BibleBack Translation

Huswi

Joshua

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka baseen ne Huswi, guhuren seini te me kabuhalan ni Israil te peglusud dan te Kanaan. Ne iyan migpangulu kandan si Huswi ne nakaliwan ki Muwisis. Seini ka me neyitabu te seini ne baseen: ka peglapas dan te Weyig ne Hurdan, ka pegkahuhus te Hiriku, ka gira diye te Ay, ka pegbaad-baad te inged diye te tagse tribu te Israil, wey ka pegbalew-balew te kasabutan te Manama wey te me keet-etawan din. Ne ka amana ne neila ne birsikulu te seini ne baseen iyan ka, “Alam kew kuntee ne aldew ke hentew ka egpamakayen niyu… Piru sikeddi wey ka me pamilya ku egpamakey mule te Magbebaye ne Manama” (24:15).

The Huswi document (LIT reading), it is a story of the descendants of Israil on their attacking of Kanaan. And the (one who) led them was Huswi who replaced Muwisis. These were the happenings in this document (LIT reading): their crossing of the Hurdan River, the destruction of Hiriku, the war there in Ay, the dividing of the place there to the each descendant of Israil, and the redoing of the agreement of God (MS Manama) and his people. And the verse that's very known in this document (LIT reading) is the, “Choose(pl) today whoever you(pl) serve… But me and my family will_serve on_the_contrary with the Lord God” (24:15).

Ka suhu te Manama ki Huswi

The command of God to Huswi

11 Human napatey si Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama, migkahiyan te Magbebaye ka talagbulig ki Muwisis ne si Huswi ne anak ni Nun, 2 “Migpatey e si Muwisis ne suluhuanen ku, purisu, keilangan ne egpangandam ka wey ka langun ne etew te peglapas te Weyig ne Hurdan peendiye te inged ne igbehey ku kaniyu te keet-etawan ku. 3 [xr]Igbehey ku kaniyu ka langun ne inged ne egkariekan niyu sumale te insaad ku ki Muwisis. 4 Seini ka eletanan niyu: puun te disirtu ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile peendiye te kabubunganan te Libanun ne diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile, wey puun te dakel ne Weyig ne Iyupratis ne diye te igsile peendiye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu ne diye te iglineb taman diye te inged te me Hitihanen. 5 [xr]Ware egpakatalu keykew taheed te manekal ke pad. Egdumaan ku sikeykew iling te pegduma ku ki Muwisis wey kene ku iya sikeykew eg-engkeran. 6 [xr]Pakannekal ka wey pakabbulut ka su sikeykew ka egpangulu te keet-etawan te peg-angken te inged ne insaad ku te me kaap-apuan dan. 7 Pakannekal ke re iya wey pakabbulut ka, keilangan ne egtumanen nu ka intiru ne Balaud ne imbehey keykew te suluhuanen ku ne si Muwisis. Kene nu irapig seini, su eyew eglampus ka minsan hendei ka egbaye. 8 Kene nu iya lingawi te egbasa ka Libru te Balaud. Palemlema nu seini te aldew wey marusilem, wey keilangan ne egtumanen nu ka langun ne nasulat kayi. Puun due, egmatubung ka wey eglampus ka. 9 Sumsumana nu ne insuhu ku sikeykew, ‘Pakannekal ka wey pakabbulut ka, kene ka iya kaaldek wey kene ka paliliyas su ka Magbebaye ne Manama nu, egduma keykew minsan hendei ka egbaye.’ ”

11 After Muwisis the servant of the Lord God had_died, the Lord told the helper of Muwisis who was Huswi the child of Nun, 2 “Muwisis my servant has died, therefore, you(sg) and all the people need to prepare(pl) for crossing the River Hurdan going_to the place that I will_give you(pl) my people. 3 [xr]I will_give you(pl) all the places that you(pl) step_on according to what_ I _promised to Muwisis. 4 This is your(pl) barrier: from the desert there in south (LIT right of line facing east) to the mountains of Libanun there in the north (LIT left of line facing east), and from the big River Iyupratis there in the east to the Sea Miditiranyu there in the west until there in the place of Hitihanons. 5 [xr]No-one will_be_able_to_defeat you(sg) while you(sg) are still strong/alive. I will_accompany you(sg) like my accompanying Muwisis and I indeed won't leave you(sg). 6 [xr]Be_strong(sg) and be_bold(sg) because you(sg) (are) the (one who) will_lead the people in accepting the place that I promised to their ancestors. 7 Be_strong(sg) indeed and be_brave(sg), it's_necessary that you(sg) obey the entire Law that was_given to_you(sg) by my servant Muwisis. Don't(sg) put_ this _aside, so_that you(sg) will_prosper wherever you(sg) go. 8 Don't(sg) forget to read the Book of the Law. Ponder(sg) this day and night, and it's_necessary that you(sg) obey all that's written here. From that, you(sg) will_flourish and you(sg) will_prosper. 9 Remember(sg) that I commanded you(sg), ‘Be_strong(sg) and be_bold(sg), don't(sg) indeed be_afraid and don't be_fearful because the Lord your(sg) God, will_accompany you(sg) wherever you(sg) go.’ ”

Ka pegsuhu ni Huswi te keet-etawan

The commanding of the people by Huswi

10 Ne insuhu ni Huswi ka me pangulu te me etew te miggenendue, 11 “Pangendiyei niyu ka kampu wey kahii niyu ka me etew te egpepangandamen sikandan te egkakeen su igkatatelu ne aldew kuntee, egpanlapas kid diye te Weyig ne Hurdan eyew te peg-angken te inged ne imbehey kanta te Magbebaye ne Manama ta.”

10 And Huswi commanded the leaders of the people going, 11 “Go_throughout(pl) the camp and tell(pl) the people to prepare food because on the third day from now, we(incl) will_cross(pl) the River Hurdan in_order for accepting the place given to_us(incl) by the Lord our(incl) God.”

12 [xr]Ne migkahiyan ni Huswi ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis,[fn] 13 “Tantanuri niyu ka ingkahi ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama ne igbehey kaniyu ka seini ne tane eyew eg-ugpaan niyu. 14 Ne ka asawa niyu, me anak niyu, wey ayam niyu, iggaat de kayi te inged te igsile te Weyig ne Hurdan ne imbehey kaniyu ni Muwisis. Piru keilangan ne eggun-a eglapas te karumaan niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ka kumplitu te panganiban eyew egbulihan sikandan, 15 taman te egkaangken dan e ka tane ne igbehey te Magbebaye ne Manama kandan. Egkataman, egkaayun kew e ne eglibed wey eg-ugpe kayi te inged te igsile te Hurdan ne imbehey kaniyu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye.”

12 [xr]And Huswi said to the descendants of Rubin, of Gad, and half of the descendant/s of Manasis,[fn] 13 “Guard(pl) what_ Muwisis the servant of the Lord God _said that this land would be_given to you(pl) in_order for you(pl) to_live_in. 14 And your(pl) spouse(s), your(pl) children, and your(pl) domestic_animals, just leave here on the east of the River Hurdan that_was_given to_you(pl) by Muwisis. But it's_necessary that the (ones) complete with weapons go_first to_cross before your(pl) relative(s) who were the descendants of Israil in_order to_help them, 15 until they receive already the land that was_given to them by the Lord. Then, it's_possible that you(pl) return and live here in the place on the east of the Hurdan that was_given to_you(pl) by Muwisis the servant of the Lord God.”

16 Ne migtabak sikandan ki Huswi, “Eggimuwen ney ka langun ne insuhu nu kanami, wey eggendiye key minsan hendei key nikeykew igpeendiye. 17 Eg-ikul key keykew iling te peg-ikul ney ki Muwisis. Egdumaan ka perem te Magbebaye ne Manama nu iling te pegduma rin ki Muwisis. 18 Eggimatayan seeye se egsupak wey seeye se kene egtuman te me suhu nu. Pakannekal ka wey pakabbulut ka!”

16 And they answered Huswi, “We(excl) will_do everything that you(sg) commanded us(excl), and we(excl) will_go wherever we(excl) are_sent by_you(sg). 17 We(excl) will_follow/imitate you(sg) like our(excl) following/imitating of Muwisis. May you(sg) be accompanied by the Lord your(sg) God like his accompanying of Muwisis. 18 Those who disobey/oppose and those who don't obey your(sg) commands will_be_killed. Be_strong(sg) and be_bold(sg)!”

Ka me tahasiliban ne insuhu peendiye te Hiriku

The spies that were commanded to go to Hiriku

21 [xr]Ne migsuhu te heles de si Huswi ne anak ni Nun te daruwa ne tahasiliban ne egpuun te kampu te Sitim wey ingkahiyan din, “Pakannekali niyu te egnengneng ka inged te Kanaan, labi en iya ka Hiriku.” Sikan naa ka nangipanew e sikandan, wey te pegginguma ran e diye te Hiriku, diye sikandan migpamaneyik te baley te malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa ne egngaranan ki Rahab, wey diye sikandan miggirehe. 2 Piru nakahiyan ka Hari te Hiriku, “Due me lukes ne egpuun te keet-etawan ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ne nakaseled kuntee ne marusilem kayi te inged ta eyew egsisilib.” 3 Ne impakahiyan te Hari te Hiriku si Rahab, “Keilangan ne igpalihawang nu ka migtuen te baley nu su miggendini sikandan ka egsisilib te intiru ne inged ta.”

21 [xr]And Huswi the child of Nun commanded secretly two spies from the camp of Sitim and he told_them, “Strive_hard to investigate(pl) the place Kanaan, especially Hiriku.” So then they went, and when they arrived there in Hiriku, they came (LIT climbed) to the house of the woman that sells (her) body named Rahab, and they stayed_overnight there. 2 But the king of Hiriku was_told, “There_are men from the people who are descendants of Israil who entered here in our(incl) place tonight in_order to spy_out.” 3 And the king of Hiriku caused_ Rahab _to_be_told, “You(sg) must let_ the ones_who_stay in your(sg) house _to_come_out because they came_here to spy_out our(incl) place.”

4 Piru nekeeles e ni Rahab ka daruwa ne tahasiliban human nekeuma ka insuhu te Hari, migkahi sikandin, “Uya, malehet ne due miggendini keddiey ne me lukes, piru wara a nakataha ke hendei sikandan egpuun. 5 Te pegkamarusilem e, te mahaan e eglekebi ka gumawan te siyudad, nangipanew e sikandan wey wara ad nakataha ke hendeid e sikandan miggendiye. Lupuha niyu sikandan il-iyali su egkeumaan niyu pad sikandan.” 6 (Kunaleg te in-uyan bes ni Rahab ka me tahasiliban diye te atep te baley[fn] rin wey imbunbunan din sikandan te me baluy.) 7 Sikan naa ka intalukunan ka me tahasiliban te me etew te Hari. Te peglihawang dan, inlekeban dan e ka gumawan te siyudad. Ne nekeuma sikandan taman diye te iglapas te Weyig ne Hurdan ka egpanalukun te me tahasiliban.

4 But Rahab had already hidden the two spies before king's messengers came, and she said, “Yes, it's true that there were two men who came to me, but I didn't know where they came_from. 5 When the evening_came, when the door of the city was about to shut, they left and I don't know where they went. Chase(pl) them quickly because you(pl) can still catch them.” 6 (On_the_contrary Rahab brought the spies there on roof of her house[fn] and she covered them with baluy_flax.) 7 So the men of the king pursued the spies. When they were coming_out, they shut the door of the city. And they reached until the crossing_bank of the River Hurdan in pursuing the spies.

8 Te ware pad miglipereng ka me tahasiliban te seeye ne marusilem, migpamaneyik e man-e si Rahab diye te atep eyew egpakiglalag kandan. 9 Ne migkahiyan din sikandan, “Nakataha a ne imbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama ka seini ne inged, wey seini ka egpuunan ne naliyasan key kaniyu wey amana naaldek kaniyu ka langun ne mahinged kayi. 10 [xra][xrb]Nakarineg key ke immenu te Magbebaye ne Manama te eg-eti ka Malalab ne Dahat te timpu te peglihawang niyu puun te Ihiptu. Nakarineg key degma ke immenu niyu te peggimatey ka daruwa ne Hari te Amurihanen ne si Sihun wey si Ug diye te igsile te Weyig ne Hurdan. 11 Te pegkarineg ney kayi, naawaan key langun te kabulut tenged kaniyu, su ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu iyan iya ka Manama te langit wey te tane. 12 Purisu kuntee, pahunlibet kew keddi te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama, ne egpapitew kew te keupiya te pamilya ku iling te keupiya ne impapitew ku kaniyu, wey pamaleheti niyu ne egtumanen niyu seini. 13 Luwasa niyu ka amey ku, iney ku, me maama ku, me hari ku ne malitan, wey ka langun ne pamilya ran. Luwasa key nikaniyu ne kene key egkapatey.”

8 Before the spies slept that night, Rahab went_up there on the roof again in_order to speak with them. 9 And she told them, “I know that the Lord God gave this place to you(pl), and this the reason we(excl) are terrified with you(pl) and all the locals here are very afraid of you(pl). 10 [xra][xrb]We(excl) heard how the Lord God dried_up the Red Sea at the time of your(pl) coming_out of Ihiptu. We(excl) heard also how you(pl) killed the two kings of Amurihanon Sihun and Ug there at the east of River Hurdan. 11 When we(excl) heard it, we(excl) all lose bravery/courage because of you(pl), because the Lord your(pl) God who is indeed the God of heaven and earth. 12 Therefore now, swear to me in the name of the Lord God, that you(pl) will_show kindness to my family like my showing of kindness to you(pl), and prove(pl) that you(pl) will_fulfill it. 13 Save my father, my mother, my brothers, my younger sisters, and all their families. Save(pl) us(excl) that we(excl) don't die.”

14 Ne ingkahiyan sikandin te daruwa ne tahasiliban, “Egpeyimatey key ke kene ney egkatuman ka ingkahi ney! Kene nu re iya degma igpanugtul ka pegsisilib ney kayi. Ne emun ke igbehey e kanami te Magbebaye ne Manama ka seini ne inged, igpapitew ney keykew ka keupiya ney wey egtumanen ney ka ingkahi ney keykew.”

14 And she was_told by the two spies, “We(excl) cause_to_be_killed if we(excl) don't fulfill what_ we(excl) _said! Just don't(pl) report also our(excl) spying here. And when the Lord God gives this place to us(excl), we(excl) will_show our(excl) goodness to you(sg) and we(excl) will_fulfill what_ we(excl) _said to you(sg).”

15 Purisu intuntun sikandan ni Rahab diye te bintana pinaahi te lubid, puun su lenged ma te batu ne alad te siyudad ka baley rin. 16 Ne ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Pangendiye kew te bubungan su eyew kene kew egkakita te seeye se egmanalukun kaniyu. Heles kew diye te tatelu ne aldew taman te eglibed e sikandan. Egkataman, kaayun kew e ne egpabulus eg-uli.”

15 Therefore they lowered by Rahab there in the window by a rope, because her house was near the stone fence of city. 16 And she told them, “Go(pl) there on the mountains so_that you(pl) won't be seen by those who run_after you(pl). Hide(pl) there for three days until they would_return. Then, you(pl) may continue to go_home.”

17 Ne ingkahiyan te daruwa ne tahasiliban si Rahab, “Kene key egkeyiketan te impepahunlibet nu kanami angin e ke egkatuman nu ka seini: 18 Te peglusud ney kayi te inged niyu, ihiket nu te bintana ka seini se malalab ne lubid ne inggamit nu te pegtuntun kanami. Ne libulunga nu kayi te baley nu ka amey nu, iney nu, me maama nu, wey ka langun ne pamilya nu. 19 Emun ke due eglihawang kayi te baley nu ne eggendiye te dalan wey egpatey sikandin, warad labet ney su seyyup din e sika. Piru emun ke eggilabetan ka diye te baley nu, sikanami ka egpanabak due. 20 Piru emun ke igwangal-wangal nu ka pegsisilib ney, kene ney egtumanen ka impepahunlibet nu kanami.” 21 Ne migtabak sikandin, “Uya, egtumanen ku ka ingkahi niyu.” Ne impeyipanew rin e sikandan. Te nekeyipanew e sikandan, inggiket din e ka malalab ne lubid diye te bintana din.

17 And Rahab was_told by the two spies, “We(excl) won't be tied_up with what_ you(sg) _caused_ us(excl) _to_swear except if you(sg) can fulfill this: 18 When we(excl) are attacking here in your(pl) place, tie this red rope at the window that you(sg) use in lowering us(excl). And gather here in your(sg) house your(sg) father, your(sg) mother, your(sg) brothers, and all your(sg) families. 19 If there's someone_coming_out from your(sg) house and go_there in the road and he dies, we(excl) are_ not _responsible (LIT no_part) because that's his mistake. But if the one in your(sg) house is touched, we(excl) (are) the ones to answer that. 20 But if you(sg) make_known our(excl) spying, we(excl) won't fulfill what_ you(sg) _caused_ us(excl) _to_swear.” 21 And she answered, “Yes, I will_fulfill what_ you(pl) _said.” And she let_ them _go. When they left already, she tied the red rope there on her window.

22 Ne miggendiye ka me tahasiliban te bubungan wey miggeles sikandan diye te tatelu ne aldew. Ne impamitew sikandan te seeye se egmanalukun kandan diye te langun ne deralanen, piru ware nakita sikandan purisu mig-uli e ka me etew te Hari. 23 Ne miglibed e ka daruwa ne tahasiliban. Migtupang sikandan te bubungan wey miglapas te weyig taman te nekeyingume e sikandan diye ki Huswi ne anak ni Nun. Ne ingguhud dan ki Huswi ka langun ne neyitabu. 24 Ingkahiyan dan si Huswi, “Malehet iya ne imbehey te Magbebaye ne Manama kanta ka intiru ne inged, wey timul pad due, nenaaldek kanta ka langun ne mahinged diye.”

22 And the spies went to the mountains and they hid there for three days. And they were searched_for by those who ran_after them in all the paths, but they were not found that's why the men of the king went_home. 23 And the two spies returned. They went_down the mountain and crossed the river until they arrived there at Huswi the child of Nun. And they told Huswi all that happened. 24 They told Huswi, “It is indeed true that the Lord God gave us(incl) the entire place, and in addition to that, the locals there were terrified us(incl).”

Ka peglapas te me kabuhalan ni Israil te Hurdan

The crossing of Hurdan by the descendants of Israil

31 Te seup ne aldew, migselem-selem mig-enew ensi Huswi wey ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil wey migligkat e sikandan puun te Sitim. Ne miggendiyad e sikandan te Weyig ne Hurdan wey migkekampu sikandan diye, te ware pad sikandan miglapas. 2 Te peglihad te tatelu ne aldew, inleug-leug te me pangulu te kabuhalan ni Israil ka kampu, 3 wey ingkahiyan dan ka me etew, “Emun ke egkakita niyu ka me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Libi ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, hipanew kew e wey sinundul kew kandan 4 eyew egkatahaan niyu ke hendei kew egbaye su ware kew re due nakabaye kayi ne dalan. Piru diyu-diyu kew re te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te me sabeka ne kilumitru.”

31 On the next day, Huswi and all the descendants of Israil rose_up early and they left from Sitim. And they went to the Hurdan river and they camped there, before they crossed. 2 When three days passed, the leaders of the descendants of Israil strolled the camp, 3 and they told the people, “When/if you(pl) see the sacrificers who are descendants of Libi carrying_together the Container of the Agreement of the Lord your(pl) God, go and follow(pl) them 4 so_that you(pl) will_know where you(pl) go because you(pl) haven't gone_through this way. But distance(pl) from the Container of the Agreement for about one kilometer.”

5 Ne ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka me etew, “Matulusa niyu ka pegkeetew niyu, su eggimu kaaselem ka Magbebaye ne Manama te kein-inuwan para kaniyu.” 6 Ne ingkahiyan degma ni Huswi ka me talagpanubad, “Uyana niyu ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan wey hun-a kew te me etew.” Sikan naa ka in-uyan dan e seini wey miggun-a sikandan te me etew.

5 And Huswi told the people, “Make_ your(pl) selves _holy, because the Lord God will_make a miracle for you(pl) tomorrow.” 6 And Huswi also told the sacrificers, “Bring(pl) the Container of the Agreement and go_ahead(pl) of the people.” So then they brought it and they went_ahead of the people.

7 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Tenged te eggimuwen ku kuntee ne aldew, egbantuhen ka te langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil wey egkanengnengan dan ne indumaan ku sikeykew iling te pegduma ku ki Muwisis. 8 Kahii nu ka me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, ‘Emun ke egpakariek kew e langun diye te Weyig ne Hurdan, diye kew pa sesasindeg.’ ”

7 And the Lord God told Huswi, “Because of what_ I _will_do this day, you(sg) will_be_made_famous by all the descendants of Israil and they will_know that I accompanied you(sg) like my accompanying with Muwisis. 8 Tell(sg) the sacrificers who carried_together the Container of the Agreement, ‘When all of you(pl) stepped on the River Hurdan already, just stand(pl)_still there.’ ”

9 Purisu ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Hendini kew wey pammineg kew te inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 10 Egkatahaan niyu kuntee ne egdumaan kew te manekal ne Manama. Te peglusud niyu, egdeldelen din iya ka me Kanaanen, me Hitihanen, me Hibihanen, me Pirisihanen, me Girgasihanen, me Amurihanen, wey me Hibusihanen. 11 Ne iyan niyu ipewun-a ipalapas te Weyig ne Hurdan ka egyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egmandu te intiru ne kalibutan. 12 Purisu kuntee, alam kew te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne etew, tigsalimbeka puun te tagse tribu te Israil. 13 Te timpu ne egpakariek e te weyig ka me talagpanubad ne egyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama te intiru ne kalibutan, egsanggel e ka weyig. Ne ka diye te diraya ne weyig, egkasubung e.”

9 So_then Huswi told the descendants of Israil, “Come_here and listen(pl) to what_ the Lord your(pl) God _said. 10 You(pl) will_know today that the living God will_accompany you(pl). On your(pl) attacking, he will_ indeed _send_away the Kanaanons, Hitihanons, Hibihanons, Pirisihanons, Girgasihanons, Amurihanons, and Hibusihanons. 11 And let_ the ones_carrying_together the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God who rules the entire world _cross first. 12 Therefore now/today, choose(pl) twelve (12) people, one from each tribe of Israil. 13 At the time the sacrificers who carry_together the Container of the Agreement of the Lord the God of the entire world step on the water, the river will stop. And the water upstream, will_be_stuck.”

14-15 Sikan naa ka nangawe e ka me etew diye te me balungbalung dan su eglapas e sikandan te Hurdan. Miggun-a kandan ka me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan. Tinggaani seeye ne timpu, wey migbaggiyu ka Hurdan. Te pegginguma te me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te weyig, miglapas e sikandan 16 wey sahuhune ne migsanggel ka weyig. Ne diye nasubung ka weyig te siyudad te Adam ne marani te Saritan. Ne warad degma weyig ne nakaleus diye te Namatey ne Dahat. Seeye naa ka nakalapas ka me etew diye te marani te Hiriku. 17 Ne diye migmanasindeg te elat te Weyig ne Hurdan ne migmammare e ka me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, taheed te miglapas ka me kabuhalan ni Israil. Ne ware mig-awe ka talagpanubad taman te naamin e nakalapas ka langun ne etew.

14-15 So then the people left there in their tents because they were crossing the Hurdan. The sacrificers carrying_together the Container of the Agreement went_ahead of them. It was harvest time, and the Hurdan was flooded. When the sacrificers carrying_together the Container of the Agreement arrived there in the river, they crossed 16 and suddenly the river stopped. And the water was stuck there in Adam the city near Saritan. And no water flowed there in Dead Sea. That's why the people were_able_to_cross there to near Hiriku. 17 And sacrificers carrying_together the Container of the Agreement stood there in the middle of the River Hurdan that dried_up, while the descendants of Israil crossed_over. And the sacrificers didn't leave until all the people crossed_over.

Ka me batu ne limlimuan

The stones that's remembrance

41 Te nakalapas e te Weyig ne Hurdan ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil, ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, 2 “Alam ka te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne etew, tigsalimbeka puun te tagse tribu te Israil. 3 Ne suhua nu sikandan ne eg-angey te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne batu diye te taliware te Hurdan, diye te lenged te nasasindehan te me talagpanubad. Ipeuyan nu seini diye te inged ne egkampuwan niyu kangkuwa te marusilem.”

41 When all the descendants of Israil crossed the River Hurdan, the Lord God told Huswi, 2 “Choose(sg) twelve (12) people, one each tribe of Israil. 3 And command them to get twelve (12) stones there in the middle of Hurdan, there near where_ the sacrificers _stood. Ask_ them _to_bring it there in the place where_ you(pl) _will_camp later tonight.”

4 Purisu, mig-alam si Huswi te tigsalimbeka puun te tagse tribu te Israil. Ne impeumew rin ka sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne me etew. 5 Ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Hendiye kew te elat te Hurdan, diye te tangkaan te nalengaran te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Angey kew te tigsalimbeka ne batu wey tianga niyu seini, tigsalimbeka re ne batu te tagse tribu te Israil. 6 Ka seini ne me batu, egkeyimu ne limlimuan te inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Emun ke eg-inse kaniyu ka me anak niyu keureme ke nekey ka igpasabut te seini ne me batu, 7 kahii niyu sikandan te migsanggel ka Weyig ne Hurdan te timpu ne impalapas ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Seini ne me batu, limlimuan te me kabuhalan ni Israil te ware egtamanan.”

4 Therefore, Huswi chose one from each tribe of Israil. And he caused_to_called the twelve (12) people. 5 He told them, “Go_there(pl) in the middle of Hurdan, there at the front where_ the Container of the Agreement of the Lord your(pl) God _stands. Get(pl) one_ stone _each and carry_it_on_shoulder(pl), only one stone each tribe of Israil. 6 This stones, will_become remembrance of what_ the Lord God _did. If your(pl) children will_ask you(pl) in_the_future what these stones means, 7 tell(pl) them that the River Hurdan stopped when the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God caused_to_crossover. These stones, remembrance of the descendants of Israil forever.”

8 Ne intuman te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne etew ka insuhu ni Huswi kandan sumale te inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Huswi. Mig-angey sikandan te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne batu diye te elat te Hurdan, tigsalimbeka tagse tribu te Israil. Ne in-uyan dan seini diye te inged ne ingkekampuwan dan wey intahu dan seini diye. 9 Migtahu degma si Huswi te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne batu diye te elat te Hurdan, diye te nalengeran te me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan. Minsan kuntee diye ded ka seeye ne me batu. 10 Migpabulus migsasindeg ka me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan diye te elat te Weyig ne Hurdan taman te neimpusan e ka langun ne impeyimu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Huswi pinaahi ki Muwisis.

8 And the twelve (12) people fulfilled the command of Huswi to them according to what_ the Lord God _told Huswi. They took twelve (12) stones there in the middle of Hurdan, one stone each tribe of Israil. And they brought it there in the place where_ they _camped and they put it there. 9 Huswi also put twelve (12) stones there in the middle of Hurdan, there near the sacrificers that carried_together the Container of the Agreement. Even today those stones were still there. 10 The sacrificers that carried_together the Container of the Agreement keep standing in the middle of River Hurdan until all that the Lord God commanded_ Huswi _to_do through Muwisis was_finished.

Ne migdagdahew e miglapas ka me etew.11 Te nakalapas e ka langun ne etew, impalapas e degma ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne miggun-e e man-e ka me talagpanubad te keet-etawan. 12 Ne miggun-a miglapas ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis[fn] ne kumplitu te panganiban wey andam egpakiggira sumale te insuhu ni Muwisis kandan. 13 Migginguma ka me lukes ne andam ne egpakiggira ne hep-at ne pulu ne libu (40,000), wey migdumaan sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama te pegbaye dan diye te napu ne marani te Hiriku. 14 Te seeye ne aldew, impabantug te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi diye te langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. Intahud sikandin te me etew te intiru ne umul rin iling te pegtahud te me etew ki Muwisis.

And the people crossed_over quickly.11 When all the people have crossed already, the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God was caused_ to _crossover also. And the sacrificers went_ahead of the people. 12 And the tribes of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendant/s of Manasis[fn] that's complete weapons and ready to fight crossed first according to the command of Muwisis to them. 13 The forty thousand (40,000) men who were ready to fight came, and the Lord God accompanied them when they passing_through there at the valley near Hiriku. 14 On that day, the Lord God exalted Huswi before all the descendants of Israil. The people respected him in his entire life like the respecting of the people with Muwisis.

15 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, 16 “Kahii nu ka me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan ne eggakap e sikandan te Weyig ne Hurdan.” 17 Purisu impahakap din e te Hurdan ka me talagpanubad. 18 Te nakahakap e te weyig ka me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, migduu e man-e ka weyig iling te an-anayan.

15 And Huswi was_told by Lord God, 16 “Tell(sg) the sacrificers who carried_together the Container of the Agreement that they can_come_out the River Hurdan already.” 17 Therefore he caused_ the sacrificers _to_come_out of the Hurdan. 18 When the sacrificers who carried_together the Container of the Agreement came_out from the river, the river/water overflowed again like the first.

19 Miglapas ka me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Hurdan te igkasapulu ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan. Ne nangekampu sikandan diye te Gilgal ne lenged te Hiriku ne diye dapit te igsile. 20 Ne diye itahu ni Huswi ka sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne batu ne impaangey rin diye te Hurdan. 21 Ne ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Emun ke eg-inse kaniyu ka me anak niyu keureme ke nekey ka igpasabut te seini ne me batu, 22 kahii niyu sikandan, ‘Neetiyan ka Weyig ne Hurdan te peglapas te me kabuhalan ni Israil.’ 23 Su impeetiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka Weyig ne Hurdan taman te nakalapas key e, iling te peg-eti rin dengan te Malalab ne Dahat taman te nakalapas key e langun. 24 Inggimu rin seini eyew eg-ileen sikandin te langun ne etew te kalibutan ne maresen iya sikandin, wey eyew egtahuren niyu sikandin ne Manama niyu te ware egtamanan.”

19 The descendants of Israil crossed Hurdan on the tenth day of the first month. And they camped there in Gilgal that's near Hiriku that's there in the east (LIT the other side of the sunrise). 20 And Huswi put there the twelve (12) stones that he caused_to_get from Hurdan. 21 And Huswi told the descendants of Israil, “When/If your(pl) children are asking you(pl) in_the_future what's the meaning of these stones, 22 tell(pl) them, ‘The River Hurdan dried_up when descendants of Israil crossed.’ 23 Because the Lord your(pl) God dried_up the River Hurdan until we(excl) were able_to_cross already, like his drying_up of the Red Sea until all of us(excl) crossed already. 24 He did this in_order for him to be recognized by all people on earth that he is indeed powerful, and in_order that you(pl) will_respect him as your(pl) God without ending.”

51 Narineg te langun ne Hari te Amurihanen ne diye te iglineb te Weyig ne Hurdan, wey te langun ne Hari te Kanaanen ne diye te ilis te Dahat ne Miditiranyu, te impeetiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka Hurdan te peglapas te me kabuhalan ni Israil. Seeye naa ka naaldek sikandan wey warad kabulut dan ne egkuntere te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

51 And all the Amurihanon kings there on the west of the River Hurdan, and all the Kanaanon kings there at the edge of the Miditiranyu Sea, heard the story that the Lord God caused_ the Hurdan _to_dry_up at the crossing of the descendants of Israil. That's why they were_afraid(pl) and bereft_of fierceness to oppose the (ones) from_Israil.

Ka pegtuli wey ka sahakeen diye te Gilgal

The circumcising and the feast there at Gilgal

2 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Himu ka te ilab puun te sumalem ne batu wey tulii nud man-e ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne ware pad natulii.” 3 Sikan naa ka miggimu si Huswi te ilab wey intulian din ka me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Gibiyat-Haaralut.[fn] 4-6 [xr]Seini ka egpuunan mania te inggimu rin sika. Te peg-awe dan diye te Ihiptu, natulian e ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. Piru ware pad natulii ka neneetew te timpu te sasangan sikandan ne eggipanew diye te disirtu te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un. Te seeye ne timpu, nammatey e ka me lukes ne eleg e ne egpakiggira su ware dan ma tumana ka suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ingkahiyan sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne kene dan e egkakita ka meupiya ne tane wey dakel se eg-uma[fn] ne insaad din ne igbehey kandan. 7 Ne ka me anak dan ne migsubal kandan, intulian ni Huswi su ware ma natulii sikandan te timpu te sasangan pad sikandan ka eggipanew.

2 And Huswi was_told by the Lord God, “Make(sg) a knife from a hard stone and circumcise(sg) the descendants of Israil that are_ not _circumcised yet.” 3 So then Huswi made a knife and he circumcised the descendants of Israil there in Gibiyat-Haaralut.[fn] 4-6 [xr]This is the reason why he did that. On their leaving in Ihiptu, all the descendants of Israil were circumcised already. But those who were_borne on the time while they were_walking there in the desert for forty (40) years were not circumcised yet. At that time, the males that fit for fighting died already because they didn't obey the command of the Lord God. They were_told by the Lord God that they won't see the good land and has plenty of harvest[fn] which he promised to give to them. 7 And their children who replaced them, Huswi circumcised (them) because they were not circumcised on the time while they were_walking.

8 Te natulian e ka langun, migpalunggaat pad sikandan diye te kampu ran taman te neulian e ka me pali dan. 9 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Kuntee ne aldew in-awe ku ka keyilew niyu puun te pegkeuripen niyu te Ihiptu.” Sikan naa ka minsan kuntee, ingngaranan te Gilgal[fn] ka seeye ne inged.

8 When all were circumcised, they remained in their camp until their wounds were healed. 9 And Huswi was_told by the Lord God, “This day I removed your(pl) shame from your(pl) being_enslaved in Ihiptu.” That's why even today, that place was called Gilgal.[fn]

10 [xr]Taheed te nangekampu pad ka me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Gilgal ne diye te napu te Hiriku, migsahakeen sikandan te Peglihad te Panalihan te Manama te igkasapulu wey hep-at (14) ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan. 11 Te seup ne aldew, migkeen sikandan te egkakeen ne in-uma te seeye ne inged: sinandag ne keenen wey paan ne ware patulin. 12 [xr]Puun te seeye ne timpu, mig-engked e ka peg-uran te mana, wey warad nakakuwa kayi ka me kabuhalan ni Israil. Puun te seeye ne leg-un, iyan dan e egkeenen ka eg-uma te tane te Kanaan.

10 [xr]While the descendants of Israil were still camping there in Gilgal there in the valley of Hiriku, they feasted for the Passing of the Angel of God on the fourteenth (14) day of the first month. 11 On the following day, they ate a food that harvested in that place: roasted food and bread without leaven. 12 [xr]From that time, the raining of mana stopped, and the descendants of Israil didn't get_any of it. From that year, they ate the harvest of the land of Kanaan.

Si Huswi wey ka etew ne due kampilan

Huswi and the person with sword

13 Taheed te diye si Huswi te marani te Hiriku, due nakita rin ne etew ne migsasindeg diye te tangkaan din ne miggen-gen te kampilan. Mig-insaan sikandin ni Huswi, “Sundalu ney sikeykew wey ke kuntere ney naa?”

13 While Huswi was there near Hiriku, he saw a man standing there in front of him who held a sword. Huswi asked him, “Are you(sg) our(excl) soldier or our(excl) enemy?”

14 Ne migtabak ka etew, “Kena a ne sundalu niyu wey ke kuntere naa. Sikeddi ka pangulu te me sundalu te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

14 And the person answered, “I am not your(pl) soldier or enemy. I (am) the leader of the soldiers of the Lord God.”

Ne miglangkeb si Huswi eyew egsimba kandin wey mig-insaan din, “Ahalen, nekey ka igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen ku te suluhuanen nu?”

And Huswi prostrated in_order to worship him and he asked_him, “Master, what do you(sg) want me to do as your(sg) servant?”

15 Ne migtabak ka pangulu te me sundalu te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Luunga nu ka sandal nu su matulus ka inged ne migsasindehan nu.” Ne intuman ni Huswi ka impeyimu kandin.

15 And the leader of the soldiers of the Lord God answered, “Take_off your(sg) sandal because the place where_ you(sg) _stand is holy.” And Huswi fulfilled what_ he _asked_to_do.

Ka pegkahuhus te Hiriku

The destruction of Hiriku

61 Ne inlekeban ay-ayari te me mahinged te siyudad ne Hiriku ka me gumawan dan tenged te me kabuhalan ni Israil. Ne ware etew ne egpakalasud wey ke egpakalihawang naa te siyudad. 2 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Igpatalu ku keykew ka Hiriku lagkes ka Hari wey ka me bahani. 3 Linglinguti nu ka siyudad duma te me sundalu nu kasabeka te tagse aldew te hen-em ne aldew. 4 Pewun-aa nu ka pitu ne talagpanubad ne eg-uyan te me trumpita ne sungey te lukes ne karniru. Te igkapitu ne aldew, linguti nu te kapapitu ka siyudad duma te me sundalu, wey duma te me talagpanubad ne egparahing te trumpita ne sungey. 5 Ne egparahingen dan te mananey ka me trumpita. Ne emun ke egkarineg nud e seini, pepanguleyia nud naa patamtamana ka me etew wey egkahuhus ka batu ne alad te siyudad. Ne egpakalasud kew e langun su warad man e elet.”

61 And the locals of Hiriku shut the doors of city of Hiriku properly because of the descendants of Israil. No person can attack or can get_out the city. 2 And Huswi was_told by the Lord God, “I will_cause_ Hiriku _to_be_defeated by you(sg) including the king and his warriors. 3 Go_around(sg) the city with your(sg) soldiers once each day for six days. 4 Let_ the seven sacrificers that bring trumpets of male sheep's horn _go_first. On the seventh day, go_around(pl) the city with the soldiers for seven_times, and with the sacrificers sounding horn trumpets. 5 And they will_sound for long the trumpets. And if you(sg) hear this, cause_ all the people _to_shout loudly and the stone fence of the city will_be_destroyed. And all of you(pl) can enter because there's_no blockage anymore.”

6 Purisu, inlibulung ni Huswi ka me talagpanubad wey ingkahiyan din, “Yayungi niyu ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne due eggun-a ne pitu ne talagpanubad ne eg-uyan te me trumpita ne sungey te karniru.” 7 Ne ingkahiyan din degma ka me etew, “Ligkat kew e! Linguti niyud e ka siyudad. Ne due eggun-a ne me sundalu ne kumplitu te panganiban te seeye se pitu ne talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

6 Therefore, Huswi gathered the sacrificers and he told_them, “Carry_together(pl) the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God. And there (will be) seven sacrificers going_ahead that will_bring trumpets of sheep's horn.” 7 And he told the people also, “Go(pl) now! Go_around(pl) the city. And there (will be) soldiers with complete weapons going_ahead with those seven sacrificers carrying_together the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God.”

8 Pegkapenga ni Huswi te pegsuhu te me etew, miggun-e e ka pitu ne talagpanubad te seeye se me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan wey imparahing dan e ka me trumpita ran ne sungey. 9 Ne miggun-a ka duma ne me sundalu ne kumplitu te panganiban te seeye se me talagpanubad ne migparahing te me trumpita, wey migsinundul ka duma ne me sundalu te me talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan taheed te imparahing ka me trumpita. 10 Piru ware pad ipepanguleyi ni Huswi ka me etew wey ke eglalag-lalag naa taman te egsuhuen din e sikandan.

8 After Huswi's commanding of the people, the seven sacrificers went_ahead of the sacrificers carrying_together the Container of the Agreement and they sounded their horn trumpets. 9 And other soldiers complete with weapons went_ahead the sacrificers that sounded the trumpets, and other soldiers followed the sacrificers who were carrying_together the Container of the Agreement while the trumpets were sounded. 10 But Huswi caused_ the people not _to_shout or speak until he will_command them.

11 Sikan naa ka impalingut dan kasabeka te siyudad ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Pegkapenga ran, miglibed e sikandan diye te kampu wey diyad sikandan miggirehe.

11 So then they caused_ the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God _to_go_around the city once. When_ they _were_finished, they returned there in the camp and they stayed_overnight there.

12 Te pegkamaselem e, migselem-selem mig-enew si Huswi. Ne inyayungan e man-e te me talagpanubad ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan. 13 Ne miggun-a red man-e ka pitu ne talagpanubad ne migparahing te me trumpita. Ne sikan ded degma ka inggimu te me sundalu ne kumplitu te panganiban, miggun-a ka duma wey migpamewuri ka duma te seeye se pitu ne talagpanubad ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, taheed te pabulus ne imparahing ka me trumpita. 14 Te igkarangeb e ne aldew, miglingut e man-e sikandan te siyudad wey miglibed e man-e sikandan diye te kampu ran. Ne seeye ded ka inggimu ran te hen-em ne aldew.

12 When the morning_came, Huswi rose_up early. And the Container of the Agreement was carried_together again by the sacrificers. 13 And the seven sacrificers went_ahead again sounding their trumpets. And same also what_ the soldiers in complete weapons _did, others went_ahead and others followed those seven sacrificers who carried_together the Container of the Agreement, while the trumpets were sounded continually. 14 On the second day, they went_around the city again and they returned there in their camp. And they did the same within six days.

15 Te egpamalat-palat pad te igkapitu ne aldew, nangenew e sikandan wey migparid e man-e sikandan palingut te siyudad iling te inggimu ran te an-anayan. Piru te seini ne aldew, kapapitu sikandan miglingut te siyudad. 16 Te igkapitu ran e te eglingut, imparahing e te me talagpanubad ka me trumpita, wey ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka me etew, “Panguleyi kew e su imbehey e kanta te Magbebaye ne Manama ka seini ne siyudad! 17 Ne keilangan ne egdereetan en iya ka langun ne diye te Hiriku isip ighalad wey igpanubad te Magbebaye ne Manama. Iyan de egkaluwas si Rahab ka malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa wey ka langun ne sakup te pamilya rin tenged su inluwas din ma ka me tahasiliban ta. 18 Ne kene kew panguwa te minsan nekey ne natahahe e ne egdereetan. Egkahule kew ke egpanguwa kew kayi, wey sikaniyu ka egpuunan ke due egginguma ne karereetan te Israil. 19 Piru ilein niyu ka langun ne inggimu puun te pelata, bulawan, burunsi wey ke putew naa su para sika te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne keilangan ne itahu niyu sika diye te tahuanan te karatuan te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

15 While it was still dawn on the seventh day, they rose_up and they march again around the city like what they did at first. But on this day, they went_around the city seven_times. 16 When they went_around for seventh_time, the sacrificers sounded the trumpets, and Huswi told the people, “Shout(pl) already because the Lord God gave us(incl) this city! 17 And everything in Hiriku must be indeed destroyed as an offering and sacrifice to the Lord God. Only Rahab the woman that sells (her) body and all members of her family will_be_saved because he saved also our(incl) spies. 18 And don't(pl) get anything that's intended to_be_destroyed. You(pl) will_be_doomed if you(pl) take it, and you(pl) (will be) the source if there's something_bad coming in Israil. 19 But separate(pl) all that's made of silver, gold, bronze and iron because that's for the Lord God. And you(pl) must put that there in the storage of the riches of the Lord God.”

20 [xr]Sikan naa ka imparahing e te me talagpanubad ka me trumpita ne sungey. Te pegkarineg dutu te me kabuhalan ni Israil, migpanaman-taman e sikandan migpanguleyi wey nahuhus ka batu ne alad te siyudad. Ne nakalasud e sikandan, wey in-ahew ran e ka siyudad. 21 Ne inggule dan pangimatayi ka langun ne diye te siyudad, ka me lukes, me malitan, me buyag, wey me bate-bate pad. Inlagkes dan degma pangimatayi ka me baka, me karniru, wey me asnu.

20 [xr]So then the sacrificers sounded the horn trumpets. When the descendants of Israil heard it, they shouted loudly and the stone fence of city was_destroyed. And they were able_to_enter, and they won_over the city. 21 And they killed all that's in the city, men, women, old_people, and young (ones). They also killed the cows, sheeps, and donkeys.

22 Ne ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka daruwa ne tahasiliban dengan, “Hendiyei niyu ka baley te malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa wey palihawanga niyu sikandin wey ka langun ne sakup te pamilya rin sumale te insaad niyu kandin.” 23 Purisu, nangendiyad e sikandan wey impalihawang dan si Rahab, duma te amey rin, iney rin, me maama rin, wey ka langun ne sakup te pamilya rin. Impalihawang dan ka langun ne sakup te pamilya ni Rahab wey impeugpe dan diye te lihawangan te kampu ran. 24 Ne insilaban dan ka intiru ne siyudad wey ka langun ne nakatahu diye, angin e te me kasangkapan ne inggimu puun te pelata, bulawan, burunsi, wey putew. Impanguwa ran seini wey intahu dan diye te balungbalung ne tahuanan te karatuan te te Magbebaye ne Manama. 25 [xr]Piru inluwas ni Huswi si Rahab, ka malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa wey ka langun ne sakup te pamilya rin, tenged su inluwas din ma ka insuhu ni Huswi ne migsisilib te Hiriku. Ne minsan kuntee mig-ugpe ded diye te Israil ka me kabuhalan ni Rahab.

22 And Huswi told the two_men who spied long_ago, “Go(pl) to the house of the woman that sells (her) body and let_her come_out and all members of her family according to what_ you(pl) _promised to her.” 23 Therefore, they went and they made_ Rahab _come_out, with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all members of her family. They made_ all the members of the family of Rahab _come_out and made_ them _live there outside their camp. 24 And they burned the entire city and all that's contained there, except the possessions made from silver, gold, bronze, and iron. They took it and they put there in storage of the riches tent of the Lord God. 25 [xr]But Huswi saved Rahab, the woman that sells (her) body and all the members of her family, because she saved also the ones_sent by Huswi that spied_out Hiriku. And even today the descendants of Rahab still lived there in Israil.

26 [xr]Te seeye ne timpu, impanpanayan ni Huswi ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te, “Egdilusen te Magbebaye ne Manama ka minsan hentew ne egbalew-balew egpasasindeg te siyudad ne Hiriku.

26 [xr]At that time, Huswi warned the descendants of Israil, “The Lord God will_curse the one(s) who rebuild again the city of Hiriku.

Ne egpatayan te panganey ne anak

And the eldest child will_die

ka minsan hentew ne egpasasindeg te pabunsuran te siyudad.

of whoever rebuild the foundation of the city.

Ne egpatayan te kinaariyan ne anak

And the youngest child will_die

ka minsan hentew ne egpasasindeg te me gumawan te siyudad.”

of whoever rebuild the doors of the city.”

27 Ne indumaan iya te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, wey nabantug sikandin te minsan hendei ne inged.

27 And the Lord God really accompanied Huswi, and he became_famous in wherever place.

Ka sale ni Akan

The sin of Akan

71 Piru insupak te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka insuhu kandan ne kene egkuwa te minsan nekey ne inhalad wey impanubad para te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne due etew ne egngaranan ki Akan ne migpanguwa te me kasangkapan ne kene igpakuwa kandan, sikan naa ka mig-ebel-ebel ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama te me kabuhalan ni Israil. Si Akan anak ni Karmi. Ne si Karmi anak ni Sabdi, wey si Sabdi anak ni Sira. Ne sakup sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Huda.

71 But the descendants of Israil disobeyed what_commanded to them not to take anything offered and sacrificed for the Lord God. And there was a man named Akan who took some possessions that were prohibited for them to get, that's why the anger of the Lord God smoked to the descendants of Israil. Akan was the child of Karmi. And Karmi was the child of Sabdi, and Sabdi was the child of Sira. And they were members of the descendants of Huda.

2 Ne puun te Hiriku, migpeuyan si Huswi te me etew ne egsisilib diye te Ay, ka siyudad ne diye te kewun-aan te Bitil diye dapit te igsile ne marani te Bit-Abin. Purisu nangendiye ka me etew eyew egsisilib diye te Ay. 3 Te peglibed dan e, ingkahiyan dan si Huswi, “Kene egkaayun ne eglusud ki langun diye te Ay su kene ne masulug ka me mahinged diye. Suhu ke re te daruwa ne libu (2,000) wey ke tatelu ne libu (3,000) naa ne sundalu.” 4 Purisu, me tatelu ne libu (3,000) re ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ka miglusud te Ay, piru nenakapallahuy sikandan puun te me mahinged diye. 5 Impanalukunan sikandan ligkat te gumawan te siyudad peendiye te Sibarim, wey napatayan sikandan te tatelu ne pulu wey hen-em (36) te pegtupang dan diye te me bubungan. Sikan naa ka naawaan ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te kabulut wey nenalliyasan sikandan.

2 And from Hiriku, Huswi sent people that will_spy there in Ay, the city there ahead of Bitil there in the east (LIT other side of the sunrise) near Bit-Abin. So_then the people went_there in_order to spy_out there in Ay. 3 On their returning, they told Huswi, “It's not good (LIT possible) that all of us(incl) attack Ay because the locals there are not many. Just command two thousand (2,000) or three thousand (3,000) soldiers.” 4 Therefore, about three thousand (3,000) descendants of Israil only attacked Ay, but they fled from the locals there. 5 They were_chased from the door of the city going to Sibarim, and thirty-six (36) of them were_killed when they were going_downhill the mountains. That's why the descendants of Israil lost their bravery/courage and they were terrified.

6 Tenged te peglungku ni Huswi wey te me igdatu te me kabuhalan ni Israil, inggisi dan ka me kumbale dan, imbukbukan dan te me alinepung ka me ulu ran, wey miglangkeb sikandan diye te tangkaan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama taman te marusilem. 7 Ne migkahi si Huswi, “He Magbebaye ne Manama, mania te impalapas key pad iya nikeykew te Hurdan ke igpatalu key re nikeykew te me Amurihanen? Meupiya pad perem ke diye key red kuntee te talipag te Hurdan. 8 He Magbebaye ne Manama, nekey naan e ka igkalalag ku te nakapallahuy ka me kabuhalan ni Israil puun te me kuntere dan? 9 Emun ke egkatahaan seini te me Kanaanen wey duma pad ne me mahinged kayi, eglingutan key e nikandan wey egpangimatayan key e. Purisu, nekey-a ka eggimuwen ney eyew kene egpakakahi ka me etew te kene ka ne mabantug ne Manama?”

6 Because of Huswi's mourning and of the leaders/datus of the descendants of Israil, they torn their cloths, they poured dust on their heads, and they prostrated there in front of the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God until the evening. 7 And Huswi said, “Oh Lord God, why did you(sg) caused_ us(excl) _to_cross Hurdan if you(sg) just cause_ us(excl) _to_be_defeated by the Amurihanons? It's better yet (wishful) that we(excl) are still there across Hurdan now/today. 8 Oh Lord God, what can I say for the descendants of Israil fled from their enemies? 9 If the Kanaanons will_know this and other locals here, they will_surround us(excl) and kill us(excl). Therefore, what should we(excl) do so_that the people won't be_able_to_say that you(sg) (are) not a famous God?”

10 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Sasindeg ka! Mania te miglangkeb ka? 11 Nakasale ka me kabuhalan ni Israil; insupak dan ka kasabutan ku kandan. Impanguwa ran ka me kasangkapan ne nakahalad e wey nakapanubad e keddi. Intakew ran seini wey mig-uubat pad man-e sikandan ne ware migpanakew, wey insewug dan e itahu te me kasangkapan dan. 12 Sika ka egpuunan ne ware natalu te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me kuntere dan. Ne nakapallahuy sikandan su minsan sikandan, inteil e iya te Manama ne egkapatey. Kena ad egduma kaniyu angin e ke egdereetan niyu ka me kasangkapan ne ware ku ipakuwa kaniyu. 13 Kahii nu ka me etew te keilangan ne egkamatulus sikandan kaaselem su egkahi a se Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Sikaniyu se me kabuhalan ni Israil, due inggeles niyu ne me kasangkapan ne nahalad e wey nakapanubad e keddi. Kene kew egpakasukul te me kuntere niyu ke kene niyu eg-aween due te kaniyu ka sika ne me kasangkapan. 14 Sikan naa, parani kew kaaselem keddi se tagse tribu. Ka egkaalam ku ne tribu ne nakasale, egparani keddi ka tagse pamilya. Ne ka egkaalam ku ne pamilya ne nakasale, egparani keddi ka tagse sabeka ne sakup te sika ne pamilya. 15 Ka etew ne egkasapenan ku ne migkuwa te me kasangkapan ne natahahe e ne egdereetan, egtutungen sikandin duma te pamilya rin wey te langun ne karatuan din. Su insupak din ka kasabutan ku, wey nekeyimu sikandin te mekeyilew-hilew diye te Israil.’ ”

10 And Huswi told the Lord God, “Stand(sg)! Why did(sg) prostrate? 11 The descendants of Israil have_sinned; they disobeyed my agreement with them. They took the possessions that were offered and sacrificed to me already. They have stolen it and they still lied that they didn't stole_it, and they mixed among their possessions. 12 That's the reason that the descendants of Israil didn't defeat their enemies. And they fled because even they, were_set_aside already to be_killed by God indeed. I won't accompany you(pl) except if you(pl) will_destroy the possessions that I didn't caused_you(pl)_to_get. 13 Tell(sg) the people that it's_necessary that they become_holy tomorrow because I will_say as Lord God, ‘You(pl) the descendants of Israil, there are possessions that's offered and sacrificed to me already that you(pl) hid. You(pl) can't fight_back with your(pl) enemies if you(pl) won't remove that possessions from you(pl). 14 So then, come(pl) to me tomorrow (by) each tribe. The tribe that I could_choose that sinned, each family will_come to me. And the family that I could_choose that sinned, each member of that family will_come to me. 15 The person that I will_find who took the possessions intended/set to be_destroyed, s/he will_be_burned with his/her family and all his/her riches. Because he disobeyed my agreement, and he made a shameful_thing there in Israil.’ ”

16 Te maselem-selem pad, impeparani e ni Huswi diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ka tagse tribu te Israil. Ne iyan naalam ka me kabuhalan ni Huda. 17 Ne impeparani rin ka me sakup te me kabuhalan ni Huda wey iyan din naalam ka kabuhalan ni Sira. Ne impeparani rin ka kabuhalan ni Sira wey iyan din naalam ka pamilya ni Sabdi. 18 Ne impeparani rin ka pamilya ni Sabdi wey iyan naalam si Akan. Si Akan, anak ni Karmi. Ne si Karmi, anak ni Sabdi wey si Sabdi, anak ni Sira. Sakup sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Huda. 19 Ne ingkahiyan ni Huswi si Akan, “Tatu, inangen nu ke nekey ka malehet kayi te tangkaan te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, wey ipangguhud nu ka sale nu. Inangen nu kuntee keddi ke nekey ka inggimu nu. Kene nu iheeles keddi.”

16 In very_early_morning still, Huswi caused_ every descendants of Israil _to_come_near to the Lord God. And the descendants of Huda was_chosen. 17 And he caused_ the members of the descendants of Huda _to_come_near and he has chosen the descendants of Sira. And he caused_ the descendants of Sira _to_come_near and he has chosen the family of Sabdi. 18 And he caused_ the descendants of Sabdi _to_come_near and he has chosen Akan. Akan, was the child of Karmi. And Karmi, was child of Sabdi and Sabdi, was the child of Sira. They were members of the descendants of Huda. 19 And Huswi told Akan, “Lad, tell(sg) what's true here in front of the Lord, the God of Israil, and story(sg) your(sg) sin. Tell(sg) to me now what you(sg) did. Don't hide (it) to me.”

20 Ne migtabak si Akan, “Malehet iya ne nakasala a te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil. Ne seini ka inggimu ku: 21 nakaahew ki te me kasangkapan, wey due nakita ku ne mateles ne kumbale ne egpuun te Babilunya, pelata ne me daruwa ne kilu, wey sabeka ne tempug ne bulawan ne ware de migginguma te liware te kilu se kabehat. Amana a neimma te seeye ne me kasangkapan, purisu ingkuwa ku. Ne inlebeng ku seeye diye te seled te balungbalung ku, wey impariralem ku ka pelata.”

20 And Akan answered, “It's really true that I sinned to the Lord the God of Israil. And this is what_ I _did: 21 we(incl) snatched some possessions, and there's a nice cloth that I saw from Babilunya, silver about two kilograms, and one cut of gold which doesn't weigh half kilogram the weight. I liked so much of those possessions, therefore I took (it). I buried them there inside my tent, and I put the silver underneath_other_stuff.”

22 Purisu, impeendiyaan ni Huswi te pila-pila ne etew ka balungbalung ni Akan. Ne nakita ran diye ka me kasangkapan ne inlebeng, wey nakariralem iya ka pelata. 23 Ingkuwa ran seini wey in-uyan dan diye ki Huswi wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil, wey impanahu dan seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

22 Therefore, Huswi caused_ few_men _to_go to the tent of Akan. And they found there the possessions that were buried, and the silver was indeed underneath. 23 They took it and brought there to Huswi and to the descendants of Israil, and they put them there in front of the Lord God.

24 Ne in-uyan ni Huswi wey te langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil si Akan diye te bangalug ne egngaranan te Akur.[fn] In-lagkes dan uyana ka pelata, kumbale, sabeka ne tempug ne bulawan, me anak din, me baka rin, me asnu rin, me karniru rin, balungbalung din, wey ka langun ne karatuan din. 25 Te pegginguma ran diye, ingkahiyan e ni Huswi si Akan, “Sikeykew ka egpuunan ne egkareetan key, purisu, eglegparan ka kuntee te Magbebaye ne Manama.” Ne imbebatu e te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil si Akan wey ka pamilya rin taman te nammatey sikandan. Insilaban dan ka lawa ran wey ka me karatuan dan. 26 Pegkeimpus, intambuan dan si Akan te masulug ne me batu. Ne minsan kuntee diye ded ka seeye ne me batu. Ne ingngaranan ka seeye ne inged te bangalug ne egngaranan te Akur.

24 And Huswi and all the descendants of Israil brought Akan there in the valley that's named Akur.[fn] They brought along the silver, cloth, one bar of gold, his children, his cows, his donkeys, his sheeps, his tent, and all his riches. 25 When they arrived there, Huswi told Akan, “You(sg) the reason (LIT source) that we(excl) will_be_destroyed, therefore, the Lord God will_punish you(sg) today.” And all the descendants of Israil stoned Akan and his family until (they) died. They burned their bodies and their riches. 26 Afterwards, they piled_up Akan with many stones. And even today those stones were still there. That place was called valley that's named Akur.

Ne naawe e ka egmangebel-ebel ne langet te Magbebaye ne Manama.

And the smoking anger of the Lord God was_removed.

Ka pegkatalu wey ka pegkahuhus te Ay

The defeat and destruction of Ay

81 Ne migkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Kene ka kaaldek wey ke egmahuye naa. Dumaa nu ka langun ne sundalu nu wey lusuri niyu abeyi ka Ay, su igbehey kud e kaniyu ka Hari te Ay, wey ka me etew rin, ka siyudad din, wey ka me inged din. 2 Himuwa niyu diye te Ay wey te Hari dutu, ka iling te inggimu niyu diye te Hiriku wey te Hari diye. Piru te seini ne timpu, egkaayun e ne egpanguen niyud ka me kasangkapan dan wey ka me ayam dan. Andam kew wey tigkawa niyu sikandan lusuri, ne diye kew baye te liyu te siyudad.”

81 And Huswi was_told by the Lord God, “Don't be_afraid or become weak. Bring_with you(sg) all the soldiers and attack Ay again, because I will_give you(pl) the king of Ay, his men, his city, and his places/villages. 2 Do(pl) in Ay and to the king of it, something_like what you(pl) did in Hiriku and the king there. But this time, it's_possible for you(pl) to get their possessions and their domestic_animals. Get_ready and attack them suddenly, and you(pl) come behind the city.”

3 Sikan naa ka migpangandam si Huswi wey ka me sundalu rin ne eglusud te Ay. Mig-alam si Huswi te tatelu ne pulu ne libu (30,000) ne me bahani, wey impeyipanew rin sikandan te marusilem. 4 Ne seini ka impanaha-taha rin kandan, “Heles kew diye te liyu te siyudad, piru kene kew re amana pariyu. Ne pangandam kew layun ne eglusud te minsan nekey ne uras. 5 Ne sikeddi wey ka duma ku ne me sundalu, eglusud diye te tangkaan te siyudad. Ne emun ke eglihawang e sikandan ka egkuntere kanami, egpallahuy key iling te an-anayan ne peglusud ta kandan. 6 Ne kahiyen dan e ne naaldek key kandan iling te an-anayan. Sikan naa ka egtalukunan key e nikandan taman te egpakapariyu e sikandan te siyudad. 7 Ne lihawang kew naan e diye te inggelesan niyu wey lusuri niyud ka siyudad, su imbehey e seini kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 8 Emun ke egkaahew niyud ka siyudad, silabi niyu seini sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Tumana niyu seini se insuhu ku kaniyu.” 9 Purisu, impeendiyad e sikandan ni Huswi, wey nangeles sikandan diye te lenged te Ay, diye dapit te iglineb, diye seini te elat-elat te Ay wey Bitil. Ne migpalunggaat de mule si Huswi wey ka me duma rin diye te kampu ran te seeye ne marusilem.

3 So then Huswi and his soldiers got_ready to attack Ay. Huswi chose thirty thousand (30,000) warriors, and he sent them in the evening. 4 And he reminded them this, “Hide(pl) there at behind the city, but just don't(pl) stay_far. And all of you(pl) get_ready(pl) to attack in any hour. 5 And I and my companion soldiers, will_attack at the front of the city. And if they will_come_out to fight with us(excl), we(excl) will_run_away just like our(incl) first attack with them. 6 And they think_mistakenly that we(excl) are_afraid of them like the first. So then they will_run_after us(excl) until they will_be_far from the city. 7 And you(pl) come_out from where_ you(pl) _hide and attack the city, because this is given to you(pl) by the Lord your(pl) God. 8 When you(pl) will_snatch the city already, burn it according to what_ the Lord God _has_commanded. Fulfill this what_ I _commanded you(pl).” 9 Therefore, Huswi caused_ them _to_go, and they hid there at near of Ay, there at the other side of the sunset, this was in between Ay and Bitil. On_the_contrary Huswi and his companions remained only in their camp on that evening.

10 Te napawe e, migselem-selem mig-enew si Huswi wey inlibulung din ka me sundalu rin. Ne iyan migpangulu si Huswi wey ka me igdatu te Israil te peggendiye dan te Ay. 11 Ne nekeuma sikandan diye te inged ne egpakatangke te siyudad te Ay, wey diyad sikandan migkekampu. Diye seini te igkahibang ne balabahan te siyudad. Ne due bangalug ne nakataliware kandan wey te Ay. 12 Ne duen e impewun-a ni Huswi ne lalimma ne libu (5,000) ne sundalu ne impeeles din diye dapit te iglineb te siyudad, diye seini te elat-elat te Ay wey Bitil. 13 Iling kayi ka pegteil ni Huswi te me sundalu: ka masulug ne me sundalu diye te lenged te siyudad, te igkahibang ne balabahan, wey ka impeeles diye lenged te peka te siyudad, dapit te iglineb. Te marusilem e, miggendiye si Huswi wey ka me duma rin diye te napu. 14 Te pegkakita te Hari te Ay te me kabuhalan ni Israil, migdagdahew sikandin miglihawang wey ka langun ne sundalu rin te siyudad te pegkamaselem. Ne miggendiye sikandan te inged ne egpakapantew te napu te Hurdan eyew egbubunu te me kabuhalan ni Israil. Ware sikandan nakataha ne duen bes eglusud kandan ne egpuun diye te liyu te siyudad. 15 Ne miglilibat si Huswi wey ka langun ne me bahani rin ne ubag kun natalu sikandan, wey namallahuy sikandan diye te disirtu. 16 Purisu migtalukunan sikandan te langun ne lukes te Ay taman te nakapariyu e sikandan te siyudad. 17 Ne puun su naamin langun migtalukun te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me lukes te Ay, sikan naa ka ware dan e nalekebi ka siyudad.

10 When next_day_came already, Huswi got_up early and he gathered his soldiers. Huswi and the leaders of Israil were the ones leading on their going to Ay. 11 And they arrived there in the place facing the city of Ay, and they camped there. This was in the north (LIT left_side) of the city. And there_was a valley that was in between of them and the Ay. 12 And there were five thousand (5,000) soldiers that Huswi sent_first that he caused_to_hide there at the other_side of the west, this was in between Ay and Bitil. 13 This was how Huswi set this soldiers: the many soldiers were there at near the city, on the north (LIT left_side), and the (ones) caused_to_hide there at the near of the back of the city, on the west (LIT sunset). When the evening_came already, Huswi and his companions went to the valley. 14 Upon seeing of the king of Ay with the descendants of Israil, he came_out right_away in the morning and all his soldiers in the city. They went to the place overlooking the valley of Hurdan in_order to fight with the descendants of Israil. They didn't know that there were ones_attacking them from the back of the city. 15 And Huswi pretended and all his warriors that they were_defeated, and they ran to the desert. 16 Therefore they were ran_after by all males of Ay until they were drawn_away from the city. 17 And since all the males of Ay ran_after the descendants of Israil, that's why they were_ not _able_to_close the city.

18 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Itinuru nu ka deldeg nu diye te Ay, su igbehey kud seini kaniyu.” Sikan naa ka intinuru e ni Huswi ka deldeg din diye te Ay. 19 Te pegtinuru ni Huswi te deldeg din, nanlihawang e ka me etew rin diye te inggelesan dan. Ne inlusuran dan e ka siyudad wey migdagdahawan dan seini te egsilab. 20 Miglilingey ka me matig-Ay, wey nakita ran ne mig-eebel e ka siyudad dan. Ne dutu, warad egkapallahuyan dan su migpalilibed man-e diye te kandan ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne immanalukunan dan diye te disirtu. 21 Su nakita ni Huswi wey te me etew ne migduma kandin ne nakalasud e ka me duma ran diye te siyudad, wey nasilaban dan e seini. Sikan naa ka migpalilibed e sikandan wey impangimatayan dan ka me matig-Ay. 22 Ne nanlihawang e seeye se me kabuhalan ni Israil ne miglasud te siyudad wey migbulig sikandan migpangimatey te me matig-Ay. Nalingutan dan ka me matig-Ay wey impangimatayan dan langun, wey warad iya nakapallahuy wey ke nasame naa. 23 Piru in-uyag dan ka Hari te Ay, wey in-uyan dan diye ki Huswi.

18 And the Lord God said to Huswi, “Point(sg) your(sg) spear there to Ay, because I will_give this to you(pl).” So then Huswi pointed his spear there to Ay. 19 On Huswi's pointing of his spear, his people came_out from where_ they _hid. And they attacked the city and they burnt it quickly. 20 The (ones) from_Ay looked_back, and they saw that their city was smoking. And there, they didn't have something_to_run_to because the descendants of Israil that they chased in the desert were turning_around to them. 21 Because Huswi and the people who went with him saw that their companions entered the city already, and they burned it already. That's why they turned_around and they killed the (ones) from_Ay. 22 And those descendants of Israil that entered the city came_out and they helped killing the (ones) from_Ay. They surrounded the (ones) from_Ay and they killed them_all, and no_(one) abled_to_run or left. 23 But they took_alive the king of Ay, and they brought (him) to Huswi.

24 Te naamin e neyimatayi te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka langun ne matig-Ay ne miglupug kandan diye te me kamet wey diye te disirtu, miglibed e sikandan diye te siyudad wey impangimatayan dan ka langun ne nasame diye. 25 Te seeye ne aldew, naamin neyimatayi ka langun ne matig-Ay—migginguma ka langun ne me lukes wey me malitan te sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000). 26 Ne migpabulus si Huswi ka migtinuru te deldeg din diye te Ay taman te neyimatayan e ka langun ne mahinged diye. 27 Ne impanguwa te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me ayam, wey me kasangkapan puun te siyudad sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Huswi. 28 Ne insilaban ni Huswi ka Ay wey warad seini nabalbalawi napasasindeg. Ne minsan kuntee warad mig-ugpe diye. 29 Ne inggimatayan ni Huswi ka Hari te Ay wey imbitin diye te kayu wey imbalahad din diye taman te naapunan. Te egkasagkup e, impaangey e ni Huswi ka minatey wey imparegpak din diye te lihawangan te gumawan te siyudad. Ne imbunbunan dan e seini te me batu, wey minsan kuntee egkakita red diye ka me batu.

24 When the descendants of Israil killed all the (ones) from_Ay who chased them in the fields and there in the desert, they returned to the city and they killed all left (ones) there. 25 On that day, the (ones) from_Ay were_ all _killed—all the men and women numbered (LIT reached) twelve thousand (12,000). 26 And Huswi continued pointing his spear to Ay until all the locals there were_killed. 27 And the descendants of Israil took the domestic_animals, and the possessions from the city according to what_ the Lord God _commanded to Huswi. 28 And Huswi burned Ay and this was not repaired to build. And even today no (one) lived there. 29 And Huswi killed the king of Ay and hung (it) on the tree and he abandoned (it) until the late_afternoon. When the sun_set, Huswi caused_ the body of the dead (one) _to_be_taken and caused_(it)_to_be_thrown outside the doorway of the city. And they covered this with stones, and even today the stone could_be_seen still there.

Ka pegbasa te Balaud diye te bubungan te Ibal

The reading of the Law there at the mountain of Ibal

30 [xr]Ne miggimu si Huswi te altar diye te bubungan te Ibal para te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil. 31 [xr]Inggimu rin seeye tenged te suhu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne nasulat te libru te Balaud ni Muwisis ne miggenendue, “Himuwi a te altar ne inggimu puun te batu ne ware nasapsapi te minsan nekey ne putew.” Ne diye te ampew te sika ne altar, migpanubad sikandan te igpanubad para te keupianan diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 32 Ne diye te tangkaan te me kabuhalan ni Israil, in-ikul sulata ni Huswi diye te me batu ka Balaud ne insulat ni Muwisis. 33 [xr]Ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil duma te igdatu dan, me upisyal ran, me talewukum dan wey ka seeye se me lapu ne mig-ugpe duma kandan, migsasindeg ne migpatangkeey. Nabaad sikandan te daruwa ne punduk, wey egkeinniyuhan te senge-punduk ka bubungan te Girisim, wey ka sabeka ne punduk, egkeinniyuhan dan ka Ibal. Ne diye te taliware dan migsasindeg ka me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun ne migyayung te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Naluhey e isuhu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Manama, ne eggimuwen dan seeye eyew te pegdawat te panalangin dan.

30 [xr]And Huswi made an altar there on the mountain of Ibal for the Lord the God of Israil. 31 [xr]He did it because of the command of Muwisis the servant of the Lord God there to the descendants of Israil that written in the book of Law of Muwisis saying, “Make me an altar made from stones that are_ not _trimmed by any iron.” And there at the top of that altar, they sacrificed a sacrifice for well-being/peace to the Lord God. 32 And there in front of the descendants of Israil, Huswi copied (LIT followed in writing) there on the stones the Law that Muwisis wrote. 33 [xr]All the descendants of Israil with their leaders, their officers, their judges and those foreigners that lived with them, stood facing_each_other. They were_divided into two groups, and the mountain of Girisim was at the back of one group, and the other group, mountain of Ibal was on their back. And the sacrificers who were descendants of Aarun were standing in their middle carrying_together the Container of the Agreement of the Lord God. Muwisis the servant of the God commanded (it), that they will_do it in_order for receiving their blessing.

34 Ne imbasa ni Huswi te meemen ka intiru ne Libru te Balaud, lagkes ka me panalangin wey ka me dilus ne nasulat. 35 Imbasa rin te tigsalimbeka ka me suhu ni Muwisis diye te tangkaan te me kabuhalan ni Israil, me malitan, me bate, wey te seeye se me lapu ne mig-ugpe duma kandan.

34 And Huswi read aloud the entire Book of Law, including the written blessings and the curses. 35 He read one_by_one the commands of Muwisis there in the front of the descendants of Israil, of women, children, and to those foreigners who lived among them.

Ka peg-akal te me matig-Gibyun ki Huswi

The betraying of the (ones) from_Gibyun towards Huswi

91 Ne narineg ka pegpanalu te me kabuhalan ni Israil te langun ne Hari ne nangugpe diye te marani te Weyig ne Hurdan, dapit te iglineb. Me Hari sikandan te Hitihanen, Amurihanen, Kanaanen, Pirisihanen, Hibihanen, wey Hibusihanen. Diye sikandan nangugpe te me bubungan, me napu diye te iglineb, wey diye te me ilis te Dahat ne Miditiranyu taman diye te Libanun. 2 Ne miglibulung sikandan langun ka egbubunu ki Huswi wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

91 And the victory of the descendants of Israil were heard by all kings that live there in the near of River Hurdan, in the west (LIT the other side of sunset). They were kings of the Hitihanons, Amurihanons, Kanaanons, Pirisihanons, Hibihanons, and Hibusihanons. They lived there on the mountains, plains in the west, and there at the edges of the Sea of Miditiranyu up_to Libanun. 2 And they gathered_together to fight with Huswi and the descendants of Israil.

3 Piru te pegkarineg te me matig-Gibyun meyitenged te neyimu ni Huswi diye te Hiriku wey te Ay, 4 nekegsabut sikandan ne eg-akalan dan si Huswi. Ne migsusuhu sikandan te me etew peendiye ki Huswi ne due me asnu ne indulanan te leddak ne me saku, te nahisi wey tinupakan ne me tahuanan te binu. 5 Ne migsaluub sikandan te leddak ne me kumbale, te leddak wey tinupakan ne me sandal. Ne iyan dan imbewu ka migkehal e wey nallupet e ne me paan. 6 Ne miggendiye sikandan ki Huswi diye te ingkekampuwan te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Gilgal. Ne ingkahiyan dan si Huswi wey ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Mariyu amana ka inged ne impuunan ney; igkeupii ney perem ne eggimu ki te kasabutan ne kene key nikaniyu eggilabetan.”

3 But when the (ones) from_Gibyun heard about what Huswi did in Hiriku and Ay, 4 they agreed that they trick Huswi. They sent people going_to Huswi with donkeys loaded with worn_out sacks, with torn and patched wine containers. 5 And they wore with worn_out cloths, with worn_out and patched sandals. And the bread that they made_provisions were dry and crumbled. 6 And they went to Huswi there where_ the descendants of Israil _camped there in Gilgal. And they told Huswi and the descendants of Israil, “The place where_ we(excl) _came_from is very far; we(excl) would like (wishful) that we(incl) make agreement that you(pl) won't interfere with us(excl).”

7 [xr]Piru migtabak ka me pangulu te Israil, “Mania te eggimu key te kasabutan kaniyu? Kema mule ke marani re kayi ka impuunan niyu.”

7 [xr]But the leaders of Israil answered, “Why are we(excl) making agreement with you(pl)? Maybe the place_where_you(pl)_came_from is just near from_here.”

8 Ne migpeyid-u-hid-u sikandan ki Huswi ne miggenendue, “Andam key ne egpasuluhuanen keykew.”

8 And they pleaded Huswi saying, “We(excl) are ready to become_ your(sg) _servants.”

Ne mig-insaan sikandan ni Huswi, “Hentew kew bes, wey hendei kew migpuun?”

And Huswi asked them, “Who are you(pl), and where do you(pl) come_from?”

9 Ne migtabak sikandan, “Mariyu amana ne inged ka impuunan ney. Miggendini key tenged su nabantuhan key te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. Narineg ney ka langun ne inggimu rin diye te Ihiptu. 10 [xr]Nanengnengan ney degma ka inggimu rin te daruwa ne Hari ne me Amurihanen diye te igsile te Hurdan, ne iyan si Sihun ne Hari te Hisbun, wey si Ug ne Hari te Basan ne mig-ugpe diye te Astarut. 11 Sikan naa ka ingkahiyan key te me igdatu ney, wey te langun ne mahinged te inged ney, ‘Andam kew te egkakeen niyu para te peggipanew niyu. Pakigkita kew te me kabuhalan ni Israil wey kahii niyu sikandan ne andam ki ne egkeyimu ne suluhuanen dan. Peyimuwa niyu sikandan te kasabutan ne kene ki nikandan eggilabetan.’ 12 Ne tengtengi niyu ka paan ney; meinit pad seini te pegligkat ney, piru kuntee, migkehal e wey nallupet e. 13 Tengtengi niyu man-e ka tinupakan ne me tahuanan te binu, iyam pad seini, piru kuntee, nabindas e. Nalledak e degma ka me kumbale ney wey ka me sandal ney tenged te mariyu amana ne inged ka impuunan ney.”

9 And they answered, “The place where_ we(excl) _came_from is very far. We(excl) came_here because the Lord your(pl) God became_famous to us(excl). We(excl) heard all that he did there in Ihiptu. 10 [xr]We(excl) also heard what_ he _did to the two Amurihanon kings there in the east of Hurdan, who were Sihun the king of Hisbun, and Ug the king of Basan who lived there in Astarut. 11 So then we(excl) were_told by our(excl) leaders, and of all locals in our(excl) place, ‘Prepare(pl) your(pl) food for your(pl) journey. Meet(pl) the descendants of Israil and tell(pl) them that we(excl) ready to become their servants. Let_ them _make(pl) a agreement that they won't interfere with us(incl).’ 12 And look(pl) at our(excl) bread; this was still hot when we(excl) left, but now, (it) became_dry and crumbled. 13 Look(pl) at also our(excl) patched wine containers, this was new, but now, (it) worn_out. Our(excl) cloths worn_out already as_well and our(excl) sandals because the place where_ we(excl) _came_from is very far.”

14 Ne inggeraman te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka pegkeen dan ke malehet naan iya ne naluhey e, piru ware sikandan nekeinse te Magbebaye ne Manama. 15 Ne miggimu si Huswi te kasabutan ne kene din eggilabetan sikandan wey ke eggimatayan naa. Ne impahunlibetan seini te me pangulu te Israil.

14 And the descendants of Israil tasted their food if it was truly old, but they weren't able_to_ask the Lord God. 15 And Huswi made an agreement that he won't interfere with them or kill (them). And the leaders of Israil swore to it.

16 Te peglihad te tatelu ne aldew puun te peggimu ran te kasabutan, natahaan te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne marani bes de ka nangugpaan te seeye ne me etew. 17 Purisu, nangipanew ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, wey te igkatelu ne aldew, nekeume e sikandan diye te me siyudad ne nangugpaan te seeye ne me etew. Me siyudad seini te Gibyun, Kipira, Biirut, wey Kiryat-Hiyarim. 18 Piru kene egkaayun ne egpangimatayan dan ka me etew diye su nakapahunlibet ma ka me pangulu te Israil diye te kandan te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil.

16 After three days from their making of agreement, the descendants of Israil learned that the home_place of those people was just near. 17 Therefore, the descendants of Israil went, and on the third day, they arrived at the cities resided by those people. These were cities of Gibyun, Kipira, Biirut, and Kiryat-Hirayim. 18 But it's_ not _possible for them to kill the people there because the leaders of Israil sworn to them in the name of the Lord God of Israil.

Ne migsagsahukul ka me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te me pangulu ran.19 Piru migtabak ka me pangulu, “Due kasabutan ne napahunlibetan ney kandan pinaahi te ngaran te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, sikan naa ka kene ta egkeyilabetan sikandan. 20 Seini naan de ka eggimuwen ta kandan: kene ta sikandan eggimatayan eyew kene ki egparusaan tenged te pegpahunlibet ta kandan. 21 Balahara niyu re due sikandan ne egkeuyag. Piru eggimuwen ta sikandan ne me talagtempug te kayu, wey talagsakug te weyig kayi te kanta.” Ne natuman iya diye te me Gibihanen ka inlalag te me pangulu.

And the descendants of Israil complained to their leaders.19 But the leaders answered, “There's a agreement that we(excl) had sworn with them by the name of the Lord, the God of Israil, that's why we(incl) can't destroy them. 20 This is only what we(incl) can do to them: we(incl) will_ not _kill them so_that we(incl) won't be_punished because of our(incl) swearing to them. 21 Just ignore them living. But we(incl) will_make them cutters of tree, and drawers of water here for us(excl).” And what_ the leaders _said happened to the Gibihanons.

22 Ne impeumew ni Huswi ka me Gibihanen wey ingkahiyan din, “Mania te in-akalan key nikaniyu? Mania te migkahi kew ne mariyu ka impuunan niyu, ne marani bes de kayi te kanami ka ugpaan niyu? 23 Tenged su inggimu niyu seini, egdilusen kew te Manama. Puun kuntee, me suluhuanen kew e ne me talagtempug te kayu wey talagsakug te weyig para te balungbalung te Magbebaye ne Manama ku.”

22 And Huswi summoned the Gibihanons and he told (them), “Why did you(pl) betray us(excl)? Why did you(pl) say that the place_where_ you(pl) _came_from was far, when your(pl) place is near us(excl)? 23 Since you(pl) did this, God will_curse you(pl). From now, you(pl) will_be_servants who will_cut trees and drawers of water for the tent of my Lord God.”
