24 Ne migtabak sikandan ki Huswi, “Uya su nanengnengan ney iya ne insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu si Muwisis ne suluhuanen din ne igbehey kaniyu ka seini ne inged, wey egpangimatayan ka langun ne mahinged kayi te peglusud niyu. Ahalen neyimu ney seeye su naaldek key ne eggimatayan key nikaniyu. 25 Ne kuntee, suluhuanen key e nikeykew. Sikeykew e ka mateu ke nekey ka eggimuwen nu kayi te kanami ne insuman-suman nu ne eleg wey meupiya.” 26 Sikan naa ka impangabangan sikandan ni Huswi wey ware din sikandan peyimatayi te me kabuhalan ni Israil. 27 Ke kene, inggimu rin sikandan ne me suluhuanen ne talagtempug te kayu wey talagsakug te weyig para te me kabuhalan ni Israil, wey diye te altar te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne minsan kuntee, inggimu ran ded seini diye te inged ne in-alam te Manama.

24 And they answered Huswi, “Yes because we(excl) truly knew that the Lord your(pl) God commanded Muwisis his servant to give this land/place to you(pl), and all the locals here will_be_called on your(pl) attack. Master we(excl) did it because we(excl) were_afraid to be_killed by you(pl). 25 And now, we(excl) are now your(sg) servants. It's up to you(sg) to decide what's you(sg) will_do here to us(excl) which you(sg) think that's correct and good.” 26 So then Huswi helped them and he did not cause_ them _to_be_killed by the descendants of Israil. 27 But rather, he made them servants who cut trees and drawers of water for the descendants of Israil, and for the altar of the Lord God. And even today/now, they did it still in the place chosen by God.

Ka pegkatalu te me Amurihanen

The defeat of the Amurihanons

101 Ne narineg ni Aduni-Sidik ne Hari te Hirusalim ka guhuren ne naahew ni Huswi ka Ay wey indereetan din iya seini, wey inggimatayan din ka Hari diye iling te inggimu rin te Hiriku wey te Hari diye. Ne narineg degma ni Aduni-Sidik ka guhuren ne migpakigsabeka ka me matig-Gibyun kandan, wey miglemung e kandan. 2 Naaldek amana sikandin, wey ka me mahinged te Hirusalim su natahaan din ne maresen ne siyudad ka Gibyun, wey due degma Hari kayi. Ne dakel pad seini te Ay, wey mabbulut ka me sundalu. 3 Sikan naa ka impabayaan ni Aduni-Sidik ne Hari te Hirusalim si Huham ne Hari te Hibrun, si Piram ne Hari te Harmut, si Hapya ne Hari te Lakis, wey si Dibir ne Hari te Iglun. 4 Ne impanagtahaan din sikandan te seini, “Hendini kew wey bulihi a; eglusuran ta ka Gibyun su migpakigsabeke e sikandan ki Huswi wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil.” 5 Purisu, migsabeka ka seini se lalimma ne Hari: ka Hari te Hirusalim, Hibrun, Harmut, Lakis wey Iglun. Ne inlibulung dan ka me sundalu ran wey inlusuran dan e ka Gibyun.

101 And Aduni-Sidik the king of Hirusalim heard the story that Huswi snatched Ay and he truly destroyed it, and he killed the king there just like what_ he _did in Hiriku and its king. And Aduni-Sidik also heard the story that the (ones) from_Gibyun united with them, and lived_among with them. 2 He was very afraid, and the locals of Hirusalim because he knew that Gibyun was a powerful city, and there's also a king of it. And this was bigger than Ay, and the soldiers were brave. 3 So then Aduni-Sidik the king of Hirusalim caused_ Huham the king of Hibrun, Piram the king of Harmut, Hapya the king of Lakis, and Dibir the king of Iglun _to_be_visited. 4 Then he sent this message to them, “Come_here(pl) and help me; we(incl) will_attack Gibyun because they united with Huswi and the descendants of Israil.” 5 Therefore, these five kings united_each_other: the king of Hirusalim, Hibrun, Harmut, Lakis and Iglun. And they gathered their soldiers and they attacked Gibyun.

6 Ne impabayaan te me matig-Gibyun si Huswi diye te kampu ran diye te Gilgal, wey impakahiyan, “Kene key balahara nikeykew se me suluhuanen nu. Dagdahew kew hendini wey luwasa key nikaniyu. Bulihi key su migsabekaan key lusuri te langun ne Hari ne me Amurihanen ne nangugpe diye te me bubungan.” 7 Purisu, migligkat e puun te Gilgal si Huswi wey ka langun ne sundalu rin, lagkes seeye se langun ne me bahani. 8 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Kene ka kaaldek kandan, impatalu kud sikandan keykew. Ware minsan sabeka kandan ne egpakatalu keykew.”

6 And Huswi was caused_to_be_visited by the (ones) from_Gibyun there in their camp in Gilgal, and being told, “Don't abandon us(excl) your(sg) servants. Come_here(pl) quickly and save(pl) us(excl). Help us(excl) because we(excl) are attacked unitedly by all the kings of Amurihanons who lived there on the mountains.” 7 Therefore, Huswi and all his soldiers departed Gilgal, including those all warriors. 8 And Huswi as told by the Lord God, “Don't(sg) be_afraid with them, I caused_ them _to_be_defeated by you(sg) already. Not even one of them can_defeat you(sg).”

9 Ne miggipanew puun te Gilgal si Huswi wey ka me duma rin te intiru ne marusilem, wey intigkew ran lusuri ka me kuntere dan. 10 Ne impaliyasan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me kuntere te pegkakita ran te me kabuhalan ni Israil. Ne impangimatayan te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me kuntere dan diye te Gibyun. Ne impanalukunan dan ka duma diye te dalan patakereg te bubungan te Bit-Hurun taman te Asika wey Makida. 11 Taheed te impanalukunan te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me kuntere dan diye te Bit-Hurun peendiye te Asika, impeuranan e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me kuntere dan te derakel ne me batu[fn] wey nammatey e sikandan. Masulug pad ka nammatey tenged te me batu du te neyimatayan te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

9 And Huswi and his company walked from Gilgal for the entire evening, and they attacked their enemies suddenly. 10 And the Lord God caused_ the enemies _to_be_afraid when their seeing of the descendants of Israil. And the descendants of Israil killed their enemies there in Gibyun. And they chased others there on the road going_up the mountain of Bit-Hurun until Asika and Makida. 11 While the descendants of Israil chased their enemies there in Bit-Hurun going_to Asika, the Lord God caused_them_to_be_rained by large stones[fn] and they died. Many died because of the stones than being killed by the descendants of Israil.

12 Ne mig-ampu si Huswi te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te tangkaan te me kabuhalan ni Israil, te timpu te impatalu te Magbebaye te me Israilita ka me Amunihanen. Miggenendue sikandin:

12 And Huswi prayed to the Lord God there in front of the descendants of Israil, at the time that God caused_ the Amonihanons _to_be_defeated by the Israilitas. He went_like_this:

“Sanggel ka aldew diye te lenged te Gibyun,

“Sun stop there near at Gibyun,

wey sanggel ka bulan diye te ampew te napu te Ayalun.”

and moon stop there on top of the plain of Ayalun.”

13 [xr]Ne migsanggel ka aldew wey ka bulan taman te natalu e te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me kuntere dan. Nasulat ka seini ne neyitabu diye te libru te Hasar. Migsanggel ka aldew diye te elat-elat te langit, wey ware seini miglineb te intiru ne aldew. 14 Ware de due neyitabu ne iling kayi ne egpalintutuu ka Magbebaye ne Manama te etew, wey migpakigbunu para te kabuhalan ni Israil.

13 [xr]And the sun and moon stopped until the descendants of Israil defeated their enemies. This event was_written there in the book of Hasar. The sun stopped there in the middle of the sky, and it didn't set on the entire day. 14 Nothing has happened like this that the Lord God obey a person, and fought for descendants of Israil.

15 Nataman, miglibed e si Huswi wey ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te kampu ran te Gilgal.

15 Then, Huswi and all the descendants of Israil returned to there camp in Gilgal.

Ka pegdakep te lalimma ne Hari ne me Amurihanen

The capturing of the five kings of Amurihanons

16 Ne nakapallahuy ka lalimma ne Hari wey nekeeles sikandan diye te sulung te Makida. 17 Piru due nakakita ne nangeles sikandan diye te sulung, wey ingguhuran e si Huswi ke hendei sikandan nangeles. 18 Purisu, migkahi si Huswi, “Bunbuni niyu ka be-be te sulung te derakel ne batu wey bantayi niyu seini. 19 Piru kene kew uugpe diye. Lupuha niyu ka me kuntere niyu wey pasampayi niyu sikandan eyew kene egpakalasud diye te siyudad dan. Su impatalu e sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu.” 20 Ne inggule pangimatayi ni Huswi wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me kuntere dan. Piru due duma ne nakapallahuy wey nakaseled diye te me siyudad ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu. 21 Ne miglibed ka langun ne sundalu diye ki Huswi diye te kampu te Makida.

16 And the five kings were able_to_flee and they hid there in the cave of Makida. 17 But there's someone_saw that they hid there in the cave, and Huswi was told where they hid. 18 Therefore, Huswi said, “Cover(pl) the mouth of the cave with large stones and guard(pl) it. 19 But don't remain there. Chase(pl) your(pl) enemies and block_them_across(pl) so_that (they) can't enter there in their city. Because the Lord your(pl) God caused_ them _to_be_defeated already.” 20 And Huswi and the descendants of Israil exterminated killing their enemies. But there were some that able_to_run and entered there in the cities fenced with high and thick stones. 21 And all soldiers returned to Huswi there in the camp of Makida.

Puun te seeye ne timpu, warad egpaalag-alag ne eglelalis te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

From that time, nobody dared to challenge_to_fight with the descendants of Israil.

22 Ne migkahi si Huswi, “Lukati niyu ka sulung wey uyana niyu kayi te keddi ka lalimma ne Hari.” 23 Purisu, impalihawang dan te sulung ka lalimma ne Hari: ka Hari te Hirusalim, Hibrun, Harmut, Lakis, wey Iglun. 24 Te diyad e te tangkaan ni Huswi ka lalimma ne Hari, inlibulung din e ka langun ne me pangulu te Israil wey ingkahiyan din ka me pangulu te me sundalu rin ne migduma kandin, “Hendini kew, wey dieki niyu ka lieg[fn] te seini ne me Hari.” Sikan naa ka migparani sikandan wey indiekan dan ka lieg te me Hari. 25 Ne ingkahiyan sikandan ni Huswi, “Kene kew kaaldek wey ke egmahuye naa. Pakannekal kew wey kene kew duwa-ruwa su iling kayi ka eggimuwen te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te langun ne kuntere niyu.” 26 Ne nangimatayan ni Huswi ka lalimma ne Hari, wey imbitin din sikandan diye te lalimma ne me kayu, wey imbalahad din diye taman te naapunan. 27 Te peglineb e te aldew, impakuwe e ni Huswi ka me minatey wey imparegpak din diye te sulung ne inggelesan dan. Ne impabunbunan din te derakel ne me batu ka be-be te sulung. Ne minsan kuntee, diye ded ka me batu.

22 And Huswi said, “Open(pl) the cave and bring(pl) to me the five kings.” 23 Therefore, they caused_ the five kings _to_come_out the cave: the king of Hirusalim, Hibrun, Harmut, Lakis, and Iglun. 24 When the five kings were in the front of Huswi, he gathered all the leaders of Israil and he told the leaders of his soldiers that accompanied him, “Come_here(pl), and tread on the neck[fn] of these kings.” That's why they came_near and they trod on the neck of the kings. 25 And Huswi told them, “Don't be_afraid(pl) or become_weak either. Be_strong(pl) and don't waver(pl) because something_like this is what the Lord God will_do to all your(pl) enemies.” 26 And Huswi killed the five kings, and he hung them on the five trees, and abandon them there until the sun_set. 27 When the sun was setting, Huswi caused_ the body of the corpses _to_be_taken_away and be_thrown there in cave where_ they _hid. And he caused_ the mouth of the cave _to_be_covered by large stones. And even today, the stones are still there.

Ka peglusud enni Huswi te duma ne me Amurihanen

The attacking of other Amurihanons by Huswi and_company

28 Te seeye ded ne aldew, insakup ni Huswi ka Makida. Inggule din pangimatayi ka langun ne mahinged, lagkes ka Hari dan. Warad iya nasame ne neuyag. Ne inggimatayan ni Huswi ka Hari te Makida iling te inggimu rin te Hari te Hiriku.

28 On that day itself, Huswi put_ Makida _under_his_jurisdiction. He exterminated killing the local_inhabitants, including their king. No (one) indeed was_left alive. And Huswi killed the king of Makida like what he did with the king of Hiriku.

29 Nataman, migligkat si Huswi wey ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Makida wey migpabulus diye te Libna, wey inlusuran dan seeye. 30 Ne impatalu e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka seeye ne siyudad wey ka Hari dan. Impangimatayan dan ka langun ne mahinged, wey warad iya nasame ne neuyag. Ne inggimatayan ni Huswi ka Hari te Libna iling te inggimu rin te Hari te Hiriku.

29 Then, Huswi departed Makida and all the descendants of Israil and continued to Libna, and they attacked it. 30 And the Lord God caused_ that city again _to_be_defeated by the descendants of Israil and their king. They killed all the local_inhabitants, and no remainder indeed left alive. And Huswi killed the king of Libna like what he did of the king of Hiriku.

31 Nataman, migligkat e man-e si Huswi wey ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Libna wey migpabulus diye te Lakis. Ne inlingutan dan seini wey inlusuran dan. 32 Ne impatalu te Magbebaye ne Manama te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka Lakis te igkarangeb ne aldew te gira. Ne impangimatayan dan ka langun ne mahinged te Lakis iling te inggimu ran diye te Libna. 33 Te sasangan pad sikandan ne eglusud te Lakis, migginguma si Huram ne Hari te Gisir wey ka me sundalu rin ka egpangabang te Lakis. Piru natalu red sikandan ni Huswi, wey impangimatayan sikandan langun.

31 Then, Huswi and all the descendants of Israil departed again from Libna and continued there to Lakis. And they surrounded it and they attacked (it). 32 And the Lord God gave_defeat to Lakis by the descendants of Israil on the second day of war. And they killed all the locals of Lakis like what_was_done by_them there at Libna. 33 While they were_ still _attacking Lakis, Huram the king of Gisir and his soldiers arrived to_help/rescue Lakis. But they just were_defeated by Huswi, and they all were_killed(pl).

34 Nataman, migligkat e man-e si Huswi wey ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Lakis wey migpabulus diye te Iglun. Ne inlingutan dan seini wey inlusuran dan. 35 Te seeye ne aldew, nasakup dan ka Iglun wey inggule dan pangimatayi ka langun ne mahinged diye iling te inggimu ran diye te Lakis.

34 Then, Huswi and all the descendants of Israil there at Lakis left again and continued there to Iglun. And they surrounded it and they attacked (it). 35 On that day, they made_ Iglun _under_ their _jurisdiction and they exterminated killing all the locals there like what_was_done by_them there at Lakis.

36 Nataman, migligkat e man-e si Huswi wey ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Iglun wey migpabulus diye te Hibrun wey inlusuran dan seini. 37 Ne in-ahew ran ka siyudad, wey inggimatayan dan ka Hari wey ka langun ne mahinged kayi. Ne inlagkes dan pangimatayi ka me mahinged te nakalingut ne me siyudad. Ne warad iya nasame ne neuyag. Indereetan dan iya ka intiru ne siyudad iling te inggimu ran diye te Iglun.

36 Then, Huswi and all the descendants of Israil left there at Iglun again and continued there to Hibrun and they attacked it. 37 And they snatched the city, and they killed the king and all the locals here. And they included in killing(pl) the locals in surrounding cities. And they were_none remaining indeed that were_alive. They indeed destroyed the entire city like what_was_done by_them there at Iglun.

38 Nataman, miggendiye si Huswi wey ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Dibir, wey inlusuran dan seini. 39 Ne in-ahew ran ka siyudad wey ka Hari kayi lagkes ka langun ne lungsud ne nakalingut kayi. Inggimatayan dan ka langun ne mahinged diye. Ne warad iya nasame ne neuyag. Ne ke nekey ka inggimu ran diye te Hibrun wey te Libna wey te me Hari diye, sikan ded degma ka inggimu ran diye te Dibir wey te Hari kayi.

38 Then, Huswi and all the (ones) from_Israil went there to Dibir, and they attacked it. 39 And they snatched the city and the king included all the towns surrounded it. They killed all the locals there. And there were_none remaining indeed that were_alive. And what_was_done by_them there at Hibrun and all Libna and to the kings there, just that also was_done by_them there at Dibir and to the king there.

40 Insakup ni Huswi ka intiru ne inged: ka me bubungan, ka inged te Nigib, ka me napu diye te iglineb, ka inged diye te me kalandihan wey ka me Hari te seeye ne me inged. Inggule pangimatayi ni Huswi ka langun ne mahinged diye, wey warad iya neuyag ne nasame. Inggimu ran seini su intuman dan ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil. 41 Indereetan ni Huswi ka me inged puun te Kadis-Barniya taman diye te Gasa, wey puun te intiru ne inged te Gusin taman diye te Gibyun. 42 Ne nasakup ni Huswi ka seeye ne me inged wey ka me Hari kayi te kasabeka re ne peglusud, puun su imbulihan ma sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama te pegpakiggira ran. 43 Nataman, miglibed e si Huswi wey ka langun ne me pangulu te Israil diye te kampu ran diye te Gilgal.

40 Huswi made_ the entire place _under_ (his) _jurisdiction: the mountains, the place of Nigib, the plains there on the west, the place there at slopes and the kings of those places. Huswi exterminated killing all the locals there, and indeed there_were_none remaining. They did this because they obeyed what_was_commanded by the Lord God, the God of Israil. 41 Huswi destroyed the places from Kadis-Barniya until Gasa, and from the entire place of Gusin until Gibyun. 42 And those places and their kings came_under_the_jurisdiction of Huswi in just a one_off attack, because they were_helped by the Lord God in their warring. 43 Then, Huswi and all the leaders of Israil returned there to their camp there at Gilgal.

Ka peglusud enni Huswi engki Hari Habin

The attacking of King Habin by Huswi (and_company)

111 Te narineg ni Habin ne Hari te Hasur ka guhuren ne migpanalu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, migpanahe e sikandin te me Hari ne ensi Hubab ne Hari te Madun, me Hari te Simrun wey te Aksap, 2 me Hari diye te bubungan ne diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile, me Hari diye te napu te Hurdan ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te Lanew ne Galiliya,[fn] me Hari diye te me napu, wey me Hari diye te ilis te Dur te iglineb. 3 Ne impataha rin man-e ka me Hari te me Kanaanen diye te igsile wey iglineb te Weyig ne Hurdan, ka me Hari te me Amurihanen, ka me Hari te me Hitihanen, ka me Hari te me Pirisihanen, ka me Hari te me Hibusihanen ne nangugpe diye te me bubungan, wey ka me Hari te me Hibihanen ne nangugpe diye te diralem te Bubungan ne Hirmun diye te inged te Mispa. 4 Ne nanginguma ka seeye ne me Hari lagkes ka me sundalu ran, ne iling sikandan kasulug te lelanek ne diye te ilis te dahat. Ne amana ne masulug ka me kudde dan wey me karwahi ran. 5 Nasabeka ka seeye ne me Hari wey migkekampu sikandan diye te ilis te Weyig ne Mirum eyew egbubunu te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

111 When Habin the king of Hasur heard the story that the descendants of Israil were_victorious, he sent_a_message to the kings who were Hubab the king of Madun, kings of Simrun and of Aksap, 2 the kings there in the mountains in the north (LIT left_side), the kings there in the valley of Hurdan in the south (LIT right of line facing east) of the Lake of Galiliya,[fn] the kings there in the plains, and the kings there at the edge of Dur in the west. 3 And he made_known also the kings of the Kanaanons there in the east and in the west of Hurdan River, the kings of the Amurihanons, the kings of the Hitihanons, the kings of the Pirisihanons, the kings of the Hibusihanons who lived there in the mountains, and the kings of the Hibihanons who lived there in the Mountains of Hirmun there in the place of Mispa. 4 And those kings arrived including their soldiers, and they are as many as the sand there in the shore of the sea. And their horses and chariots are very many. 5 Those kings were united and they camped there at the shore of the Mirum River in_order to fight_against the descendants of Israil.

6 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, “Kene ka kaaldek su igpatalu ku sikandan keykew kaaselem iling te seini ne uras. Lepui niyu ka me kudde dan, wey silabi niyu ka me karwahi ran.” 7 Sikan naa ka intigkew lusuri ni Huswi wey te me sundalu rin ka me kuntere dan diye te Weyig ne Mirum. 8 Ne impatalu te Magbebaye ne Manama te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me kuntere dan. Impanalukunan dan ka me kuntere dan taman diye te Mabantug ne Sidun wey Misriput-Maim taman diye te napu te Mispa te igsile. Ne inggule dan pangimatayi ka me kuntere dan. 9 Inggimu ni Huswi kandan ka impeyimu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Impanlepuan din ka me kudde dan wey impanilaban din ka me karwahi ran.

6 And the Lord God said to Huswi, “Don't(sg) be_afraid because I will_cause_ them _to_be_defeated by you(sg) tomorrow like this hour. Lame(pl) their horses, and burn(pl) their chariots.” 7 So then Huswi and his soldiers attacked their enemies suddenly there in the Mirum River. 8 And the Lord God caused_ the descendants of Israil _to_defeat their enemies. They chased their enemies until there in the Great Sidun and Misriput-Maim until there at the valley of Mispa in the east. And they exterminated killing their enemies. 9 Huswi did to them what the Lord God caused_to_be_done. He lamed their horses and burned their chariots.

10 Nataman, miggendiyad si Huswi wey ka me duma rin wey in-ahew ran ka Hasur, wey inggimatayan dan ka Hari kayi. Te seeye ne timpu, iyan maresen ne inged ka Hasur te langun ne migharian. 11 Inggule dan degma pangimatayi ka langun ne mahinged te Hasur, ne warad iya neuyag ne nasame. Ne insilaban dan ka siyudad.

10 Afterwards, Huswi went and his companions and seized(pl) Hasur, and killed(pl) the king of it. At that time, Hasur was the powerful place of all the kingdoms. 11 They killed completely all the inhabitants of Hasur, and no remainder indeed was_alive. And they burned the city.

12 Ne naahew ni Huswi ka langun ne siyudad. Inggule dan pangimatayi ka langun ne mahinged lagkes ka me Hari diye. Neyitabu seini pinaahi te suhu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama. 13 Piru ware panilabi te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me siyudad ne diye neyimu te nahuhus ne me siyudad, angin e te Hasur ne insilaban mule ni Huswi. 14 Impanguwa te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka langun ne kasangkapan wey me ayam te seeye ne me siyudad. Piru inggule dan pangimatayi ka langun ne mahinged diye, wey warad iya neuyag ne nasame. 15 Seeye ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis, wey insuhu din e degma ki Huswi. Ne intuman ni Huswi ka langun ne insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis.

12 And Huswi seized all the cities. They killed completely all the inhabitants including the kings there. This happened by_means of the command of Muwisis the servant of the Lord God. 13 But the descendants of Israil did not burn the cities that were built there in the broken cities, except for Hasur that Huswi burned on_the_contrary. 14 The descendants of Israil took all the materials and the animals in those cities. But they killed completely all the inhabitants there, and there was indeed no (one) indeed left alive. 15 That was the command of the Lord God to Muwisis, and he commanded it to Huswi also. And Huswi obeyed all the command(s) of the Lord God to Muwisis.

Ka pegkaangken ni Huswi te langun ne tane

The possesing of all the lands by Huswi

16 Naahew ni Huswi ka intiru ne inged: ka me bubungan, ka intiru ne inged te Nigib, ka intiru ne inged te Gusin, ka me napu diye te iglineb, ka bangalug te Hurdan, ka me bubungan wey napu te Israil. 17-18 Ka inged ne nasakup te me kabuhalan ni Israil, migbunsud te bubungan te Halak patakereg te Siir taman diye te Baal-Gad. Diye seini te napu te Libanun ne diye te lenlen te Bubungan ne Hirmun. Naluhey ka pegpakigbunu ni Huswi te me Hari te seini ne me inged. Impandakep ni Huswi ka me Hari te seeye ne me inged, wey impangimatayan din sikandan. 19 Ne warad siyudad ne migpakigsabeka te me kabuhalan ni Israil angin e te me Hibihanen ne mig-ugpe diye te Gibyun. Ne natalu te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka langun te pegpakiggira ran. 20 [xr]Tenged su impakehal te Magbebaye ne Manama ka ulu[fn] te me kuntere dan eyew egbubunu kandan. Ne te seini ne paahi, inggule dan pangimatayi ka me kuntere dan te ware pegkeyid-u sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis.

16 Huswi possessed the entire place(s): the mountains, the entire place of Nigib, the entire place of Gusin, the valleys there in the west, the valley of Hurdan, the mountains and valleys of Israil. 17-18 The place that became under_the_jurisdiction of the descendants of Israil, started from the mountain of Halak going_up to Siir until there at Baal-Gad. This was in the valley of Libanun there at the foot of Mount Hirmun. The fighting of Huswi was long against the kings of these places. Huswi seized the kings of those places, and he killed them. 19 And no_longer city that united with the descendants of Israil except for the Hibihanons that lived there in Gibyun. And the descendants of Israil defeated the all in their warring. 20 [xr]Because the Lord God hardened the head[fn] of their enemies in_order to fight against them. And in this way, they have killed completely their enemies without mercy according to the command of the Lord God to Muwisis.

21 Te seeye ded ne timpu, inlusuran ni Huswi ka me Anakanhen ne nangugpe diye te me bubungan te Hibrun, Dibir, Anab, wey langun ne bubungan te Huda wey te Israil. Indereetan en iya sikandan ni Huswi, wey ka me siyudad dan. 22 Ne warad nasame ne me Anakanhen diye te inged te me kabuhalan ni Israil, piru duen pad duma ne nasame diye te Gasa, Gat, wey Asdud.

21 On that same time, Huswi attacked the Anakanhon that lived there in the mountains of Hibrun, Dibir, Anab, and all the mountains of Huda and Israil. Huswi destroyed them completely, and their cities. 22 And no Anakanhon was left there in the places of the descendants of Israil, but there were others left in Gasa, Gat, and Asdud.

23 Naahew ni Huswi ka intiru ne inged sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis. Ne impamehey seini ni Huswi diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan, wey imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse tribu.

23 Huswi conquered the entire place according to the command of the Lord God to Muwisis. And Huswi gave it to the descendants of Israil as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to them, and this was_divided by each tribe.

Te seeye ne timpu, warad e samuk te seeye ne inged.

At that time, there was no fighting in that place.

Ka me Hari ne natalu ni Muwisis

The kings defeated by Muwisis

121-2 [xr]Ne nasakup e te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me inged diye te igsile te Hurdan, bunsud seini te bangalug te Arnun peendiye te Bubungan ne Hirmun, nalagkes e kayi ka inged diye te igsile te Araba. Ne seini ka me Hari te seeye ne me inged ne natalu te me kabuhalan ni Israil:

121-2 [xr]And the descendants of Israil conquered the places there in the east of Hurdan, from the valley of Arnun to Mount Hirmun, including here the place there in the east of Araba. And these were the kings of those places that were_defeated by the descendants of Israil:

Si Sihun ne Hari te me Amurihanen ne mig-ugpe diye te Hisbun. Nasakup te migharian din ka katenge te Gilyad, bunsud seini te Aruwir ne dangdang te bangalug te Armun wey bunsud te taliware te bangalug taman diye te Weyig te Habuk, ka eletanan te me Amunihanen.3 Nasakup din pad man-e ka diye te igsile te bangalug te Hurdan, bunsud te Lanew te Galiliya[fn] peendiye te Bit-Hisimut taman diye te igsile te Namatey ne Dahat, wey peendiye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te Bubungan ne Pisga.

Sihun the king of the Amurihanon who lived there in Hisbun. His kingdom covered half of Gilyad, from Aruwir beside the valley of Armun and from the middle of the valley until to the Habuk River, the boundary of the Amunihanons.3 The ones there in the east of valley of Hurdan became_under_ his _jurisdiction, from the Lake of Galiliya[fn] to Bit-Hisimut until there in the east of Dead Sea, and to the south (LIT right side) of the Mount Pisga.

4 Ne si Ug ne Hari te Basan ka igkarangeb ne natalu te me kabuhalan ni Israil. Sikandin dengan ka nasame te kabuhalan ni Ripaim ne mig-ugpe diye te Astarut wey te Idrii. 5 Ne nasakup te migharian din ka Bubungan ne Hirmun, Silika, intiru ne Basan peendiye te eletanan te Gisur wey te Maaka, wey ka katenge te Gilyad taman diye te eletanan te Hisbun ne migharian ni Sihun.

4 And Ug the king of Basan was the second_one that's defeated by the descendants of Israil. He (was) the one remaining ago of the descendant of Ripaim who lived there in Astarut and Idrii. 5 And his kingdom covered the Mount of Hirmun, Silika, the entire Basan to the boundary of Gisur and Maaka, and half of Gilyad until to the boundary of Hisbun ruled by Sihun.

6 [xr]Ne natalu sikandan te me kabuhalan ni Israil wey ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne imbehey ni Muwisis ka inged dan diye te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, ni Gad, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis[fn] eyew egkakandan e.

6 [xr]And they were_defeated by the descendants of Israil and of Muwisis who was the servant of the Lord God. And Muwisis gave their place to the tribes of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendant/s of Manasis[fn] in_order for them to possess_as_theirs.

Ka me Hari ne natalu ni Huswi

The kings defeated by Huswi

7-8 Ne nasakup degma ni Huswi wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka inged diye te iglineb te Weyig ne Hurdan, bunsud seeye te Baal-Gad diye te napu te Libanun taman diye te Bubungan ne Halak peendiye te Siir. Ne imbehey ni Huswi ka inged diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil eyew egkakandan e. Imbaad-baad din seeye diye te tagse tribu. Nalagkes te seeye ne inged ka me bubungan, me napu diye te iglineb, ka bangalug te Hurdan, ka kalandihan te me bubungan, ka disirtu, wey ka inged te Nigib. Sika ne me inged ka nangugpaan dengan te me Hitihanen, me Amurihanen, me Kanaanen, me Pirisihanen, me Hibihanen, wey me Hibusihanen. Ne seini ka me Hari te seeye ne me inged ne natalu ni Huswi wey te me kabuhalan ni Israil: 9 ka Hari te Hiriku, ka Hari te Ay ne marani te Bitil, 10 ka Hari te Hirusalim, ka Hari te Hibrun, 11 ka Hari te Harmut, ka Hari te Lakis, 12 ka Hari te Iglun, ka Hari te Gisir, 13 ka Hari te Dibir, ka Hari te Gidir, 14 ka Hari te Hurma, ka Hari te Arad, 15 ka Hari te Libna, ka Hari te Adulam, 16 ka Hari te Makida, ka Hari te Bitil, 17 ka Hari te Tapuwa, ka Hari te Hipir, 18 ka Hari te Apik, ka Hari te Lasarun, 19 ka Hari te Madun, ka Hari te Hasur, 20 ka Hari te Simrun-Mirun, ka Hari te Aksap, 21 ka Hari te Taanak, ka Hari te Migidu, 22 ka Hari te Kadis, ka Hari te Hukni-Am ne diye te Karmil, 23 ka Hari te Dur ne diye te ilis te dahat, ka Hari te Guyim ne diye te Galiliya,[fn] 24 wey ka Hari te Tirsa. Migginguma ka langun ne Hari te tatelu ne pulu wey sabeka (31).

7-8 And Huswi and the descendants of Israil also covered/conquered the place there at the west of the Hurdan River, from Baal-Gad there in the valley of Libanun until there to the Mount of Halak from Siir. And Huswi gave the place to the descendants of Israil in_order for them to possess_as_theirs. He divided it to each tribe. Those place(s) include the mountains, plains there in the west, valley of Hurdan, slopes of the hills/mountains, desert, and the place of Nigib. Those places were resided before by the Hitihanons, Amurihanons, Kaananons, Pirisihanons, Hibihanons, and Hibusihanons. And these were the kings of those places that's defeated by Huswi and of the descendants of Israil: 9 the king of Hiriku, the king of Ay near to Bitil, 10 the king of Hirusalim, the king of Hibrun, 11 the king of Harmut, the king of Lakis, 12 the king of Iglun, the king of Gisir, 13 the king of Dibir, the king of Gidir, 14 the king of Hurma, the king of Arad, 15 the king of Libna, the king of Adulam, 16 the king of Makida, the king of Bitil, 17 the king of Tapuwa, the king of Hipir, 18 the king of Apik, the king of Lasarun, 19 the king of Madun, the king of Hasur, 20 the king of Simrun-Mirun, the king of Aksap, 21 the king of Taanak, the king of Migidu, 22 the king of Kadis, the king of Hukni-Am that's there in Karmil, 23 the king of Dur there at the shore of the sea, the king of Guyim there in Galiliya,[fn] 24 and the king of Tirsa. All the kings came thirty-one (31).

Ka inged ne ware pad naahew

The place that's not conquered yet

131 Ne hengkayi te egkabuyag e si Huswi, ingkahiyan sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Buyag kad amana kuntee wey maluag pad ka inged ne eg-ahawen. 2 Seini ka me inged ne eg-ahawen pad: ka intiru ne inged te me Pilistihanen wey te me Gisurihanen, 3 ne sakup te inged te me Kanaanen. Puun seini te Weyig ne Sihur peendiye te igsile te Ihiptu, taman diye te eletanan te Ikrun diye te igkahibang ne balabahan. Ne lagkes ka lalimma ne siyudad te me Pilistihanen: ka Gasa, ka Asdud, ka Askilun, ka Gat, wey ka Ikrun, lagkes ka inged te me Abihanen, 4 ka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan; ka intiru ne inged te me Kanaanen bunsud te Miyara ne iyan kamuney dengan ka me Sidunihanen taman diye te Apik ne eletanan te inged te me Amurihanen; 5 ka inged degma te me Gibalihanen; wey ka intiru ne Libanun peendiye te igsile, bunsud te Baal-Gad ne diye te lenlen te Bubungan ne Hirmun taman diye te Libu-Hamat. 6 [xr]Lagkes degma ka me bubungan bunsud te Libanun peendiye te Misriput-Maim ne iyan kamuney ka me Sidunihanen. Egdeldelen ku ka me mahinged te seeye ne me inged te timpu ne eglusuran niyu sikandan. Ba-baara nu ka seini ne me inged diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan sumale te insuhu ku keykew. 7 Ba-baara nu ka seini ne inged diye te siyam ne tribu wey diye te katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis[fn] isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan.”

131 And at the time when Huswi became_old, the Lord God told him, “You(sg) are very old now and the place to conquer is still large. 2 These (are) the places to be conquered yet: the entire place of the Pilistihanons and of the Gisurihanons, 3 which belong to the place of the Kanaanons. This is from the Sihur River to the east of Ihiptu, until there at the boundary of Ikrun there in the north (LIT left_side). And including the five cities of the Pilistihanons: Gasa, Asdud, Askilun, Gat, Ikrun, including the place of the Abihanons, 4 the one(s) there in the south (LIT right side of east); the entire place of the Kaananons from Miyara which was owned before by the Sidunihanons until there in Apik the boundary of the place of the Amurihanons; 5 the place also of the Gibalihanons; and the entire Libanun to the east, from Baal-Gad there at the foot of the Mount Hirmun until there in Libu-Hamat. 6 [xr]Including also the mountains from Libanun to Misriput-Maim which was owned by the Sidunihanons. I will_chase_away the inhabitants of those places at the time when you(pl) attack them. Divide_among(sg) the descendants of Israil these places as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to them according to what_ I _commanded to you(sg). 7 Divide_among(sg) the nine tribes and to the half of the descendant/s of Manasis[fn] this place as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to them.”

Ka pegbaad-baad te inged ne diye te igsile te Hurdan

The dividing of the place there on the east of the Hurdan

8 [xr]Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis, imbehayan e ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama te karatuan ne inggaat kandan diye te igsile te Weyig ne Hurdan. 9 Migbunsud ka inged dan diye te Aruwir ne dangdang te bangalug te Arnun, nalagkes e kayi ka siyudad ne diye te taliware te bangalug, peendiye seini te napu te Midiba taman diye te Dibun. 10 Nalagkes e degma ka langun ne me siyudad ni Sihun ne Amurihanen ne mighari diye te Hisbun, diye taman seini te eletanan te me Amunihanen. 11 Nalagkes degma ka Gilyad wey ka tane ne in-ugpaan te me Gisur wey te me Maaka, ka intiru ne bubungan te Hirmun, wey ka intiru ne Basan taman te Salika. 12 Nalagkes man-e ka intiru ne migharian ni Ug ne Hari te Astarut wey te Idrii. Si Ug iyan naan de nasame te me Ripaimhanen. Natalu sikandan enni Muwisis wey indelrel sikandan diye te inged dan. 13 Piru ware delrela te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me Gisur wey ka me Maaka, purisu minsan kuntee miglemung ded sikandan mig-ugpe te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

8 [xr]And the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis, were_given with inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) there in the east of Hurdan River by Muwisis the servant of the Lord God. 9 Their place began there in Aruwir next to the valley of Arnun, including here the city there in the middle of the valley, until to the plains of Midiba until there in Dibun. 10 Included also all cities of Sihun the Amurihanon who ruled there in Hisbun, this was until the boundary of the Amunihanons. 11 Included also the Gilyad and the land inhabited by the Gisur and of Maaka, the entire mountain of Hirmun, and the entire Basan until Salika. 12 Included also the entire kingdom of Ug the king in Astarut and Idrii. Ug was the only one left of the Ripaimhanons. Muwisis defeated them and they were_chased_away in their place. 13 But the descendants of Israil didn't chase_away the Gisur and the Maaka, therefore even today/now they are still living together with the descendants of Israil.

14 [xr]Piru ware behayi ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Libi te karatuan ne inggaat kandan. Ka igpanubad de ne egtutungen diye te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil, ka igbehey kandan isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis.

14 [xr]But Muwisis didn't give an inheritance (LIT wealth left) to the descendants of Libi. Only the burnt offering to the Lord God of Israil, will_be_given to them as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) according to the command of the Lord God to Muwisis.

Ka inged ne baad te me kabuhalan ni Rubin

The place share of the descendants of Rubin

15 Ne impamaaran ni Muwisis te inged ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Rubin isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan. 16 Migbunsud ka inged dan te Aruwir ne dangdang te bangalug te Arnun, nalagkes e kayi ka siyudad ne diye te taliware te bangalug, taman seeye te intiru ne napu te Midiba. 17 Nalagkes degma kayi ka Hisbun wey ka langun ne me siyudad diye te napu ne iyan ka Dibun, ka Bamut-Baal, ka Bit-Baal-Miyun, 18 ka Hahas, ka Kidimut, ka Mipaat, 19 ka Kiryataim, ka Sibma, ka Sirit-Sahar ne diye te labuntud te napu, 20 ka Bit-Piyur, ka me kalandihan te Bubungan ne Pisga, ka Bit-Hisimut, 21 ka langun ne me siyudad diye te napu, wey ka langun ne siyudad ne migmanduan ni Sihun ne Hari te Amurihanen ne diye migmandu te Hisbun. Natalu sikandin ni Muwisis wey ka me Hari te Midiyan ne si Ibi, si Rikim, si Sur, si Hur, wey si Riba; me pangulu sikandan langun te inged ne migmanduan ni Hari Sihun. 22 Ne lagkes degma te inggimatayan te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka egpanagne ne si Balaam ne anak ni Biyur. 23 Ne iyan eletanan te me kabuhalan ni Rubin ka Weyig ne Hurdan. Ne seeye ka me siyudad wey ka me lungsud ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, wey imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya ran.

15 And Muwisis shared a place to the families of the descendants of Rubin as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind). 16 Their place began at Aruwir next to the valley of Arnun, including here the city there in the middle of the valley, until there at the entire plains of Midiba. 17 Included also here was Hisbun and all the cities there in the plains of Dibun, Bamut-Baal, Bit-Baal-Miyun, 18 Hahas, Kidimut, Mipaat, 19 Kiryataim, Sibma, Sirit-Sahar which was there in the hill of the plains, 20 Bit-Piyur, the hillsides of Mount Pisga, Bit-Hisimut, 21 all the cities there in the valley, and all the cities ruled by Sihun king of the Amurihanons who ruled there in Hisbun. He was defeated by Muwisis and the kings of Midiyan who were Ibi, Rikim, Sur, Hur, and Riba; they were all leaders of the place ruled by king Sihun. 22 The descendants of Israil killed also the one prophesying Balaam the child of Biyur. 23 The boundary of the descendants of Rubin was the Hurdan River. And those were the cities and the towns as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) of descendants of Rubin, and they divided it to each of their family.

Ka inged ne baad te me kabuhalan ni Gad

The place that's the portion of the descendants of Gad

24 Ne impamaaran ni Muwisis te inged ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Gad isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan. 25 Ne nalagkes te inged dan ka Hasir, ka langun ne siyudad te Gilyad, wey ka katenge ne inged te me Amunihanen taman diye te Aruwir ne diye dapit te igsile te Raba. 26 Nalagkes degma ka inged ne egbunsud te Hisbun peendiye te Ramat-Mispi wey Bitunim, wey bunsud te Mahanaim taman diye te Ludibir. 27 Nalagkes degma ka inged diye te bangalug te Hurdan ne iyan ka Bit-Haran, ka Bit-Nimra, ka Sukut, ka Sapun, wey ka nasame ne migharian ni Sihun ne Hari te Hisbun. Ne ka eletanan diye te iglineb iyan ka Weyig ne Hurdan peendiye te Lanew ne Galiliya. 28 Seeye ka me siyudad wey ka me lungsud ne inggaat ne karatuan te me kabuhalan ni Gad wey imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya ran.

24 And Muwisis shared a place to the families of the descendants of Gad as an inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to them. 25 Included in their places was Hasir, all the cities of Gilyad, and half of the place of the Amunihanons until there in Aruwir there at the east side of Raba. 26 Included also the place that begins from Hisbun going to Ramat-Mispi and Bitunim, and from Mahanaim to Lubidir. 27 Included also the place there in the valley of Hurdan which was Bit-Haran, Bit-Nimra, Sukut, Sapun, and the remaining kingdom of Sihun the king of Hisbun. And the boundary at the west was the Hurdan River going to Lake of Galiliya. 28 Those were the cities and towns left as inheritance (LIT wealth) to the descendants of Gad and they divided it to each of their families.

Ka inged ne baad te me kabuhalan ni Manasis

The place that's the portion of the descendants of Manasis

29 Ne imbaaran degma ni Muwisis te inged ka me pamilya ne katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis. 30 Ne migbunsud ka inged dan te Mahanaim lagkes ka intiru ne Basan, ka intiru ne migharian ni Ug ne Hari te Basan, wey ka hen-em ne pulu (60) ne me siyudad te Hair ne sakup te Basan. 31 Nalagkes kayi ka katenge te Gilyad, ka me siyudad te Astarut wey Idrii ne migharian ni Ug diye te Basan. Imbehey seini diye te me pamilya te katenge te me kabuhalan ni Makir ne anak ni Manasis.

29 And Muwisis also shared a place to the families of the half of the descendant/s of Manasis. 30 And their place began in Mahanaim including the entire Basan, the entire kingdom of Ug the king of Basan, and the sixty (60) cities of Hair which was under_the_jurisdiction of Basan. 31 Included here the half of Gilyad, the cities of Astarut and Idrii ruled by Ug there in Basan. These were_given to the families of the half of the descendants of Makir the son of Manasis.

32 Seeye ka pegbaad-baad ni Muwisis te tane ne diye te igsile te Hiriku wey te Hurdan. Ne ka pegbaad-baad te tane neyitabu diye te kanapnapuan te Muwab. 33 [xr]Piru ware behayi ni Muwisis ka me kabuhalan ni Libi te tane isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan. Ingkahiyan din sikandan te iyan dan karatuan ne inggaat ka baad te me ighalad te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil.

32 That was the dividing of the land there in the east of Hiriku and Hurdan by Muwisis. The dividing of the land happened there at the plains of Muwab. 33 [xr]But Muwisis didn't give land to the descendants of Libi as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind). He told them that their inheritance were the portions of the offerings of the descendants of Israil to the Lord God of Israil.

Ka pegbaad-baad te inged ne diye te iglineb te Weyig ne Hurdan

The dividing of the place there in the west of Hurdan River

141 Iling kayi ka pegbaad-baad te inged te me Kanaanen diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan. Si Ilyasar ne talagpanubad, si Huswi ne anak ni Nun, wey ka me pangulu te me pamilya te tagse tribu te Israil ka migbaad-baad. 2 [xr]Nabaad-baad seeye diye te siyam wey te katenge te me tribu pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut su sika ka insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis. 3 [xr]Nabehayan e ni Muwisis ka daruwa ne tribu wey tenge isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan diye te igsile te Weyig ne Hurdan. 4 (Ka me kabuhalan ni Husi, nabaad te daruwa ne me kabuhalan: me kabuhalan ni Manasis wey me kabuhalan ni Ipraim.) Ne ware nabaari ka me Libita te tane ne kandan degma ne baad, piru nabaaran ded sikandan te me siyudad ne eg-ugpaan dan wey panabtaban para te me ayam dan. 5 Iling dutu ka pegbaad-baad te inged diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis.

141 Like this the dividing of the place of the Kanaanons by/to the descendants of Israil as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind). Ilyasar the sacrificer, Huswi the child of Nun, and the leaders of the families of each descendant of Israil were the ones_who_divided. 2 [xr]That was_divided to the nine and half tribes by casting because that was the command of the Lord God to Muwisis. 3 [xr]Muwisis has_given already the two tribes and half as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) there at the east of Hurdan River. 4 (The descendants of Husi, were_divided into two descendants: descendants of Manasis and descendants of Ipraim.) And the Libitas were not shared with land as their portion, but they were_given with cities to live on and pastures for their domestic_animals. 5 Just like that the dividing of the place there to the descendants of Israil according to the command of the Lord God to Muwisis.

Ka inged ne naangken ni Kalib

The place received by Kalib

6 [xr]Ne nangendiye ki Huswi diye te Gilgal ka duma ne me etew ne me kabuhalan ni Huda. Ne si Kalib ka sabeka kandan, anak sikandin ni Hipuni ne Kinisihanen. Ne ingkahiyan ni Kalib si Huswi, “Ware nu naan ded nalingawi ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama diye ki Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Manama meyitenged keykew wey keddi te diye ki pad te Kadis-Barniya? 7 [xr]Hep-at pad ne pulu (40) ka idad ku te insuhu a ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama puun te Kadis-Barniya eyew egsisilib te seini ne inged. Te peg-uli kud e, ingguhuran kud e iya sikandin ke nekey ka nakita ku. 8 Piru ingginaaldek te me duma ku ne nanduma keddiey ka keet-etawan. Ne sikeddi mule, migmatinumanen a ne mig-ikul te Magbebaye ne Manama ku. 9 [xr]Purisu, migsaaran a ni Muwisis te seeye ne aldew. Migkahi sikandin, ‘Tenged su migmatinumanen ka ne mig-ikul te Magbebaye ne Manama ku, sikeykew wey ka me kabuhalan nu iyan egpakakamuney te inged ne nabayaan nu te pegsisilib.’ 10 Ne miglihad e ka hep-at ne pulu wey lalimma (45) ne leg-un te ingkahi seeye te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis. Te seeye ne timpu, nangipanew pad ka me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te disirtu. Ne kuntee, walu e ne pulu wey lalimma (85) ka idad ku, wey in-uyag e pad te Magbebaye ne Manama. 11 Piru ka kanekal ku kuntee, iling pad te seeye te timpu ne insuhu a ni Muwisis. Duen pad kanekal ku te egpakiggira wey te peggimu te minsan nekey iling te dengan. 12 Sikan naa ka ibehey nu keddi ka me bubungan ne insaad dengan keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama. Narineg nu dengan ne diye nangugpe ka me Anakanhen te me siyudad ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu. Piru pinaahi te bulig te Magbebaye ne Manama, egdeldelen ku sikandan te seeye ne inged sumale te insaad keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

6 [xr]And other people from the descendants of Huda went to Huswi there in Gilgal. And Kalib was one of them, he was son of Hipuni the Kinisihanon. And Kalib said to Huswi, “Have you(sg) not forgotten what the Lord God said to Muwisis the servant of God concerning you(sg) and me while we(incl) were still at Kadis-Barniya? 7 [xr]Forty (40) years was my age when I was commanded by Muwisis the servant of the Lord God from Kadis-Barniya in_order to spy_out on this land. On my returning, I indeed told him what_ I _saw. 8 But my companions who came with me frightened the people. And on_the_contrary, I obeyed faithfully the Lord my God. 9 [xr]Therefore, Muwisis promised me on that day. He said, ‘Because you(sg) obeyed the Lord my God faithfully, you(sg) and your(sg) descendants will_possess_as_owners the land that you(sg) went_through when (you) were_spying.’ 10 And forty-five (45) years passed_by already (after) the Lord God said it to Muwisis. At that time, the descendants of Israil were still walking in the desert. And now/today, my age is eighty-five (85) already, and the Lord God caused_ me _to_live yet. 11 But my strength today/now, was still like at the time when Muwisis commanded me. I still have a strength to fight and to do whatever just like before. 12 So then give(sg) to me the mountains that were_promised to me before by the Lord God. You(sg) have heard before that the Anakanhons lived in cities fenced with high and thick stones. But by the help of the Lord God, I will_drive_ them _away from this place according to the promise of the Lord God to me.”

13 Ne impanalanginan ni Huswi si Kalib ne anak ni Hipuni, wey imbehey e kandin ka inged te Hibrun isip karatuan ne inggaat kandin. 14 Purisu minsan kuntee, naangken ded te me kabuhalan ni Kalib ne anak ni Hipuni ne Kinisihanen ka inged te Hibrun, tenged su matinumanen amana si Kalib te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil. 15 Te seeye ne timpu, iyan ngaran te inged te Hibrun ka Kiryat-Arba, isip eglimlimuan ki Arba, ka mabantug te me kabuhalan te Anakanhen.

13 And Huswi blessed Kalib the son of Hipuni, and given to him the place of Hibrun as his inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind). 14 Therefore even today/now, the descendants of Kalib the son of Hipuni the Kinisihanon still possessed Hibrun, because Kalib was so faithful to the Lord God, the God of Israil. 15 At that time, the name of the place of Hibrun was Kiryat-Arba, as to commemorate with Arba, the great of the descendants of the Anakanhons.

Te seeye ne timpu, neengked e ka gubut te seeye ne inged.

At that time, the war was stopped in that place.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Huda

The place possessed by the descendants of Huda

151 Seini ka me inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Huda, ne imbaad-baad diye te tagse pamilya:

151 These were the places that the descendants of Huda possessed, and were_divided among each family:

Nekeuma seini taman diye te katamanan te inged ne Idum peendiye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te Sin ne disirtu.2 Ne ka katamanan te seeye ne eletanan, migbunsud diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te Namatey ne Dahat, 3 peendiye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te takerehen te Akrabim taman diye te Sin ne mammara ne inged ne kene egkeugpaan. Nekeuma pad seini diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te Kadis-Barniya, peendiye te Hisrun, patakereg diye te Adar. Ne nakatiku seini peendiye te Karka. 4 Ne nekeuma seini diye te Asmun, nakalurug te weyig te Ihiptu, wey nakatuhun seini diye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. Seeye ka eletanan te Huda diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile.

This has reached until there at the boundary of Idum going_to the south (LIT right side of east) of Sin which was a desert.2 And the border of the boundary, begain there at the south (LIT right side of east) of the Dead Sea, 3 going_to the south of the ascent of Akrabim until there at Sin which was a wilderness. This has even reached there to the south (LIT right side of the east) of Kadis-Barniya, going_to Hisrun, going_up to Adar. And this turned_around to Karka. 4 And this has reached there to Asmun, went_along the Ihiptu river, and reached_its_end at the Miditiranyu Sea. That was the boundary of Huda there in the south (LIT right side of east).

5 Ka eletanan te igsile, iyan ka Namatey ne Dahat taman diye te be-be te Weyig ne Hurdan.

5 The boundary in the east, was the Dead Sea until there at the opening of the Hurdan River.

Ka eletanan te igkahibang ne balabahan, migbunsud diye te ilis te Namatey ne Dahat ne diye te iglepew te Weyig ne Hurdan.6 Nakatakereg seini diye te Bit-Hugla, wey nekeendiye te igkahibang ne balabahan te Bit-Araba taman diye te Batu ni Buhan ne anak ni Rubin. 7 Ne puun diye, nekeuma seini diye te bangalug ne egngaranan te Akur, peendiye te Dibir, nakatiku seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile, peendiye te Gilgal ne egpakatangke te Adunim ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te napu. Ne nekeuma seini diye te sebseb te In-Simis, wey diye te In-Rugil. 8 Ne puun diye, nekeuma pad man-e seini diye te napu te Binhinum peendiye te kalandihan te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile ne siyudad te me Hibusihanen, ne iyan ka siyudad ne Hirusalim. Ne nekeuma seini diye te iddus te bubungan, diye te iglineb te napu te Hinum, diye te katamanan te igkahibang ne balabahan te napu te Ripaim. 9 Ne puun diye, nekeuma seini diye te Sebseb te Niptuwa, peendiye te me siyudad ne marani te bubungan te Iprun. Ne puun diye, nakatupang te Baala, ne iyan ka Kiryat-Hiyarim. 10 Ne nakatiku seini diye te iglineb te Baala peendiye te Bubungan ne Siir. Ne nakatupang seini diye te tuhal te Bubungan ne Hiyarim, ne iyan ka Kisalun. Ne nakatupang seini diye te Bit-Simis wey nakalihad pad te Timna. 11 Ne puun diye, nakapabulus man-e seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile te tuhal te Ikrun, wey nakatiku seini diye te Sikirun. Ne nakalihad pad seini diye te Bubungan ne Baala taman diye te Habnil, wey diye seini nataman te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. 12 Ne diye te iglineb, iyan ded man-e eletanan ka Dahat ne Miditiranyu.

The boundary at the north (LIT left_side), started there at the shore of the Dead Sea which was there at the entrance of the Hurdan River.6 This ascended there at Bit-Hugla, and went to the north (LIT left side) of Bit-Araba until there at the Stone of Buhan the child of Rubin. 7 And from there, this has reached to the valley that's named Akur, going to Dibir, it turned_around there at the north (LIT left side of east), going to Gilgal that's facing Adunim in the south (LIT right side of east) of the valley. And it has reached there in the spring of In-Simis, and there at In-Rugil. 8 And from there, it has reached also there in the valley of Binhinum going to the hillside of the south of the city of Hibusihanons, which was the city of Hirusalim. And this has reached to the peak of the mountain, there in the west of the valley of Hinum, there to the border of the north (LIT left_side) of the valley of Ripaim. 9 And from there, it has reached there to the Spring of Niptuwa, going to the cities near the mountain of Iprun. And from there, (it) went_down Baala, which was Kiryat-Hirayim. 10 And it turned_around there at the west of Baala going_to Mount Siir. And it went_down there at the hill_top of Mount Hirayim, which was Kisalun. And it went_down there to Bit-Simis and past_by Timna. 11 And from there, it continued there in the north (LIT left side of east) of the hill_top of Ikrun, and turned_around there in Sikirun. And it passed_by at the Mountain of Baala until there in Habnil, and it has ended there in Miditiranyu Sea. 12 And there at the west, the boundary was still the Miditiranyu Sea.

Seeye ka me eletanan te naangken ne inged te me kabuhalan ni Huda, ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya.

Those were the boundaries of the place possessed by the descendants of Huda, and they divided it to each of the family.

Naangken ni Kalib ka Hibrun wey Dibir

Kalib possessed Hibrun and Dibir

(Tal 1:11‑15)

(Judg 1:11‑15)

13 [xr]Ne insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi ne egpabehayan te inged si Kalib ne anak ni Hipuni, puun te inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Huda. Seini ne inged iyan ka Kiryat-Arba ne iyan ka Hibrun. Ingngaran seini ki Arba ne amey ni Anak. 14 Indelrel ni Kalib puun dutu ne inged ka tatelu ne kabuhalan ni Anak: ka me pamilya ni Sisay, ni Ahiman, wey ni Talmay. 15 Puun diye, migpakiggira pad man-e ensi Kalib te me mahinged te Dibir. Iyan dengan ngaran te Dibir ka Kiryat-Sipir. 16 Ne migkahi si Kalib, “Igpaasawa ku ka anak ku ne mengebay ne si Aksa, te etew ne eglusud wey egpakaahew te Kiryat-Sipir.” 17 Ne iyan nakaahew dutu si Utnil ne anak ni Kinis ne hari ni Kalib. Sikan naa ka impaasawa rin e ka anak din ne si Aksa ki Utnil. 18 Te nekeg-asawe e sikandan, imbanasalan ni Utnil si Aksa ne egpabuyuen te kamet diye te amey rin. Purisu, miggendiye si Aksa ki Kalib, wey te nakalegsad e sikandin te asnu rin, mig-insaan e sikandin ni Kalib, “Nekey-a ka innendini nu?” 19 Ne migtabak sikandin, “Egbuyu a te duma ne dasag su ka imbehey nu keddi ne tane diye te Nigib, ware weyig.” Purisu, imbehayan sikandin ni Kalib te me sebseb ne diye te dibabew wey diye te diralem te inged te Nigib.

13 [xr]And the Lord God commanded Huswi to give a place to Kalib the child of Hipuni, from the place possessed by the descendants of Huda. This place was Kiryat-Arba which was Hibrun. This was called_after Arba the father of Anak. 14 Kalib chased_away from that place the three descendants of Anak: the family of Sisay, of Ahiman, and of Talmay. 15 From there, Kalib_and_company fought again with the residents of Dibir. The name of Dibir was Kiryat-Sipir before. 16 And Kalib said, “I will_cause_ my unmarried child Aksa _marry, to a person that will_attack and captures Kiryat-Sipir.” 17 And the (one who) captured it was Utnil who was a child of Kinis the younger_brother of Kalib. That's why he caused_ his child Aksa _to_marry with Utnil. 18 When they got_married, Utnil encouraged Aksa to ask a field from her father. Therefore, Aksa went to Kalib, and when she got_off from her donkey, Kalib asked her, “What did you(sg) come_here_for?” 19 And she answered, “I am asking some gifts because the land that you(sg) have given me there in Nigib, has no water/river.” Therefore, Kalib gave her the springs there in the top and below the place of Nigib.

Ka me siyudad te me kabuhalan ni Huda

The cities of the descendants of Huda

20 Seini ka me siyudad ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Huda ne imbaad-baad dan diye te tagse pamilya, 21 ka me siyudad ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile ne diye te katamanan te Nigib ne marani te eletanan te Idum: ka Kabsil, ka Idir, ka Hagur, 22 ka Kina, ka Dimuna, ka Adada, 23 ka Kidis, ka Hasur, ka Itnan, 24 ka Sip, ka Tilim, ka Bi-Alut, 25 ka Hasur-Hadata, ka Kiryut-Hisrun ne iyan ka Hasur, 26 ka Amam, ka Sima, ka Mulada, 27 ka Hasar-Gada, ka Hismun, ka Bit-Pilit, 28 ka Hasar-Suwal, ka Birsiba, ka Bisyutiya, 29 ka Baala, ka Iyim, ka Isim, 30 ka Iltulad, ka Kisil, ka Hurma, 31 ka Siklag, ka Madmana, ka Sansana, 32 ka Libaut, ka Silim, ka Ayin, wey ka Rimun. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te daruwa ne pulu wey siyam (29) lagkes ka me lungsud ne nakalingut kayi.

20 These were the cities as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) of the descendants of Huda that they divided on each family, 21 the cities there at the south (LIT right side) which as there at the boundary of Nigib near the boundary of Idum: Kabsil, Idir, Hagur, 22 Kina, Dimuna, Adada, 23 Kidis, Hasur, Itnan, 24 Sip, Tilim, Bi-Alut, 25 Hasur-Hadata, Kiryut-Hisrun which was Hasur, 26 Amam, Sima, Mulada, 27 Hasar-Gada, Hismun, Bit-Pilit, 28 Hasar-Suwal, Birsiba, Bisyutiya, 29 Baala, Iyim, Isim, 30 Iltulad, Kisil, Hurma, 31 Siklag, Madmana, Sansana, 32 Libaut, Silim, Ayin, and Rimun. All the cities have_reached twenty-nine (29) including the towns that surrounding them.

33 Ne naangken dan degma ka me siyudad ne diye te napu diye te iglineb ne iyan ka Istaul, ka Sura, ka Asna, 34 ka Sanuwa, ka In-Ganim, ka Tapuwa, ka Inam, 35 ka Harmut, ka Adulam, ka Suku, ka Asika, 36 ka Sa-Araim, ka Aditaim, ka Gidira, wey ke Gidirutaim. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu wey hep-at (14) lagkes ka me lungsud ne nakalingut kayi.

33 And they possessed also the cities there in the plains at the west which was Istaul, Sura, Asna, 34 Sanuwa, In-Ganim, Tapuwa, Inam, 35 Harmut, Adulam, Suku, Asika, 36 Sa-Araim, Aditaim, Gidira, or Gidirutaim. All the cities have_reached fourteen (14) including the towns that surrounding them.

37 Nalagkes degma ka Sinan, ka Hadasa, ka Migdal-Gad, 38 ka Dilyan, ka Mispi, ka Huktil, 39 ka Lakis, ka Buskat, ka Iglun, 40 ka Kabun, ka Lamam, ka Kitlis, 41 ka Gidirut, ka Bit-Dagun, ka Naama, wey ka Makida. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu wey hen-em (16) lagkes ka me lungsud ne nakalingut kayi.

37 Included also were Sinan, Hadasa, Migdal-Gad, 38 Dilyan, Mispi, Huktil, 39 Lakis, Buskat, Iglun, 40 Kabun, Lamam, Kitlis, 41 Gidirut, Bit-Dagun, Naama, and the Makida. All the cities have_reached sixteen (16) including the towns that surrounding them.

42 Naangken dan man-e ka Libna, ka Itir, ka Asan, 43 ka Ipta, ka Asna, ka Nisib, 44 ka Kila, ka Aksib, wey ka Marisa. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te siyam lagkes ka me lungsud ne nakalingut kayi.

42 They have possessed also the Libna, Itir, Asan, 43 Ipta, Asna, Nisib, 44 Kila, Aksib, and Marisa. All the cities have_reached nine including the towns that surrounding them.

45 Nalagkes degma ka Ikrun wey ka me siyudad, wey ka me lungsud ne nakalingut kayi, 46 wey ka langun ne siyudad wey me lungsud ne marani te Asdud puun te Ikrun peendiye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu.

45 Included also were Ikrun and the cities, and towns surrounded it, 46 and all the cities and towns near Asdud from Ikrun going_to Miditiranyu Sea.

47 Nalagkes degma ka Asdud, wey Gasa, wey lagkes kayi ka me siyudad dan wey me lungsud dan peendiye te Weyig te eletanan te Ihiptu, wey peendiye te ilis te Dahat ne Miditiranyu.

47 Included also the Asdud, and Gasa, and including the cities and towns of them going to River of the boundary of Ihiptu, and going to the shore of the Miditiranyu Sea.

48 Ne naangken dan man-e ka me siyudad diye te me bubungan ne iyan ka Samir, ka Hatir, ka Suku, 49 ka Dana, ka Kiryat-Sana ne iyan ka Dibir, 50 ka Anab, ka Istimu, ka Anim, 51 ka Gusin, ka Hulun, wey ka Gilu. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu wey sabeka (11) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi.

48 And they have also possessed the cities there in the mountains which were Samir, Hatir, Suku, 49 Dana, Kiryat-Sana which was Dibir, 50 Anab, Istimu, Anim, 51 Gusin, Hulun, and Gilu. All the cities have_reached eleven (11) including the towns that surrounding them.

52 Nalagkes degma ka Arab, ka Duma, ka Isan, 53 ka Hanim, ka Bit-Tapuwa, ka Apika, 54 ka Humta, ka Kiryat-Arba ne iyan ka Hibrun, wey ka Siyur. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te siyam lagkes ka me lungsud kayi.

52 Included also were Arab, Duma, Isan, 53 Hanim, Bit-Tapuwa, Apika, 54 Humta, Kiryat-Arba which was Hibrun, and Siyur. All the cities have_reached nine including the towns of them.

55 Naangken dan man-e ka Maun, ka Karmil, ka Sip, ka Huta, 56 ka Hisril, ka Hukdi-Am, ka Sanuwa, 57 ka Kain, ka Gibiya, wey ka Timna. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu lagkes ka me lungsud kayi.

55 They have also possessed the Maun, Karmil, sip, Huta, 56 Hisril, Hukdi-An, Sanuwa, 57 Kain, Gibiya, and Timna. All the cities have_reached ten including their towns.

58 Naangken dan man-e ka Halhul, ka Bit-Sur, ka Gidur, 59 ka Maarat, ka Bit-Anut, wey ka Iltikun. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te hen-em lagkes ka me lungsud kayi.

58 They have also possessed Halhul, Bit-Sur, Gidur, 59 Maarat, Bit-Anut, and Iltikun. All the cities have_reached six including the towns of them.

60 Naangken dan man-e ka Kiryat-Baal ne iyan ka Kiryat-Hiyarim, wey ka Raba. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te daruwa lagkes ka me lungsud kayi.

60 They have also possessed the Kiryat-Baal which was Kiryat-Hirayim, and Raba. All the cities have_reached two including the towns of them.

61 Ne naangken dan man-e ka me siyudad ne diye te disirtu, ne iyan ka Bit-Araba, ka Midin, ka Sikaka, 62 ka Nibsan, ka siyudad te Asin, wey ka In-Gidi. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te hen-em lagkes ka me lungsud kayi.

61 They have also possessed the cities in the desert, which were Bit-Araba, Midin, Sikaka, 62 Nibsan, the city of Asin, and In-Gidi. All the cities have_reached six including the towns of them.

63 [xr]Piru ware nadelrel te me kabuhalan ni Huda ka me Hibusihanen ne nangugpe diye te Hirusalim. Sikan naa ka minsan kuntee, mig-ugpe ded sikandan duma te me matig-Huda.

63 [xr]But the descendants of Huda were_ not _able_to_chase_away the Hibusihanons that lived there in Hirusalim. That's why even today, they still lived among the (ones) from_Huda.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Husi

The place possessed by the descendants of Husi

161 Ne ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Husi, migbunsud diye te Hurdan ne marani te Hiriku ne diye te igsile te me sebseb te Hiriku, peendiye te disirtu, wey peendiye te me bubungan taman te Bitil. 2 Ne puun diye te Bitil, nekeuma seini diye te Lus, wey nekeuma seini diye te Atarut ne nangugpaan te me Arkihanen. 3 Ne nakatupang pad seini diye te iglineb te inged te me Haplitihanen, peendiye te diralem te Bit-Hurun. Ne nakapabulus seini diye te Gisir, wey diye nataman seini te Dahat ne Miditiranyu.

161 And the place possessed by the descendants of Husi, started there in Hurdan which was near Hiriku at the east of the springs of Hiriku, going to the desert, and going to the mountains until Bitil. 2 And from there in Bitil, it has reached to Lus, and it has reached there to Atarut where the Arkihanons lived. 3 And it went_down_hill there in the west of the place of the Haplitihanons, going_there below Bit-Hurun. And it continued there in Gisir, and it ended there in the Miditiranyu Sea.

4 Seeye ka naangken te me kabuhalan ni Manasis wey ni Ipraim ne me kabuhalan ni Husi isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan.

4 Those (places) as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) were possessed by the descendants of Manasis and of Ipraim which were descendants of Husi.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim

The place possessed by the descendants of Ipraim

5 Seini ka baad te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim ne imbaad-baad dan diye te tagse pamilya ran: ka eletanan kayi diye te igsile, migbunsud te Atarut-Adar[fn] peendiye te dibabew te Bit-Hurun. 6 Ne puun diye, nekeuma seini diye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. Ne ka eletanan te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile, migbunsud diye te Mik-Mitat wey nakatiku seini diye te igsile peendiye te Taanat-Silu, wey nakalihad pad seini diye te igsile te Hanuwa. 7 Ne puun te Hanuwa, nakatupang pad seini diye te Atarut wey Naara. Nakabaye seini diye te Hiriku, wey nakatuhun diye te Weyig ne Hurdan. 8 Ne puun te Tapuwa, nekeuma ka eletanan diye te iglineb, wey peendiye te Weyig ne Kana taman diye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. Seini ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim, ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya. 9 Nalagkes kayi ka duma ne me siyudad wey me lungsud ne apil te tane ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Manasis. 10 [xr]Piru ware dan nadelrel ka me matig-Kanaan ne nangugpe diye te Gisir, purisu minsan kuntee, nangugpe ded ka me matig-Kanaan duma te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim isip me uripen.

5 This was the portion of the descendants of Ipraim which they have divided to each of their families: the boundary of it there in the east, from Atarut-Adar[fn] going to the upper_portion of Bit-Hurun. 6 And from there, it has reached to Miditiranyu Sea. And the boundary at the north (LIT left side of east), began there in Mik-Mitat and it turned_around there to the east going_to Taanat-Silu, and past_by there at the east of Hanuwa. 7 And from Hanuwa, this went_down_hill there in Atarut and Naara. This went_through there in Hiriku, and reached_its_ending there in Hurdan River. 8 And from Tapuwa, the boundary has reached there in the west, and going_to the River Kana until there at the Miditiranyu Sea. This place was_possessed by the descendants of Ipraim, and they divided it to each family. 9 Included here were the rest of the cities and towns included in the land as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to the descendants of Manasis. 10 [xr]But they were_ not _able_to_chase_away the (ones) from_Kanaan who lived there in Gisir, therefore even today/now, the (ones) from_Kanaan still lived together with the descendants of Ipraim as slaves.

Ka inged ne naangken te katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis

The place possessed by half of the descendants of Manasis

171 Due degma inged ne naangken te katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis,[fn] ka kinakakayan ne anak ni Husi. Ne naangken te pamilya ni Makir ka Gilyad wey ka Basan tenged su meupiya sikandin ne sundalu. Si Makir ka amey ni Gilyad, ka kinakakayan ne anak ni Manasis. 2 Ne ka inged ne diye te iglineb te Weyig ne Hurdan, naangken te duma ne me kabuhalan ni Manasis ne me pamilya ni Abi-Isir, Hilik, Asril, Sikim, Hipir, wey Simida. Ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya. 3 Ne due etew ne egngaranan ki Silupihad. Anak sikandin ni Hipir, wey apu sikandin ni Gilyad. Ne si Gilyad, anak ni Makir, wey si Makir, anak ni Manasis. Ne neelin de ne malitan ka anak ni Silupihad ne iyan ensi Mala, Nuwa, Hugla, Milka wey Tirsa. 4 [xr]Ne nangendiye ka seeye ne me malitan ki Ilyasar ne talagpanubad, ki Huswi ne anak ni Nun, wey diye te me pangulu, wey migkahi sikandan, “Migsuhu ka Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis ne egpabehayan key te inged isip karatuan ne inggaat iling te me karumaan ney ne me lukes.” Purisu, nabehayan sikandan te inged sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 5 Seini ka egpuunan ne natimulan te sapulu ne baad ka naangken ne inged te kabuhalan ni Manasis, angin e te Gilyad wey Basan ne diye te igsile te Hurdan, 6 tenged su nabehayan ma degma te inged ka me malitan ne kabuhalan din iling te kabuhalan din ne me lukes. Ne naangken ka Gilyad te duma ne me kabuhalan ni Manasis.

171 There was also a place that's possessed by half of the descendant/s of Manasis,[fn] the eldest child of Husi. And the family of Makir possessed Gilyad and Basan because he (was) a good soldier. Makir was the father of Gilyad, the eldest child of Manasis. 2 And the place there in the west of Hurdan River, possessed by the other descendants of Manasis who were the families of Abi-Isir, Hilik, Asril, Sikim, Hipir, and Simida. And they divided it to each family. 3 And there was a person who was_named Silupihad. He was a son of Hipir, and he was a grandchild of Gilyad. And Gilyad, was child of Makir, and Makir, was a child of Manasis. The children of Silupihad were all females who were Mala, Nuwa, Hugla, Milka and Tirsa. 4 [xr]And those women went to Ilyasar the sacrificer, to Huswi the child of Nun, and there to the leaders, and they said, “The Lord God commanded Muwisis to give us(excl) a place as an inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) just like our(excl) male relatives.” Therefore, they were_given a place according to the command of the Lord God. 5 This was the reason that the place possessed by the descendants of Manasis was added with ten portions, except for Gilyad and Basan there in the east of Hurdan, 6 because the women who were his descendants were_ also _given a place just like his male descendants. And Gilyad was_possessed by other descendants of Manasis.

7 Ne ka inged ne naangken te kabuhalan ni Manasis, migbunsud diye te Asir peendiye te Mik-Mitat ne igsile te Sikim. Ne migginguma seini diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile peendiye te nangugpaan te matig-In-Tapuwa. 8 Ne iyan nakaangken ka kabuhalan ni Manasis te inged ne nakalingut te Tapuwa, piru ka Tapuwa diye te eletanan te inged ni Manasis ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim. 9 Ne nakatupang ka eletanan diye te Weyig ne Kana. Ne due me siyudad diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te weyig ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim, minsan ke naseled seini te naangken te me kabuhalan ni Manasis. Ne nakapabulus ka eletanan te me kabuhalan ni Manasis diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te Weyig ne Kana taman diye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. 10 Ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim ka diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile, wey naangken te me kabuhalan ni Manasis ka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile. Ne iyan eletanan te me kabuhalan ni Manasis diye te iglineb ka Dahat ne Miditiranyu. Ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Asir ka diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile, wey naangken degma te me kabuhalan ni Isakar ka diye te igsile. 11 Ne due degma me siyudad ne nasakup te inged te me kabuhalan ni Isakar wey ni Asir ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Manasis: ka Bit-San, Iblaim, Dur, In-Dur, Taanak, Migidu, wey ka me bariyu ne nakalingut kayi. 12 [xr]Piru ka seeye ne me siyudad ware neugpei te me kabuhalan ni Manasis, tenged su ware dan nadelrel ka me matig-Kanaan diye. 13 Piru te migmaresen e ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, in-uripen dan e ka me matig-Kanaan, piru ware dan sikandan delrela.

7 And the place possessed by the descendants of Manasis, began there in Asir going to Mik-Mitat in the east of Sikim. And it has reached there in south (LIT right side of east) going to the where the (ones) from_In-Tapuwa lived. 8 And the descendants of Manasis possessed the place around Tapuwa, but Tapuwa was in the boundary of the land of Manasis that was_possessed by the descendants of Ipraim. 9 And the boundary went_down_hill there in the Kana River. And there were cities there in the south of the river that was_possessed by the descendants of Ipraim, even it was inside (the land) possessed by the descendants of Manasis. And the boundary of the descendants of Manasis continued there in the north of Kana River until there at the Miditiranyu Sea. 10 And the descendants of Ipraim possessed (the portion) there in the north (LIT left side of east), and the descendants of Manasis possessed (the portion) there in the south. And the boundary of the descendants of Manasis there in the west was the Miditiranyu Sea. And the descendants of Asir possessed (the portion) there in north (LIT left side of east), and the descendants of Isakar also possessed (the portion) there in the east. 11 And there were also cities that under_jurisdiction of the place of the descendants of Isakar and Asir that were possessed by the descendants of Manasis: Bit-San, Iblaim, Dur, In-Dur, Taanak, Migidu, and the villages around them. 12 [xr]But those cities were_ not _inhabited by the descendants of Manasis, because they were_ not _able_to_chase_away the (ones) from_Kanaan there. 13 But when the descendants of Israil became_ more _powerful, they took_as_slaves the (ones) from_Kanaan, but they didn't chase_ them _away.

Ka pegpatimul te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim wey ni Manasis te tane

The descendants of Ipraim and of Manasis asking_addition of the land

14 Ne migkahi ka me kabuhalan ni Husi diye ki Huswi, “Mania te sabeka re ne baad ne inged ka imbehey nu kanami? Masulug key amana tenged su impanalanginan key te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

14 And the descendants of Husi said to Huswi, “Why is it that only one portion of land/place you(sg) have given us(excl)? We(excl) are too many because the Lord God blessed us(excl).”

15 Ne migtabak si Huswi, “Emun ke masulug kew amana, wey emun ke kene ne eleg kaniyu ka me bubungan te Ipraim, pangendiye kew te me Puwalas te me Pirisihanen wey me Ripaimhanen. Ne gehawan kew te inged diye ne para kaniyu.”

15 And Huswi replied, “If you(pl) are too many, and if the mountains of Ipraim would not be enough for you(pl), go(pl) there in the Forests of the Pirisihanons and Ripaimhanons. And clear a place there for you(pl).”

16 Ne migkahi ka me kabuhalan ni Husi, “Kene ne eleg kanami ka me bubungan. Ne kene ney egkatalu ka me matig-Kanaan ne diye te napu tenged su due me karwahi ran ne putew. Ne iling ded ka me Kanaanen ne diye te Bit-San, wey ka nakalingut ne me lungsud kayi, wey minsan ka diye te bangalug ne egngaranan te Hisril.”

16 And the descendants of Husi said, “The mountains are not enough for us(excl). And we(excl) won't be able to defeat the (ones) from_Kanaan there in the valley because they have iron chariots. And same as with the Kanaanons there in Bit-San, and the towns surrounding it, and even the ones_there in the valley that's named Hisril.”

17 Ne intabak ni Huswi ka kabuhalan ni Husi ne iyan ka me kabuhalan ni Ipraim wey ni Manasis, “Masulug niyu bes iya wey tenged due egmaresen kew amana. Ne keilangan ne kene ne sabeka re ne baad ka egkaangken niyu. 18 Egkaangken niyu man-e ka puwalas diye te me bubungan. Gawani niyu re, wey kaniyud e puun te iglenlen te seeye ne bubungan taman diye te iddus. Ne egkadelrel niyu ka me matig-Kanaan minsan maresen sikandan, wey minsan ke due me karwahi ran ne putew.”

17 And Huswi replied to the descendants of Husi who were the descendants of Ipraim and Manasis, “You(pl) are indeed (surp) too many and due to that you(pl) will_become very powerful. And it is necessary that you(pl) will_possess not only one portion. 18 You(pl) will_possess also the forest there in the mountains. Just clear(pl)_it, and you(pl) will_possess it from the foot of that mountain until there at its peak. And you(pl) will_be_able_to_chase_away the (ones) from_Kanaan even_though they are powerful, and even if they have iron chariots.”

Ka pegbaad-baad te duma ne inged

The dividing of other places

181 Te naahew e te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka seeye ne inged, miglibulung sikandan langun diye te Silu, wey miggimu sikandan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan dan. 2 Ne duen pad pitu ne tribu te me kabuhalan ni Israil ne ware pad nabehayi te inged isip karatuan ne inggaat. 3 Purisu, ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Ken-u niyu pad eg-angkenen ka inged ne imbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama te kaap-apuan niyu? 4 Alam kew te tatelu ne etew te tagse tribu. Egpaleuyen ku sikandan te intiru ne inged. Ne eggimu sikandan te mapa eyew egkanengnengan ta ke egmenuwen te egbaad-baad ka seeye ne tane. Ne eglibed e sikandan kayi te keddi. 5 Ne egbaaren dan te pitu ne baad ka inged, angin e te inged te me kabuhalan ni Huda ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile, wey ka inged te me kabuhalan ni Husi ne diye te inged te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile. 6 Emun ke egkeimpusan dan e te egmapa, eg-uyanen dan e seini kayi te keddi eyew egpinpituten ku seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 7 Piru ware inged ne egkaangken te me Libita tenged su iyan dan himu ka egpamakey te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne nakarawat e ka me kabuhalan ni Gad, ni Rubin, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis[fn] te inged isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan diye te igsile te Hurdan ne imbehey kandan ni Muwisis, ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

181 When the descendants of Israil have snatched already those places, they gathered all there in Silu, and they made their Tent of Meeting. 2 And there were seven more tribes of the descendants of Israil that were not given a place/land as an inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind). 3 Therefore, Huswi said to the descendants of Israil, “When do you(pl) possess the place that has_given by the Lord God to your(pl) ancestors? 4 Choose(pl) three people from each tribe. I will_cause_ them _to_spy the entire place. And they will_make a map in_order that we(incl) will_know how to divide that place. And they will_return to me. 5 And they will_divide the place in seven_portions, except for the place of the descendants of Huda which is there in the south (LIT right side of east), and the place of the descendants of Husi which is there in the north (LIT left side of east). 6 When they are done of mapping_(it)_out, they will_bring it to me so_that I will_draw it up there in front of the Lord God. 7 But no place the Libitas could possess for their work is serving the Lord God. And the descendants of Gad, Rubin, and half of the descendant/s of Manasis[fn] have received a place already as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) there in the east of Hurdan which was_given to them by Muwisis, the servant of the Lord God.”

8 Te egpangipanew e ka naalam ne me etew, ingkahiyan sikandan ni Huswi, “Leuya niyu ka intiru ne inged wey himu kew te mapa.
