Ne libed kew kayi su egpinpintuten ku seini diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew egkatahan ta ke hentew ne tribu ka egpakaangken te tagse inged.” 9 Sikan naa ka nangipanew ka me etew ne egleuy te intiru ne inged. Ne inggimuwan dan seini te mapa ne migpakita ne nabaad ka inged te pitu ne baad wey insulat dan ka me siyudad, wey ka me lungsud ne nasakup te tagse baad. Te neimpusan dan e te egmapa, miglibed e sikandan ki Huswi diye te Silu. 10 Ne pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, imbehayan ni Huswi te baad ka me tribu te Israil ne ware pad nakaangken te inged.

8 When the chosen people were leaving, Huswi said to them, “Spy_out(pl) the entire place and make(pl) a map. And come_back(pl) here because I will_draw it up there in front of the Lord God so_that we(incl) will_know what tribe will_possess every place.” 9 So then the people left in_order to spy_out the entire place. And they made a map of it that showed that the place was_divided into seven and they have written the names of the cities, and the towns under_the_jurisdiction of each portion. When they were done mapping, they returned to Huswi there in Silu. 10 And by_means of drawing_lots, Huswi has_given a portion the tribes of Israil that didn't possess land yet.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin

The place possessed by the descendants of Binhamin

11 Ka an-anayan ne nabehayan te inged pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, iyan ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Diye seini te elat te naangken ne inged te me kabuhalan ni Huda wey ni Husi. 12 Ne ka eletanan dan te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile; migbunsud diye te Hurdan patakereg diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile te Hiriku. Ne peendiye seini te iglineb te me bubungan taman diye te Bit-Abin ne disirtu. 13 Ne puun diye, nekeuma seini diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te tuhal te Lus, peendiye te igkahibang ne balabahan ne bubungan kayi ne iyan e ngaran kuntee ka Bitil. Ne nakatupang seini diye te Atarut-Adar[fn] ne diye te bubungan te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te diralem te Bit-Hurun. 14 Ne puun diye, migpabulus seini diye te iglineb ne bubungan ne egpakatangke te Bit-Hurun ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile. Ne diye nataman seini te Kiryat-Baal (ne egngaranan ded te Kiryat-Hiyarim), ka siyudad te me kabuhalan ni Huda. Ne seeye ka eletanan diye te iglineb. 15 Ne ka eletanan te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile, migbunsud diye te katamanan te Kiryat-Hiyarim. Nakapabulus seini diye te iglineb peendiye te me Sebseb te Niptuwa. 16 Ne nakatupang seini diye te lenlen te bubungan ne nakatangke te bangalug te Binhinum ne diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile te bangalug te Ripaim. Ne puun diye, nakapabulus seini diye te napu te Hinum peendiye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile te ilis te lungsud te me Hibusihanen, wey taman seini diye te In-Rugil. 17 Ne nakatiku seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile peendiye te In-Simis. Ne nekeuma seini diye te Gililut ne nakatangke te takerehen te Adumim. Ne nakatupang seini diye te Batu ni Buhan ne anak ni Rubin. 18 Ne puun diye, nekeuma seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile te tuhal ne egpakatangke te bangalug te Bit-Araba, wey nakatupang seini diye te bangalug te Araba. 19 Ne nekeuma seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile te ilis te Bit-Hugla, wey diye nataman seini te igkahibang ne balabahan te igsile ne bayaanan te weyig ne Namatey ne Dahat, ne iyan ka pulipusan te Weyig ne Hurdan diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile. Seeye ka eletanan diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile. 20 Ne Weyig ne Hurdan ka eletanan diye te igsile. Ne seeye ka me eletanan te inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin, ne imbaad-baad dan te tagse pamilya.

11 The first_one that were given with a place by drawing_lots, was the families of the descendants of Binhamin. This was in the middle of the place(s) possessed by the descendants of Huda and Husi. 12 And their boundary in the north (LIT left side of east); began there in Hurdan ascending to the north (LIT left side of east) of Hiriku. And it went to the west of the mountains until there in Bit-Abin a desert. 13 And from there, it has reached there in the south (LIT right side of east) of the hill_tops of Lus, to it's southern mountain which was now named Bitil. And it descended there in Atarut-Adar[fn] which was there in the mountain in the south (LIT right side of east) below Bit-Hurun. 14 And from there, this continued there in western mountain that's facing Bit-Hurun which was there in the south (LIT right side of east). And it ended in Kiryat-Baal (which was_named also Kiryat-Hiyarim), the city of the descendants of Huda. And that was the boundary there in the west. 15 And the boundary at the south (LIT right side of east), began there in the border of Kiryat-Hiyarim. This continued there in the west going to the Springs of Niptuwa. 16 And it descended there in the foot of the mountain that's facing the valley of Binhinum which was there in the north (LIT left side of east) of the valley of Ripaim. And from there, it continued there in the valley of Hinum going to the south (LIT right side of east) of the outskirt of the town of Hibusihanons, and ended there in In-Rugil. 17 And it turned_around there in the north going to In-Simis. And it has reached there in Gililut that's facing the ascent of Adumim. And it descended there in the Stone of Buhan who was the child of Rubin. 18 And from there, this has reached there in the north of the hill_tops facing the valley of Bit-Araba, and descended there in the valley of Araba. 19 And it has reached there in the north of the outskirt of Bit-Hugla, and ended there in the north of passage of the river the Dead Sea, which was the end_point of the Hurdan River there in the south. That was the boundary there in the south. 20 And Hurdan River was the boundary there in the east. And those boundaries of the place possessed by the descendants of Binhamin, which they have divided on each family.

21 Ne ka me siyudad ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin, ne imbaad-baad dan te tagse pamilya ran iyan ka Hiriku, Bit-Hugla, Imik-Kisis, 22 Bit-Araba, Simaraim, Bitil, 23 Abim, Para, Upra, 24 Kipar-Amuni, Upni, wey Giba. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu wey daruwa (12) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi. 25 Lagkes degma kayi ka Gibyun, Rama, Biirut, 26 Mispa, Kipira, Musa, 27 Rikim, Irpil, Tarala, 28 Sila, Ha-Ilip, Hibus (Hirusalim e kuntee seini), Gibiya, wey Kiryat-Hiyarim. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu wey hep-at (14) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi. Seeye ka inged ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin, ne imbaad-baad dan seeye diye te tagse pamilya.

21 And cities possessed by the descendants of Binhamin, which they divided to each family were Hiriku, Bit-Hugla, Imik-Kisis, 22 Bit-Araba, Simaraim, Bitil, 23 Abim, Para, Upra, 24 Kipar-Amuni, Upni, and Giba. All the cities have reached twelve (12) including the towns of them. 25 Included also were Gibyun, Rama, Biirut, 26 Mispa, Kipira, Musa, 27 Rikim, Irpil, Tarala, 28 Sila, Ha-Ilip, Hibus (this is now Hirusalim), Gibiya, and Kiryat-Hiyarim. All the cities have_reached fourteen (14) including the towns of them. Those places were the inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) of the descendants of Binhamin, which they divided to each family.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Simyun

The place possessed by the descendants of Simyun

191 Ka igkarangeb ne nabehayan te inged pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, iyan ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Simyun. Ka inged ne karatuan ne inggaat kandan, diye te elat-elat te inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Huda. 2 [xr]Nalagkes kayi ka Birsiyiba, Siyiba, Mulada, 3 Hasar-Suwal, Bala, Isim, 4 Iltulad, Bitul, Hurma, 5 Siklag, Bit-Markabut, Hasar-Susa, 6 Bit-Libaut, wey Siyaruhin. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu wey tatelu (13) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi.

191 The second_ones that were_given a place by drawing_lots, were the families of the descendants of Simyun. The place as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind), was there in the middle of the place possessed by the descendants of Huda. 2 [xr]Included here were Birsiyiba, Siyiba, Mulada, 3 Hasar-Suwal, Bala, Isim, 4 Iltulad, Bitul, Hurma, 5 Siklag, Bit-Markabut, Hasar-Susa, 6 Bit-Libaut, and Siyaruhin. All the cities have_reached thirteen (13) including the towns of them.

7 Nalagkes degma ka Ayin, Rimun, Itir, wey Asan. Migginguma langun ka me siyudad te hep-at lagkes ka me lungsud kayi. 8 Nalagkes ka langun ne bariyu taman diye te Baalat-Bir ne iyan ka Rama ne diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan. Seeye ka inged ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Simyun, ne imbaad-baad dan seeye diye te tagse pamilya. 9 Ka inged ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Simyun, diye angaya te inged te me kabuhalan ni Huda su maluag de ka inged dan du te egkeilanganen dan. Seeye ka egpuunan ke mania te diye ka inged te me kabuhalan ni Simyun te elat-elat te inged te me kabuhalan ni Huda.

7 Included also here were Ayin, Rimun, Itir, and Asan. All the cities have_reached four including the towns of them. 8 Included also all the villages until there at Baalat-Bir which was Rama there in the south (LIT right side). That was the place given as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to the descendants of Simyun, which they divided to each family. 9 The place given as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to the descendants of Simyun, was taken from the place of the descendants of Huda because their place is too broad than what they need. That's the reason why the place of the descendants of Simyun was in the middle of the place of the descendants of Huda.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Sabulun

The place possessed by the descendants of Sabulun

10 Ka igkatatelu ne nabehayan te inged pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, iyan ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Sabulun. Ne nekeuma taman diye te Sarid ka eletanan te inged dan. 11 Ne puun diye, nekeuma seini te iglineb te Marala, te Dabisit, wey nakapabulus seini diye te weyig ne diye te igsile te Hukni-Am. 12 Ne puun te limang te Sarid, nekeuma pad ka eletanan te igsile taman diye te eletanan te Kislut-Tabur, wey nakapabulus seini diye te Dabirat taman diye te Hapiya. 13 Ne puun diye, nekeuma pad seini te igsile te Gat-Hipir peendiye te It-Kasin, wey Rimun. Ne nakatiku seini diye te Niya. 14 Ne ka eletanan te igkahibang ne balabahan, nakatiku diye te Hanatun wey nataman seini diye te bangalug te Ipta-Il. 15 Migginguma ka langun ne siyudad ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Sabulun te sapulu wey daruwa (12) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi. Timul pad kayi ka Katat, Nahalal, Simrun, Idala, wey Bitlihim. 16 Seeye ka me siyudad wey me lungsud ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Sabulun isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan, ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya.

10 The third_one being given a place by drawing_lots, were the families of the descendants of Sabulun. And the boundary of the place reached until there in Sarid. 11 And from there, it has reached to the west of Marala, Dabisit, and continued there in the river there at the east of Hukni-Am. 12 And from the other_side of Sarid, the boundary has reached to the east until there at the border of Kislut-Tabur, and it continued there in Dabirat until there in Hapiya. 13 And from there, it has reached to the east of Gat-Hipir going to It-Kaisin, and Rimun. And it turned_around there in Niya. 14 And the boundary at the north, turned_around there in Hanatun and ended there in the valley of Ipta-Il. 15 All the cities that were possessed by the descendants of Sabulun have_reached twelve (12) including the towns of them. Added to it were Katat, Nahalal, Simrun, Idala, and Bitlihim. 16 Those were the cities and towns possessed by the descendants of Sabulun as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind), and they divided it to each family.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Isakar

The place possessed by the descendants of Isakar

17 Ka igkeep-at ne nabehayan te inged pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, iyan ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Isakar. 18 Seini ka me inged ne naangken dan: ka Hisril, Kisulut, Sunim, 19 Hapara-Im, Siyun, Anaharat, 20 Rabit, Kisyun, Ibis, 21 Rimit, In-Ganim, In-Hada, wey Bit-Pasis. 22 Nekeuma ka eletanan dan diye te Tabur, Sahasima, Bit-Simis, wey nataman seini diye te Hurdan. Migginguma ka langun ne siyudad te sapulu wey hen-em (16) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi. 23 Ne seeye ka me siyudad wey me lungsud ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Isakar, ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya.

17 The fourth_one given a place by drawing_lots, were the families of the descendants of Isakar. 18 These were the places that they possessed: Hisril, Kisulut, Sunim, 19 Hapara-Im, Siyun, Anaharat, 20 Rabit, Kisyun, Ibis, 21 Rimit, In-Ganim, In-Hada, and Bit-Pasis. 22 Their boundary reached there to Tabur, Sahasima, Bit-Simis, and ended there in Hurdan. All the cities have_reached sixteen (16) including the towns of them. 23 And those were the cities and towns (given) as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to the descendants of Isakar, and they divided it to each family.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Asir

The place possessed by the descendants of Asir

24 Ka igkalalimma ne nabehayan te inged pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, iyan ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Asir. 25 Seini ka me inged ne naangken dan: ka Hilkat, Hali, Bitin, Aksap, 26 Alamilik, Amad, wey Misal. Ne ka eletanan dan diye te iglineb, nekeuma diye te Karmil wey Sihur-Libnat. 27 Ne nakatiku seini diye te igsile peendiye te Bit-Dagun, ne nekeuma diye te Sabulun wey diye te bangalug te Ipta-Il. Ne nekeuma seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan peendiye te Bit-Imik wey Nil. Ne nakapabulus seini diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te Kabul, 28 Ibrun, Rihub, Hamun, Kana, wey taman diye te Dakel ne Sidun. 29 Ne nakatiku seini diye te Rama, ne peendiye te siyudad ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu te Tiru. Ne nakatiku seini diye te Husa, wey nataman diye te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. Nalagkes ka duma ne me siyudad ne Mahalab, Aksib, 30 Uma, Apik, wey Rihub. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te daruwa ne pulu wey daruwa (22) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi. 31 Ne seeye ka me siyudad wey me lungsud ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Asir, ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya.

24 The fifth_one given a place by drawing_lots, were the families of the descendants of Asir. 25 These were the places that they possessed: Hilkat, Hali, Bitin, Aksap, 26 Alamilik, Amad, and Misal. And their boundary at the west, has reached to Karmil and Sihur-Libnat. 27 And it turned_around there in the east going to Bit-Dagun, and reached there to Sabulun and there at the valley of Ipta-Il. And it has reached there at the north (LIT left_side) going to Bit-Imik and Nil. And it continued there at the north (LIT left_side) of Kabul, 28 Ibrun, Rihub, Hamun, Kana, and ended at Big Sidun. 29 And it turned_around there in Rama, and going to the city of Tiru fenced with high and thick stone. And it turned_around there in Husa, and ended there in Miditiranyu Sea. Included were other cities such as Mahalab, Aksib, 30 Uma, Apik, and Rihub. All the cities have_reached twenty-two (22) including the towns of them. 31 And those were the cities and towns (given) that's inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) for the descendants of Asir, and they divided it to each family.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Naptali

The place possessed by the descendants of Naptali

32 Ka igkeen-em ne nabehayan te inged pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, iyan ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Naptali. 33 Ne ka eletanan te inged dan, migbunsud diye te Hilip wey te kayu ne uk ne diye te Sa-Ananim peendiye te Adami-Nikib wey te Habnil peendiye te Lakum, ne diye nataman seini te Weyig ne Hurdan. 34 Ne puun diye, nakatiku seini diye te iglineb peendiye te Asnut-Tabur, peendiye te Hukuk taman diye te eletanan te Sabulun diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te igsile, peendiye man-e te eletanan te Asir diye te iglineb wey te Hurdan diye te igsile. 35 Ne ka nalagkes ne me siyudad ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu, iyan ka Sidim, Sir, Hamat, Rikat, Kinirit, 36 Adama, Rama, Hasur, 37 Kidis, Idrii, In-Hasur, 38 Irun, Migdal-Il, Hurim, Bit-Anat, wey Bit-Simis. Migginguma ka langun ne me siyudad te sapulu wey siyam (19) lagkes ka me lungsud kayi. 39 Seeye ka me siyudad wey me lungsud ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Naptali, ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya.

32 The sixth_ones given a place by drawing_lots, were the families of the descendants of Naptali. 33 And the boundary of their place, started there in Hilip and of the uk tree there in Sa-Ananim going to Adami-Nikib and to Habnil going to Lakum, and it ended there in Hurdan River. 34 And from there, it turned_around there in the west going to Asnut-Tabur, going to Hakuk until there in the boundary of Sabulun in the south, going to the boundary of Asir in the west and in Hurdan there in the east. 35 And included were the cities fenced with high and thick stones, were Sidim, Sir, Hamat, Rikat, Kinirit, 36 Adama, Rama, Hasur, 37 Kidis, Idrii, In-Hasur, 38 Irun, Migdal-Il, Hurim, Bit-Anat, and Bit-Simis. All the cities have_reached nineteen (19) including the towns of them. 39 Those were the cities and towns (given) as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to the descendants of Naptali, and they divided it to each family.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Dan

The place possessed by the descendants of Dan

40 Ka igkapitu ne nabehayan te inged pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut, iyan ka me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Dan. 41 Naangken dan ka me inged te Sura, Ista-Ul, Ir-Simis, 42 Sa-Albim, Ayalun, Hitla, 43 Ilun, Timna, Ikrun, 44 Iltiki, Gibitun, Baalat, 45 Hihud, Bini-Birak, Gat-Rimun, 46 Mi-Harkun, wey Rakun, lagkes ka inged ne talipag te Hupa. 47 [xr]Piru naahew te kuntere ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Dan, sikan naa ka inlusuran dan ka inged te Lais, wey impangimatayan dan ka me mahinged diye. In-ahew ran seini wey diyad sikandan nangugpe. Ne imbalbalawan dan seini ngarani te Dan ne ngaran te kaap-apuan dan. 48 Seeye ka me siyudad wey me lungsud ne karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan ni Dan, ne imbaad-baad dan seini diye te tagse pamilya.

40 The seventh_ones given a place by drawing_lots, were the families of the descendants of Dan. 41 They possessed the places of Sura, Ista-Ul, Ir-Simis, 42 Sa-Albim, Ayalun, Hitla, 43 Ilun, Timna, Ikrun, 44 Iltiki, Gibitun, Baalat, 45 Hihud, Bini-Birak, Gat-Rimun, 46 Mi-Harkun, and Rakun, including the place on the opposite of Hupa. 47 [xr]But the enemy snatched the place possessed by the descendants of Dan, that's why they attacked the place of Lais, and they killed the inhabitants there. They snatched it and they lived there. They changed it and named it Dan after the name of their ancestor. 48 Those were the cities and towns (given) as inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) to the descendants of Dan, and they divided it to each family.

Ka inged ne naangken ni Huswi

The place possessed of Huswi

49 Te neimpusan e te pegbaad-baad te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka inged isip karatuan ne inggaat, imbehayan dan degma te inged si Huswi ne anak ni Nun.

49 When the dividing of the place of the descendants of Israil as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind), they have given Huswi a place also the child of Nun.

50 Ne sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama, imbehey ran kandin ka siyudad ne imbuyu din ne iyan ka Timnat-Sira ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim. Ne imbalbalawan din ka siyudad pasasindeha wey diyad sikandin mig-ugpe.

50 And according to the command of the Lord God, they given to him the city that he asked_for which was Timnat-Sira in the mountain of Ipraim. And he rebuild again the city and he lived there.

51 Ne iyan migbaad-baad te tane si Ilyasar ne talagpanubad, si Huswi ne anak ni Nun, wey ka me pangulu te tagse tribu te Israil. Imbaad-baad dan seeye pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, diye te gumawan te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan diye te Silu. Purisu, neimpusan e ka pegbaad-baad te inged.

51 And Ilyasar the sacrificer was the one divided the land, Huswi the child of Nun, and the leaders of each descendant of Israil. They divided it by drawing_lots in front of the Lord God, there in the door of the Tent of Meeting in Silu. Therefore, the dividing of the place was_finished.

Ka me siyudad ne aputanan

The cities of refuge

201 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huswi, 2 “Kahii nu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil ne eg-alam sikandan te me siyudad ne aputanan sumale te ingkahi ku ki Muwisis. 3 Ne ka minsan hentew ne egpakapatey ne ware din tuyui, egpakaaput sikandin te seeye ne me siyudad eyew egpakapariyu te me etew ne egsuli kandin. 4 Egpakaaput sikandin te seeye ne me siyudad, egpeendiye te gumawan te siyudad ne hukumanan, wey egpakahuhud sikandin diye te me igdatu ke nekey ka neyitabu. Egkataman, igpalasud dan e sikandin diye wey diye pad egpeuugpaa. 5 Emun ke eglupuhen sikandin diye te siyudad te me etew ne egsuli kandin, keilangan ne ka me mahinged, kene sikandin igbehey te seeye ne me etew. Tenged su ware din tuyua ka peggimatey wey ware nabelu sikandin ka miggimatey. 6 Ne eg-uugpe pad sikandin te seeye ne siyudad taman te egkewusey e sikandin wey taman te egpatey e ka Labew ne Talagpanubad ne migpamakey te seeye te timpu. Ne egpekeuli e sikandin diye te ugpaan din mismu ne migpuunan din te migpallahuy.”

201 [xr]And the Lord God said to Huswi, 2 “Tell(sg) the descendants of Israil that they will_choose cities of refuge according to what_ I _told Muwisis. 3 And whoever killed_another unintentionally, he can take_refuge in those cities in_order to be away from the people that will_take_revenge on him. 4 He can take_refuge on those cities, going to the entrance of the trial city, and he can tell the leaders on what happened. Then, they will_cause_ him _to_enter and allow_to_live_ there _temporary. 5 If the people who will_take_revenge on him run_after him in the city, the inhabitants must, not give him to those people. Because he didn't kill_someone on purpose and he was not angry on killing_someone. 6 And he will_live_temporarily in that city until his_case is resolved and until the Prominent Sacrificer who serves at that time dies. And he can go home there in his own place where he comes from running.”

7 Sikan naa ka in-alam dan ka Kidis ne diye te Galiliya ne diye te bubungan te inged te me kabuhalan ni Naptali, ka Sikim ne diye te bubungan te inged te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim, wey ka Kiryat-Arba ne iyan ka Hibrun ne diye te bubungan te inged te me kabuhalan ni Huda. 8 Ne ka diye te igsile te Hurdan ne marani te Hiriku, in-alam dan ka Bisir ne diye te disirtu diye te napu te inged te me kabuhalan ni Rubin. Ne in-alam dan man-e ka Ramut diye te Gilyad ne diye te inged te me kabuhalan ni Gad, wey ka Gulan ne diye te Basan ne diye te inged te me kabuhalan ni Manasis. 9 Seeye ka me siyudad ne aputanan ne in-alam para te me kabuhalan ni Israil, wey te kene ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ne miglemung kandan. Ka minsan hentew ne egpakapatey ne ware tuyua, egkaayun ne eg-aput diye eyew kene sikandin egkeyimatayan te etew ne egsuli kandin taheed te kene pad egkapamalehetan ne ware sale din diye te hukumanan.

7 So then they have chosen Kidis which was in Galiliya in the mountain of the place of the descendants of Naptali, and Sikim in the mountain of the place of the descendants of Ipraim, and Kiryat-Arba which was Hibrun in the mountain of the place of the descendants of Huda. 8 And there in the east of Hurdan near Hiriku, they have chosen Bisir there in the desert there in the valley of the place of the descendants of Rubin. And they have chosen Ramut also there in Gilyad in the place of the descendants of Gad, and Gulan there in Basan in the place of the descendants of Manasis. 9 Those were the cities to take_refuge_in chosen for the descendants of Israil, and of those not descendants of Israil who lived among them. And whoever can kill_someone not on purpose, can take_refuge there in_order that he won't be killed by the person who takes_revenge on him while he is not proven without sin there in the court_trial.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Libi

The place possessed by the descendants of Libi

211-2 [xr]Ne nangendiye ka me pangulu te kabuhalan ni Libi diye ki Ilyasar ne talagpanubad, diye ki Huswi ne anak ni Nun, wey diye te me pangulu te tagse tribu te Israil diye te Silu te inged ne Kanaan. Migkahi sikandan, “Migsuhu ka Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis ne egpabehayan key te me siyudad ne egkeugpaan ney, wey te panabtaban para te me ayam ney.” 3 Purisu, intuman te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egpabehayan te me siyudad wey te me panabtaban puun te inged ne karatuan ne inggaat kandan ka me kabuhalan ni Libi.

211-2 [xr]And the leaders of the descendants of Libi went to Ilyasar the sacrificer, to Huswi the child of Nun, and to the leaders of each descendant of Israil there in Silu in the place of Kanaan. They said, “The Lord God commanded Muwisis to give us(excl) cities for us(excl) to live, and pastures for our(excl) domestic_animals.” 3 Therefore, the descendants of Israil obeyed the command of the Lord God that the descendants of Libi be given a cities and pastures from the place as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind).

4 Ne iyan nekewun-a nakarawat te me siyudad ka me pamilya te kabuhalan ni Kuhat. Duma te kabuhalan ni Kuhat, ka me kabuhalan ni Aarun ne nabehayan te sapulu wey tatelu (13) ne siyudad puun te me kabuhalan ni Huda, Simyun, wey Binhamin. 5 Ne imbehayan ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Kuhat te sapulu ne siyudad puun te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim, Dan, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis.[fn]

4 And the first_ones to receive cities were the families of the descendants of Kuhat. Included in the descendants of Kuhat, (were) the descendants of Aarun that were_given thirteen (13) cities from the tribes of Huda, Simyun, and Binhamin. 5 And the other descendants of Kuhat were_given ten cities from the descendants of Ipraim, Dan, and half of the descendant/s of Manasis.[fn]

6 Ne imbehayan ka me kabuhalan ni Girsun te sapulu wey tatelu (13) ne siyudad puun te me kabuhalan ni Isakar, ni Asir, Naptali, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis ne diye te Basan.

6 And the descendants of Girsun given thirteen (13) cities from the descendants of Isakar, Aisr, Naptali, and half of the descendant/s of Manasis there in Basan.

7 Ne imbehayan degma ka me kabuhalan ni Mirari te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne me siyudad puun te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey ni Sabulun.

7 And the descendants of Mirari were given twelve (12) cities from the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and of Sabulun.

8 Ne imbehey te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me siyudad wey me panabtaban diye te me kabuhalan ni Libi pinaahi te pegpintut-pintut sumale te insuhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis.

8 And the descendants of Israil gave cities and pastures to the descendants of Libi by drawing_lots according to what_ the Lord God _commanded to Muwisis.

9-10 Seini ka me ngaran te me siyudad puun te me kabuhalan ni Huda, wey ni Simyun ne imbehey diye te me kabuhalan ni Aarun. Me kabuhalan sikandan ni Kuhat ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Libi. Sikandan ka nekewun-a nakarawat te me siyudad. 11 Imbehey kandan ka Kiryat-Arba (si Arba ka amey ni Anak) ne iyan ka Hibrun ne diye te bubungan te Huda wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 12 Piru imbehey ran ka me kamet wey me bariyu ne nakalingut te seini ne siyudad diye ki Kalib ne anak ni Hipun isip baad din. 13 Sikan naa ka imbehey ran diye te me kabuhalan ni Aarun ne talagpanubad ka Hibrun ne sabeka te me siyudad ne aputanan te me etew ne egpekeyimatey ne ware tuyua. Imbehey ran pad man-e ka Libna wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 14 Hatir wey ka me panabtaban kayi, Istimuwa wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 15 Hulun wey ka me panabtaban kayi, Dibir wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 16 Ayin wey ka me panabtaban kayi, Huta wey ka panabtaban kayi, Bit-Simis wey ka panabtaban kayi. Migginguma ka langun ne siyudad ne migpuun te me kabuhalan ni Simyun wey ni Huda te siyam. 17 Ne imbeheyan pad man-e sikandan te hep-at ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Ne iyan seini: ka Gibyun wey ka me panabtaban kayi, Giba wey ka me panabtaban kayi, 18 Anatut wey ka me panabtaban kayi, wey Almun wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 19 Migginguma ka langun ne narawat te me talagpanubad ne me kabuhalan ni Aarun te sapulu wey tatelu (13) ne siyudad wey ka me panabtaban dan.

9-10 These were the names of the cities from the descendants of Huda, and Simyun that were_given to the descendants of Aarun. They were descendants of Kuhat from the descendants of Libi. They were the first_ones to receive cities. 11 Kiryat-Arba (Arba was the father of Anak) was_given to them which was Hibrun in the mountain of Huda and its pastures. 12 But they have give the fields and villages around of this city there to Kalib the child of Hipun as his portion. 13 That's why they gave the Hibrun which was one of the cities as refuge_place of people who_commit_murder not on purpose to the descendants of Aarun the sacrificer. They have also given Libna and its pastures, 14 Hatir and its pastures, Istimuwa and its pastures, 15 Hulun and its pastures, Dibir and its pastures, 16 Ayin and its pastures, Huta and its pastures, Bit-Simis and its pastures. All the cities from the tribes of Simyun and Huda reached nine. 17 And they were_ also _given four cities from the place of the descendants of Binhamin. These were: Gibyun and its pastures, Giba and its pastures, 18 Anatut and its pastures, and Almun and its pastures. 19 All cities that were received by the descendants of Aarun reached thirteen (13) and their pastures.

20-22 Ne nakarawat ka duma ne me kabuhalan ni Kuhat ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Libi te hep-at ne siyudad puun te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim. Ne iyan seini: ka Sikim (ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim ne sabeka te me siyudad ne aputanan te etew ne egpekeyimatey ne ware tuyua), Gisir, Kibsa-Im, wey Bit-Hurun wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 23-24 Ne imbehayan pad man-e sikandan te hep-at ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Dan. Ne iyan seini: ka Iltiki, Gibitun, Ayalun, wey Gat-Rimun wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 25 Ne imbehayan pad man-e sikandan te daruwa ne siyudad te katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis. Ne iyan seini: ka Taanak, wey Gat-Rimun wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 26 Migginguma ka langun ne narawat te duma ne kabuhalan ni Kuhat te sapulu (10) ne siyudad lagkes ka me panabtaban.

20-22 And the other descendants of Kuhat who were from the tribes of Libi received four cities from the descendants of Ipraim. And these were: Sikim (which was there in the mountain of Ipraim which one of the cities as refuge_places by a person who_commits_murder not on purpose), Gisir, Kibsa-Im, and Bit-Hurun and its pastures. 23-24 And they were_ also _given four cities from the place of the descendants of Dan. And these were: Iltiki, Gibitun, Ayalun, and Gat-Rimun and its pastures. 25 And they were_ also _given two cities of the half of the descendant/s of Manasis. And these were: Taanak, and Gat-Rimun and its pastures. 26 All the cities that the rest of the descendants of Kuhat received reached ten (10) including its pastures.

27 Ka me kabuhalan ni Girsun ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Libi, nakarawat te daruwa ne siyudad puun te katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis. Ne iyan seini: ka Gulan ne diye te Basan (ne sabeka te me siyudad ne aputanan te etew ne egpekeyimatey ne ware tuyua), wey ka Bi-Istira wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 28 Ne imbehayan pad man-e sikandan te hep-at ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Isakar. Ne iyan seini: ka Kisyun, Dabirat, 29 Harmut, In-Gamin wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 30 Ne imbehayan pad man-e sikandan te hep-at ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Asir. Ne iyan seini: ka Mishal, Abdun, 31 Hilkat, wey Rihub wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 32 Ne imbehayan pad man-e sikandan te tatelu ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Naptali. Ne iyan seini: ka Kidis ne diye te Galiliya (ne sabeka te me siyudad ne aputanan te etew ne egpekeyimatey ne ware tuyua), Hamut-Dur, wey Kartan wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 33 Migginguma ka langun ne narawat te kabuhalan ni Girsun te sapulu wey tatelu (13) ne siyudad wey ka me panabtaban kayi.

27 The descendants of Girsun from the descendants of Libi, received two cities from the half of the descendant/s of Manasis. And these were: Gulan which was in Basan (which one of the cities to take_refuge by a person who commits_murder not on purpose), and Bi-Istira and its pastures. 28 And they were given also a four cities from the place of the descendants of Isakar. And these were: Kisyun, Dabirat, 29 Harmut, In-Gamin and its pastures. 30 And they were_ also _given four cities from the place of the descendants of Asir. And these were: Mishal, Abdun, 31 Hilkat, and Rihub and its pastures. 32 And they were_ also _given three cities from the place of the descendants of Naptali. And these were: Kidis which was in Galiliya (which one of the cities to take_refuge by a person who commits_murder not on purpose), Hamut-Dur, and Kartan and its pastures. 33 All the cities that the descendants of Girsun received reached thirteen (13) and its pastures.

34-35 Ne ka nasame ne me kabuhalan ni Libi ne me kabuhalan ni Mirari, imbehayan te hep-at ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Sabulun. Ne iyan seini: ka Hukni-Am, Karta, Dimna, wey Nahalal wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 36-37 Ne imbehayan pad man-e sikandan te hep-at ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Rubin. Ne iyan seini: ka Bisir, Hahas, Kidimut, wey Mipaat wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 38-39 Ne imbehayan pad man-e sikandan te hep-at ne siyudad puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Gad. Ne iyan seini: ka Ramut ne diye te Gilyad (ne sabeka te me siyudad ne aputanan te etew ne egpekeyimatey ne ware tuyua), Mahanaim, Hisbun, wey Hasir wey ka me panabtaban kayi. 40 Purisu, migginguma ka langun ne imbehey te kabuhalan ni Libi diye te kabuhalan ni Mirari te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne siyudad wey me panabtaban.

34-35 And the remaining descendants of Libi who were descendants of Marari, were_given four cities from the place of the descendants of Sabulun. And these were: Hukni-Am, Karta, Dimna, and Nahalal and its pastures. 36-37 And they were_given also with four cities from the place of the descendants of Rubin. And these were: Bisir, Hahas, Kidimut, and Mipaat and its pastures. 38-39 And they were_ also _given with four cities from the place of the descendants of Gad. And these were: Ramut which was in Gilyad (which one of the cities to take_refuge by a person who commits_murder not on purpose), Mahanaim, Hisbun, and Hasir and its pastures. 40 Therefore, all cities given by the descendants of Libi to the descendants of Mirari reached twelve (12) and its pastures.

41-42 Migginguma ka langun ne narawat te me kabuhalan ni Libi puun te inged te me kabuhalan ni Israil te hep-at ne pulu wey walu (48) ne siyudad wey ka me panabtaban kayi.

41-42 All the cities received by the descendants of Libi from the place of the descendants of Israil reached forty-eight (48) and its pastures.

Ka inged ne naangken te me kabuhalan ni Israil

The place possessed by the descendants of Israil

43 Sikan naa ka imbehey te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka langun ne inged ne insaad din diye te kaap-apuan dan. Te naangken dan e seini, diyad sikandan nangugpe. 44 Imbehayan sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama te keupianan puun te me kuntere dan ne nakalingut kandan sumale te insaad din diye te me kaap-apuan dan. Ne ware sikandan natalu te me kuntere dan tenged su impepanalu ma sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama te langun ne kuntere dan. 45 Intuman te Magbebaye ne Manama ka langun ne insaad din diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

43 So then the Lord God gave all the place to the descendants of Israil that he promised to their ancestors. When they possessed it already, they lived there. 44 The Lord God gave them peace/prosperity from their enemies around them according to what his promised to their ancestors. And they were not defeated by their enemies because the Lord God caused_ them _to_win_over all their enemies. 45 The Lord God fulfilled all his promise to the descendants of Israil.

Ka peg-uli te duma ne tribu diye te igsile

The going_home of other tribes to the east

221 Ne inlibulung ni Huswi ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis.[fn] 2 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan sikandan ni Huswi, “Inggimu niyu ka langun ne insuhu kaniyu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey intuman niyu degma ka langun ne insuhu ku kaniyu. 3 Ne minsan kuntee, ware niyu engkeri ka me duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil. Maayad-ayad kew ne migtuman te me suhu kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 4 Ne kuntee, nakarawat e ka me duma niyu ne me kabuhalan ni Israil te keupianan ne insaad kandan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Sikan naa, uli kew e diye te inged niyu ne diye te talipag te Hurdan ne imbehey kaniyu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama. 5 Piru kene niyu kalingawi te egtuman ka insuhu kaniyu wey ka impanulu kaniyu ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama: geyinawei niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, tumana niyu ka igkeupii rin, wey ka me suhu din. Keilangan ne matinumanen kew kandin, wey pamakaya niyu sikandin te mapahetpet.” 6 Nataman, impanalanginan e sikandan ni Huswi wey impeuli e. 7 (Imbehey ni Muwisis ka inged ne diye te Basan te seeye se katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis, wey imbehey degma ni Huswi diye te dangeb ne katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis wey te duma ne tribu ka inged ne diye te iglineb te Hurdan.) Impanalanginan sikandan ni Huswi te peg-uli dan e. 8 Migkahi sikandin, “Eg-uli kew ne matubung amana: masulug se me ayam, pelata, bulawan, burunsi, putew, wey me manggad. Ne baari niyu ka me karumaan niyu diye te kaniyu te minsan nekey ne naahew niyu diye te me kuntere niyu.” 9 Sikan naa ka nanguli e ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis. In-engkeran dan ka me karumaan dan ne me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Silu ne sakup te inged te Kanaan, wey miglibed e sikandan diye te Gilyad, ka tane ne naangken dan sumale te suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi ki Muwisis.

221 And Huswi gathered the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and the half of the descendant/s of Manasis.[fn] 2 [xr]And Huswi said to them, “You(pl) did all that Muwisis commanded to you(pl) who was the servant of the Lord God, and obeyed(pl) also all that I commanded you(pl). 3 And even today, you(pl) didn't leave your(pl) companion/relatives who are descendants of Israil. You(pl) are very careful to obey the commands of the Lord God to you(pl). 4 And now/today, the other companion/relatives of yours(pl) have received peace/good_things that the Lord God promised to them. So then, go_home(pl) there to your(pl) place there in the opposite of Hurdan which Muwisis the servant of the Lord God has_given you(pl). 5 But don't(pl) forget to obey the command and the teaching of Muwisis the servant of the Lord God to you(pl): love(pl) the Lord your(pl) God, obey(pl) what he desires, and his commands. It's_necessary that you(pl) become_obedient to him, and serve(pl) him energetically.” 6 Then, Huswi blessed them and caused_ them _to_go_home. 7 (Muwisis gave the place there in Basan to those half of the descendant/s of Manasis, and Huswi also gave to the other half of the descendants of Manasis and other tribes the place there in the west of Hurdan.) Huswi blessed them on their going_home. 8 He said, “You(pl) go_home very abundant: have many domestic_animals, silver, gold, burunsi, iron, and garments. And share your(pl) relatives there in your(pl)_place with what you(pl) have snatched_away from your(pl) enemies.” 9 So then the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis went_home. They left their relatives the descendants of Israil there in Silu which was under_the_jurisdiction of the place of Kanan, and they returned there in Gilyad, the land that they possessed according to the command of the Lord God through Muwisis.

Ka altar diye te marani te Hurdan

The altar near Hurdan

10 Te nekeume e ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis diye te Gililut ne marani te Hurdan, miggimu sikandan te dakel ne altar. Ka seini ne inged sakup pad te Kanaan. 11-12 Te nanengnengan te duma ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ne miggimu sikandan te altar diye te Gililut ne marani te Weyig ne Hurdan ne eletanan te Kanaan, miglibulung sikandan diye te Silu eyew egbubunu kandan.

10 When the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis reached there in Gililut which was near Hurdan, they made a big altar. This place was still under_the_jurisdiction of Kanaan. 11-12 When the other descendants of Israil knew that they made an altar there in Gililut which was near the Hurdan River the boundary of Kanaan, they gathered there in Silu in_order to fight against them.

13 Ne impeendiye te me kabuhalan ni Israil si Pinihas ne anak ni Ilyasar ne talagpanubad diye te Gilyad te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis. 14 Indumaan si Pinihas te sapulu ne pangulu te tagse kabuhalan te Israil. Ka tagse sabeka kandan, me pangulu te tagse me pamilya te me kabuhalan dan. 15 Te pegginguma ran diye te Gilyad, ingkahiyan dan e ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis, 16 [xr]“Ka intiru ne keet-etawan te Magbebaye ne Manama egkeupian ne egpakataha ke mania te in-akalan niyu ka Manama te Israil. Insupak niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi te peggimu niyu te altar para kaniyu. Ware niyud ikula sikandin. 17 [xr]Kene naan pad ne eleg ka sale ne neyimu ta diye te Piyur? Tenged dutu, inlegparan ki te Magbebaye ne Manama wey minsan kuntee mig-antus ki re due. 18 Ne kuntee, eg-inniyuhan niyud man-e ka Magbebaye ne Manama! Ke egsupak kew pad man-e kandin kuntee, egkalangetan sikandin kaaselem te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil. 19 Sikan naa, emun ke keilangan niyu ka altar tenged su kene ne likes ne egsimbaan ka inged niyu, hendiye kew naan de kanami, diye te inged te Magbebaye ne Manama ne due Matulus ne Balungbalung ne In-alad, wey egpekeugpe kew diye. Kene kew re iya himu te lein ne altar angin e te altar te Magbebaye ne Manama ta. 20 [xr]Sumsumana niyu si Akan ne anak ni Sira ne ware migtuman te suhu meyitenged te me kasangkapan ne nakahalad e wey nakapanubad e langun diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. Inlegparan sikandin wey ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil. Kene ne si Akan de ka napatey tenged te sale din.”

13 And the descendants of Israil caused_ Pinihas the child of Ilyasar the sacrificer _to_go there in Gilyad to the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis. 14 Pinihas was accompanied by ten leaders of each descendant of Israil. Each one of them, were leaders of each family of their descendants. 15 When they reached there in Gilyad, they told the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis, 16 [xr]“The entire people of the Lord God wanted to know why you(pl) betrayed the God of Israil. You(pl) disobeyed the Lord God by your(pl) making of an altar for you(pl). You(pl) don't follow him anymore. 17 [xr]Would not our(incl) sin that we(incl) did in Piyur is not enough? Due to it, the Lord God punished us(incl) and even today we(incl) are still suffering. 18 And now/today, you(pl) are turning_back from the Lord God! If you(pl) are disobeying again now/today, he will_be_angry tomorrow with all the descendants of Israil. 19 So then, if you(pl) need the altar because your(pl) place is not worthy for worshiping, just come(pl) to us(excl), there in the place of the Lord God with a Holy Fenced Tent, and you(pl) can_live there. Just don't(pl) make another altar except for the altar of the Lord our(incl) God. 20 [xr]Remember(pl) Akan the child of Sira who didn't obey concerning the all things offered and sacrificed already to the Lord God. He was punished and all the descendants of Israil. Not only Akan died because of his sin.”

21 Ne migtabak ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis te seeye se me pangulu te me pamilya te Israil, 22 kahi ran, “Ka Magbebaye ne Manama, Amana ne Maresen ne Manama! Ka Magbebaye, Amana ne Maresen ne Manama! Nakataha sikandin ke mania te inggimu ney seini, wey keilangan degma ne egkatahaan niyu seini. Emun ke malehet ne migsupak key te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey ke mig-inniyug key kandin, himatayi key e nikaniyu te seini ne aldew. 23 Ne emun ke insupak ney ka Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi te peggimu ney te altar ney mismu ne para egtutungan te me igpanubad, egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne pinamula ne halad, wey ke me igpanubad para te meupiya ne rilasyun te Magbebaye ne Manama, eglegparan key perem te Magbebaye ne Manama. 24 Inggimu ney re seini tenged su naaldek key ne kema ke egginguma ka timpu ne ka me kabuhalan niyu egkahi te me kabuhalan ney, ‘Nekey-a ka labet niyu te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil? 25 Inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne eletanan ta ka Hurdan te pegpasuwey kaniyu puun kanami. Ne ware labet niyu se me kabuhalan ni Rubin wey Gad te Magbebaye ne Manama.’ Ne kema ke egkenaan e te me kabuhalan niyu ka me kabuhalan ney ne egsimba te Magbebaye ne Manama. 26 Sikan naa ka miggimu key te altar, kene ne eyew egtutungan, wey ke eghalaran naa te me halad ney, 27 ke kene, eyew limlimuan para kanami, para kaniyu, wey para te me kabuhalan, ne egsimba key iya te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te balungbalung pinaahi te pegtutung te me igpanubad, me igpanubad para te meupiya ne rilasyun, wey te duma pad ne me halad. Purisu, te egginguma ne timpu, kene egpakakahi ka me kabuhalan niyu diye te me kabuhalan ney ne ware labet dan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 28 Ne emun ke egkamalehet ne egkahiyan dan ka me kabuhalan ney te iling due, egpakakahi sikandan te, ‘Tengtengi niyu! Miggimu ka me kaap-apuan ney te altar ne iling te altar te Magbebaye ne Manama, kene ne egtutungan wey ke eghalaran naa te me halad, ke kene, eyew due limlimuan para kanami wey kaniyu.’ 29 Kene ney egkeyimu ne egsupak wey ke eg-inniyug te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi te peggimu te kanami ne altar ne para te egtutungan te me igpanubad, egkakeen ne egpuun te egketuen ne pinamula ne halad, wey duma pad ne me halad. Iyan de eghalaran ka altar te Magbebaye ne Manama ta ne diye nakatahu te balungbalung ne egsimbaan kandin.”

21 And the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis answered to those leaders of the families of Israil, 22 they said, “The Lord God, is_Very Powerful God! The Lord God, is_Very Powerful God! He knows why we(excl) did this, and it is necessary also_that you(pl) will_know it. If it is true that we(excl) disobeyed the Lord God, or we(excl) turned_back from him, just kill us(excl) this day. 23 And if we(excl) disobeyed the Lord God by making our(excl) own altar for burning the sacrifices, food from plucked plants for offering, and offerings for good relationship with the Lord God, may the Lord God punish us(excl). 24 We(excl) just did this because we(excl) are afraid that time will_come that your(pl) descendants will_say to our(excl) descendants, ‘What's your(pl) business (LIT portion) with the Lord God of Israil? 25 The Lord God made Hurdan as the boundary in separating you(pl) from us(excl). And you(pl) descendants of Rubin and Gad have no business (LIT portion) with God.’ And perhaps your(pl) descendants will_prohibit our(excl) descendants to worship the Lord God. 26 That's why we(excl) made an altar, and not in_order for burning, or to offer our(excl) offerings, 27 but rather, as a remembrance for us(excl), for you(pl), and for the descendants, that we(excl) indeed worship with the Lord God there in the tent by burning sacrifices, sacrifices for good relationship, and other offerings. Therefore, in the coming time, your(pl) descendants won't be able to say to our(excl) descendants that they have no business (LIT portion) with the Lord God. 28 And if it will_become_true that they will_say that to our(excl) descendants, they can say, ‘Look(pl)! Our(excl) descendants made an altar like the altar of the Lord God, not for burning or to offer offerings, but rather, as a remembrance for us(excl) and for you(pl).’ 29 We(excl) can't do to disobey or to turn_back from the Lord by making our(excl) altar for burning of sacrifices, food offering from the plucked plants, and other offerings. Only the altar of the Lord God there in the tent where he is worshiped the thing_to_be_offered_on.”

30 Ne amana nahale si Pinihas ne talagpanubad wey ka me pangulu te me pamilya te me kabuhalan ni Israil te pegkarineg dan te ingkahi te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te kabuhalan ni Manasis. 31 Sikan naa ka ingkahiyan ni Pinihas ne anak ni Ilyasar ne talagpanubad ka me kabuhalan ni Rubin, Gad, wey katenge te me kabuhalan ni Manasis, “Natahaan tad kuntee ne indumaan ki te Magbebaye ne Manama tenged te ware kew migsupak kandin. Inluwas niyu ka me kabuhalan ni Israil puun te legpad te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

30 And Pinihas the sacrificer was so happy and the leaders of the family of the descendants of Israil when they heard what the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis have said. 31 That's why Pinihas the child of Ilyasar the sacrificer said to the descendants of Rubin, Gad, and half of the descendants of Manasis, “We(incl) knew today/now that the Lord God will_be_with us(incl) because you(pl) didn't disobey him. You(pl) have saved the descendants of Israil from the punishment of the Lord God.”

32 Ne nanguli e ensi Pinihas wey ka me pangulu diye te Kanaan, wey ingguhud dan te me karumaan dan ne me kabuhalan ni Israil ka neyingumaan dan ne guhud puun te me kabuhalan ni Rubin, wey ni Gad ne diye te Gilyad. 33 Te narineg seini te me kabuhalan ni Israil, nahale sikandan wey indeyrey ran ka Manama. Ne warad sikandan migsuman-suman ne eglusud diye te inged ne nangugpaan te me kabuhalan ni Rubin wey Gad.

32 And Pinihas and the leaders went_home to Kanaan, and they told to their relatives the descendants of Israil what_ they _heard story (LIT reached story) from the descendants of Rubin, and Gad there in Gilyad. 33 When the descendants of Israil heard it, they were happy and praised God. And they didn't think to attack the place where the descendants of Rubin and Gad lived.

34 Ne ingngaranan te me kabuhalan ni Rubin wey ni Gad ka altar te “Limlimuan” su migkahi sikandan, “Seini ka limlimuan ta langun te ka Magbebaye, iyan ka Manama ta.”

34 And the descendants of Rubin and Gad named the altar “Remembrance” because they said, “This is all our(incl) remembrance that the Lord, is our(incl) God.”

Ka pegpanaha-taha ni Huswi

The farewell of Huswi

231 Te malayat e ne timpu ka miglihad, impeyimeley e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka Israil puun te me kuntere dan ne nakalingut kandan. Te seeye ne timpu, buyag e amana si Huswi. 2 Ne impeumew ni Huswi ka langun ne me kabuhalan ni Israil, lagkes ka me igdatu, ka me pangulu, ka me talewukum, wey ka me upisyal. Ne ingkahiyan din sikandan, “Buyag ad amana kuntee. 3 Ne nakita niyu ka langun ne inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu te seini ne me nasud tenged kaniyu. Ne sikandin e ka migpakiggira te me kuntere niyu. 4 Ne nabaad-baad kud diye te kaniyu isip karatuan ne inggaat te me kabuhalan niyu ka langun ne inged te me nasud ne naahew ta, lagkes ka me nasud ne ware te pad naahew. Puun seeye te igsile te Hurdan peendiye te iglineb te Dahat ne Miditiranyu. 5 Ne egdeldelen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu sikandan wey egpaaween eyew egsubalan niyu ka tane dan su sika ka insaad te Magbebaye kaniyu. 6 Purisu, pakannekal kew. Pakannekali niyu te egtuman ka langun ne nasulat te baseen te Balaud ni Muwisis. Tumana niyu ka langun ne nasulat kayi. 7 Kene kew saamul te me etew ne mig-ugpe duma kaniyu, kene kew dawit te me ngaran te me diyus-diyus dan, wey ke egpanaad naa ne eggamiten ka ngaran dan. Ne kene kew simba, wey ke pamakey naa kandan. 8 Ke kene, palunggaat kew ne matinumanen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, iling te inggimu niyu kuntee. 9 Ne indeldel te Magbebaye ne Manama ka derakel wey maresen ne me nasud te peglusud niyu kandan. Ne minsan kuntee, ware iya nakatalu kaniyu. 10 [xra][xrb]Ne minsan hentew kaniyu, egpakadelrel te sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne etew, tenged su ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka egbubunu te me kuntere niyu sumale te insaad din kaniyu. 11 Purisu, geyinawei niyu iya ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu. 12 Piru ke eg-inniyug kew kandin, wey ke egpakigsaamul kew naa te me etew ne mig-ugpe duma kaniyu, wey ke egpangasawa naa kandan, 13 egpakasihuru kew ne kenad iya egdeldelen te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka me etew ne mig-ugpe duma kaniyu. Ke kene, egkeyimu nasi sikandan ne egpakarereet kaniyu iling te balatik, wey ke sahilut naa, wey egpakamasakit sikandan te peka niyu iling te eglampesan, wey iling sikandan te duhi ne egpakasanggat te me mata niyu. Ne egpabulus seini taman te egkapatey kew kayi te meupiya ne inged ne imbehey kaniyu te Magbebaye ne Manama.

231 When a long time passed_by, the Lord God put_a_rest on Israil from the enemies that surrounded them. At that time, Huswi as very old already. 2 And Huswi called all the descendants of Israil, including the tribal_leaders, leaders, judges, and officers. And he told them, “I am very old now. 3 And you(pl) saw everything that the Lord your(pl) God did to this nation for you(pl). And he was the one fighting against your(pl) enemies. 4 And I have divided among you(pl) all the places of the nations that we(incl) conquered as an inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind) of the tribes, including the nations that we(incl) haven't conquered yet. It is from the east of Hurdan going to the west of Miditiranyu Sea. 5 And the Lord your(pl) God will_chase_ them _away and remove (them) so_that you(pl) will_take_over their place because that's what the Lord promised to you(pl). 6 Therefore, strive_hard(pl). Strive_hard(pl) to obey all that's written in the Law of Muwisis. Obey(pl) all that's written in it. 7 Don't join with the people that live among you(pl), don't(pl) call the names of their gods, or promise using their names. Don't(pl) worship, or serve them either. 8 But rather, remain faithful to the Lord your(pl) God, like what you(pl) did today/now. 9 The Lord God chased_away the great and powerful nations when you(pl) attacked them. And even today/now, no (one) indeed defeated you(pl). 10 [xra][xrb]And whoever among you(pl), can_chase_away one thousand (1,000) people, because the Lord God is the one to fight agaist your(pl) enemies according to his promise to you(pl). 11 Therefore, love(pl) the Lord your(pl) God indeed. 12 But if you(pl) turn_back from him, or join with the people that live among you(pl), or marry them, 13 you(pl) can be sure that the Lord your(pl) God won't chase_away the people who live among you(pl). But rather, they become a harm for you(pl) like a snare, or a trap, and they can_cause_a_pain at your(pl) back like someone_beaten_up, and they are_like a thorn that hooks_up your(pl) eyes. And this will_continue until you(pl) die here in the good land that the Lord God has_given you(pl).

14 “Mahaan ad e egpatey. Tantanuri niyu layun ne intuman te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ka langun ne meupiya ne insaad din kaniyu. Ne ware iya minsan sabeka ne ware din tumana. 15 Piru ke immenu te Magbebaye ne Manama te pegtuman ka langun ne meupiya ne insaad din kaniyu, iling ded degma ka pegtuman din te karereetan ne impaney-paney rin e kaniyu, taman te egdereetan kew e nikandin puun kayi te meupiya ne inged ne imbehey rin kaniyu. 16 Malehet iya ne egkatuman seini due te kaniyu ke egsupaken niyu ka kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama niyu ne igpatuman din kaniyu. Ne emun ke egsimba kew wey egpamakey te me diyus-diyus, igpasalerep kew iya nikandin te mangune-kune ne langet din, wey sahuhune ne egkareetan kew kayi te meupiya ne inged ne imbehey rin kaniyu.”

14 “I will_die shortly. Always remember that the Lord God has fulfilled all good_things he has promised to you(pl). And nothing even one that he did not fulfilled. 15 But the way (LIT how) the Lord God fulfilled all the good_things that he has promised to you(pl), just like that also his fulfillment of the destruction that he warned to you(pl), until he can destroy you(pl) from this good place that he gave to you(pl). 16 This indeed be_fulfilled unto you(pl) if you(pl) disobey the covenant of the Lord God which he cause_to_obey by you(pl). And if you(pl) worship or serve the gods, he will_cause_ you(pl) _to_suffer from his great wrath, and suddenly you(pl) will_be_destroyed here in the good place that he gave to you(pl).”

Ka pegsaad man-e te me kabuhalan ni Israil

The promising again of the descendants of Israil

241 Ne inlibulung ni Huswi ka langun ne tribu te Israil diye te Sikim. Ne impeumew rin ka me igdatu, me pangulu, me talewukum, wey me upisyal te Israil. Ne migparani sikandan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 2 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka langun ne etew, “Seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil: Diye nangugpe dengan ka me kaap-apuan niyu te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis, wey migpamakey sikandan te me diyus-diyus. Ne sabeka kandan si Tira ne amey ni Abraham wey ni Nahur. 3 [xra][xrb]Piru ingkuwa ku si Abraham puun dutu ne inged wey impeendiye ku sikandin te inged ne Kanaan, wey impabuhal ku sikandin diye. Ne imbehayan ku sikandin te anak ne si Isaak. 4 [xra][xrb][xrc]Ne imbeheyan ku degma si Isaak te anak ne si Hakub wey Isaw. Ne imbehey ku ki Isaw ka bubungan te Siir isip baad din. Piru nangendiye mule si Hakub wey ka me anak din te Ihiptu. 5 [xr]Nataman, impeuyan ku si Muwisis wey si Aarun ka egluwas kaniyu diye te Ihiptu. Ne impasalerep ku te legpad ka Ihiptu, wey impalihawang ku sikaniyu diye. 6 [xr]Te pegginguma te me kaap-apuan niyu diye te Malalab ne Dahat, intalukunan sikandan te me Ihiptuhanen ne nangukudde wey nangekarwahi. 7 Ne migpangananey sikandan keddi, wey intahuan ku te meitem ne gapun ka eletanan dan wey te me Ihiptuhanen. Ne nenaalep e ka me Ihiptuhanen wey nallened e sikandan. Namelmelehan niyu ke nekey ka inggimu ku diye te me Ihiptuhanen wey naluhey kew ka nangugpe diye te disirtu.

241 And Huswi gathered all the tribes of Israil there in Sikim. He summoned the tribal_leaders, leaders, judges, and officers in Israil. And they came_close in front of the Lord God. 2 [xr]And Huswi told all the people, “This is what the Lord God said to Israil: Your(pl) ancestors lived before at the opposite of the Iyupratis River, and they worshiped gods. And one of them was Tira the father of Abraham and of Nahur. 3 [xra][xrb]But I took Abraham from that place and sent him to the place of Kanaan, and I caused_ him _to_multiply there. And I gave him a child Isaak. 4 [xra][xrb][xrc]And I also gave Isaak a child Hakub and Isaw. And I have given to Isaw the mountain of Siir as his portion. But Hakub on the other hand and his children went to Ihiptu. 5 [xr]Then, I sent Muwisis and Aarun to save you(pl) there in Ihiptu. And I caused_ Ihiptu _to_suffer, and I caused_ you(pl) _to_come_out there. 6 [xr]When your(pl) ancestors reached in Red Sea, the Ihiptuhanons chased_after them riding_on_horses and riding_on_chariots. 7 And they asked_help from me, and I put a black cloud between them and Ihiptuhanons. And they were_covered_with_water and they were drowned. You(pl) have seen what_ I _have done to the Ihiptuhanons and you(pl) have lived longer there in the desert.

8 [xr]“Nataman, in-uyan ku sikaniyu diye te inged te me Amurihanen ne nangugpe diye te igsile te Hurdan. Ne migpakigbunu sikandan kaniyu, piru impatalu ku sikandan kaniyu. Indereetan ku sikandan, wey in-angken niyud ka inged dan te peglusud niyu. 9 [xr]Ne migpakig-ehet kaniyu si Balak ne Hari te Muwab ne anak ni Sipur, wey imparilus kew nikandin ki Balaam ne anak ni Biyur. 10 Piru ware ku tuhuti si Balaam ne eggimuwen din sika due te kaniyu, ke kene, impepanalanginan ku sikaniyu wey inluwas ku sikaniyu puun ki Balak. 11 [xra][xrb]Ne miglapas kew te Hurdan, wey nekeuma kew te Hiriku. Migpakigbunu kaniyu ka me mahinged te Hiriku lagkes ka me Amurihanen, Pirisihanen, Kanaanen, Hitihanen, Girgasihanen, Hibitihanen, wey Hibusihanen. Piru impatalu ku sikandan kaniyu. 12 [xr]Ne ingginaldek[fn] ku ka daruwa ne Hari ne me Amurihanen eyew egkareldel niyu sikandan te peglusud niyu. Migpanalu kew ne kene ne pinaahi te kampilan wey pane niyu. 13 [xr]Imbeheyan ku sikaniyu te inged ne kene ne sikaniyu ka nalasey. Impeugpe ku sikaniyu te me siyudad ne kene ne sikaniyu ka migpasasindeg. Nangeen kew kuntee te behas te paras wey te ulibu ne kene ne sikaniyu ka migpamula.”

8 [xr]“Then, I took you(pl) there in the place of the Amurihanons that lived there in the east of Hurdan. And they fought against you(pl), but I caused_ them _to_be_defeated by you(pl). I destroyed them, and you(pl) possessed their land on your(pl) attacking. 9 [xr]And Balak the king of Muwab fought against you(pl) the child of Sipur, and he caused_ Balaam _to_curse you(pl) the child of Biyur. 10 But I didn't allow Balaam to do that to you(pl), but rather, I caused_ you(pl) _to_be_blessed and I saved you(pl) from Balak. 11 [xra][xrb]And you(pl) crossed Hurdan, and reached Hiriku. The inhabitants of Hiriku fought against you(pl) including the Amurihanons, Pirisihanons, Kananons, Hitihanons, Girgasihanons, Hibitihanons, and Hibusihanons. But I caused_ them _to_be_defeated by you(pl). 12 [xr]And I frightened[fn] the two Amurihanon kings so_that you(pl) can chase_ them _away when you(pl) are attacking. You(pl) won and not by sword and bow. 13 [xr]I have given you(pl) a place which you(pl) didn't work_hard. I caused_ you(pl) _to_live in cities that you(pl) didn't erect. You(pl) now eat a fruit of vineyards and olive that you(pl) didn't plant.”

14 Ne migkahi pad man-e si Huswi, “Purisu kuntee, kaaldeki niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama wey pamakaya niyu sikandin te intiru ne pusung niyu. Engkeri niyud kuntee ka me diyus-diyus te me kaap-apuan niyu ne insimba ran dengan diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis, wey diye te Ihiptu. Ne iyan niyu re pamakaya ka Magbebaye ne Manama. 15 Piru ke kene kew egkeupian ne egpamakey te Magbebaye ne Manama, alam kew kuntee ne aldew ke iyan niyu egpamakayen ka me diyus-diyus te me kaap-apuan niyu ne diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis wey ke ka me diyus-diyus naa te me Amurihanen ne kayi te in-ugpaan niyu kuntee? Piru sikeddi wey ka pamilya ku, iyan ney mule egpamakayen ka Magbebaye ne Manama.”

14 And Huswi also said, “Therefore now/today, fear(pl) the Lord God and serve(pl) him with all your(pl) hearts. Leave now the gods of your(pl) ancestors that they worshiped before there at the opposite of Iyupratis River, and there in Ihiptu. And the (one that) you(pl) serve only is the Lord God. 15 But if you(pl) don't want to serve the Lord God, choose today if you(pl) serve the gods of your(pl) ancestors which were served in the opposite of Iyupraties River or the gods of the Amurihanons here where you(pl) live today? But me and my family, the (one that) we(excl) serve is the Lord God.”

16 Ne migtabak ka me etew, “Ware te suman-suman ney ne eg-engked te Magbebaye ne Manama wey ke egpamakey naa te me diyus-diyus. 17 Su ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka migluwas kanta wey te me kaap-apuan ta te timpu ne neuripen ki diye te Ihiptu. Ne namelmelehan tad degma ka me kein-inuwan ne inggimu rin. Impangabangan ki nikandin te peggipanew ta wey te peglihad ta diye te duma ne me nasud. 18 Ne ka me Amurihanen ne nangugpe te seini ne inged, indelrel sikandan langun te Magbebaye te peglusud niyu kandan. Purisu, egpamakey key degma te Magbebaye su sikandin de iya ka Manama ta.”

16 And the people answered, “Not in our(excl) minds to leave the Lord God or serve the gods. 17 Because the Lord God was the (one who) saved us(incl) and of our(incl) ancestors at the time we(incl) were enslaved there in Ihiptu. And we(incl) have seen_clearly also the miracles that he did. He protected us(incl) on our(incl) walking and on our(incl) passing_by the other nations. 18 And the Amurihanons that lived in this place, they were_chased_away by the Lord on your(pl) attacking of them. Therefore, we(excl) will_ also _serve the Lord because he is the only God.”

19 Ne migkahiyan ni Huswi ka me etew, “Kene egkaayun ne egpamakey kew te Magbebaye ne Manama su matulus sikandin wey talikuren. Kene din egpasayluwen ka me mareet ne hinimuwan niyu wey ka me sale niyu. 20 Ne emun ke eg-inniyuhan niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama wey egpamakey kew te me diyus-diyus, egkabelu sikandin kaniyu wey eglegparan kew nikandin. Egguleen kew nikandin minsan pad ke neyid-u dengan sikandin kaniyu.”

19 And Huswi told the people, “It's_ not _possible for you(pl) to serve the Lord God because he is holy and jealous. He will_ not _forgive your(pl) evil deeds and your(pl) sins. 20 And if you(pl) turn_back from the Lord God and serve(pl) the gods, he will_be_angry at you(pl) and he will_punish you(pl). He will_kill_ you(pl) _all even if he pitied you(pl) before.”

21 Piru migtabak ka me etew, “Egpamakey key iya te Magbebaye ne Manama.” 22 Ne migkahi si Huswi, “Sikaniyu mismu ka me talagpamalehet te pegkeetew niyu ne egpamakey kew te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

21 But the people answered, “We(excl) will_ indeed _serve the Lord God.” 22 And Huswi said, “You(pl) yourselves the witness of your(pl) selves that you(pl) will_serve the Lord God.”

Ne migtabak sikandan, “Uya, sikanami iya ka me talagpamalehet.”

And they answered, “Yes, we(excl) are indeed the witnesses.”

23 Ne migkahi si Huswi, “Emun ke iling due, engkeri niyud ka me diyus-diyus niyu wey pamakey kew te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil.”

23 And Huswi said, “If it is like that, leave(pl) your(pl) gods and worship the Lord God of Israil.”

24 Ne migtabak ka me etew, “Egpamakey key te Magbebaye ne Manama ney, wey egtumanen ney ka me suhu din.”

24 And the people answered, “We(excl) will_serve the Lord our(excl) God, and we(excl) will_obey his commands.”

25 Purisu, te seeye ne aldew miggimu si Huswi te kasabutan diye te Sikim para te me keet-etawan te Israil. Ne imbehayan din sikandan te me balaud wey me suhu. 26 Insulat seini ni Huswi diye te Libru te Balaud te Manama. Nataman, migkuwa sikandin te dakel ne batu wey intahu din seini diye te lenged te uk ne kayu diye te matulus ne inged te Magbebaye ne Manama. 27 Ne ingkahiyan ni Huswi ka langun ne etew, “Egpakabulig kaniyu seini ne batu ne egkasuman-suman niyu ke nekey ka immanlalag ta kuntee. Kayi seini ne batu te pegnangen ku kaniyu te lalag te Magbebaye ne Manama. Purisu ka seini ne batu egpakabulig kaniyu ne egkasuman-suman niyu ke nekey ka neyitabu kuntee. Egpasuman-suman seini kaniyu te kene peg-inniyug te Manama.” 28 Nataman, impeuli e ni Huswi ka me etew diye te tagse inged dan isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan.

25 Therefore, on that day Huswi made a covenant there in Sikim for the people of Israil. And he gave them laws and commands. 26 Huswi wrote it there in the Book of Law of God. Then, he took a big stone and put it there near the uk tree there in the holy place of the Lord God. 27 And Huswi told all the people, “This stone will_help you(pl) that you(pl) remember what we(incl) said(pl) today. This stone was here when I told you(pl) the word of the Lord God. Therefore this stone will_help you(pl) that you(pl) remember what happened today. This remind you(pl) to not turning_back (against) God.” 28 Then, Huswi caused_ the people _to_go_home there on their each places as their inheritance (LIT wealth left_behind).

Ka pegpatey ni Huswi wey ni Ilyasar

The dying of Huswi and Ilyasar

29 Nataman, napatey e ka suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama ne si Huswi ne anak ni Nun, te sabeka ne gatus wey sapulu (110) ka idad din. 30 [xr]Ne inlebeng dan sikandin diye te baad din ne inged diye te Timnat-Sira ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim, diye seini te igkahibang ne balabahan te bubungan te Gaas.

29 Then, the servant of the Lord God Huswi the child of Nun died, when his age was one hundred ten (110). 30 [xr]And they buried him there in his portion of the land/place at Timnat-Sira which was there in the mountain of Ipraim, there north (LIT left side) of the mountain of Gaas.

31 Migpamakey ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te Magbebaye ne Manama te neuyag pad si Huswi wey ka me igdatu te Israil ne nakataha te langun ne inggimu te Magbebaye para te Israil.

31 The descendants of Israil served the Lord God while Huswi was still alive and the leaders of Israil knew everything that the Lord did for Israil.

32 [xr]Egpakasungkiye pad ne guhud, ka tul-an ni Husi ne in-uyan te me kabuhalan ni Israil puun te Ihiptu, diye dan ilebeng te Sikim. Diye dan seini ilebeng te inged ne nabeli ni Hakub te sabeka ne gatus (100) ne pelata diye te me anak ni Hamur ne amey ni Sikim. Ne iyan nakaangken kayi ne inged ka me kabuhalan ni Husi.

32 [xr]The_story_can_be_changed_this time, the bones of Husi that the descendants of Israil brought from Ihiptu, they buried it there in Sikim. The buried it there in the place that Hakub bought for one hundred (100) silver from the children of Hamur the father of Sikim. And the ones who possessed this place were the descendants of Husi.

33 Ne migpatey e degma si Ilyasar ne anak ni Aarun, wey diye sikandin ilebeng te Gibiya, ka siyudad ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim ne imbehey rin te anak din ne si Pinihas.

33 And Ilyasar the child of Aarun also died, and he was_buried there in Gibiya, the city on the mountain of Ipraim that he gave to his child Pinihas.
